# PowerPoint import — lot 5: app import and agent fine-tuning — Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** In the app, "Open" accepts a `.pptx`: a dialog asks for the mode (hi-fi, or retrofit with a pack and a theme), the app builds a new deck from the import plan in one undoable step, then an agent fine-tunes it in a bounded loop, slide by slide against the reference witness, through two new MCP tools (`import_report`, `import_diff`) and versioned instructions.

**Architecture:** The import orchestration leaves the CLI for a module `oku_slides_session::import` (read, project, install in one history step, probe, render through the worker, overflows, witness, `ImportState`); the CLI and the app's workspace (`WorkspaceRequest::ImportTab`) both call it. The witness ranking first learns the witness's own errors (`WitnessLimit`, t-884) so the agent never chases them. Packs and themes generated or derived by an import are deck-only (`PackScope::Deck`): agent edits embed new versions and never touch the library. The tab keeps an `ImportState` in memory; the MCP tools read it, count tries per slide from page fingerprints and refuse beyond `[import] tune_iterations`. A `Tune` agent turn carries the hidden `import.md` instructions; both hosts start it after an import with `tune`.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 2024 (`oku-slides-session`, `-import`, `-reference`, `-mcp`, `-agent`, `-platform`, `-core`, `-cli`, `-i18n`), `rust-mcp-sdk` 1.x, `office2pdf` =0.8.1 witness in the render worker, Fluent (20 locales); Tauri 2 host (`src-tauri`); React/TS UI with Bun, happy-dom render tests, Playwright e2e with the fake ACP agent; tests with `speculoos`, `rstest`, nextest.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-09-import-pptx-design.md` — "Agent fine-tuning (app)", "Entry points", "Import report", "Tests", "Lots", and the section "Decisions from the lot 5 plan (2026-10-16)" that Task 11 adds. Earlier plans: `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-09-import-pptx-lot1.md`, `…-10-10-import-pptx-lot2.md`, `…-10-11-import-pptx-lot3.md`, `…-10-14-import-pptx-lot4.md`; their validated decisions still apply where lot 5 does not supersede them.

**Subtasks:** Task 1 → t-913, Task 2 → t-914, Task 3 → t-915, Task 4 → t-916, Task 5 → t-917, Task 6 → t-918, Task 7 → t-919, Task 8 → t-920, Task 9 → t-921, Task 10 → t-922, Task 11 → t-923, Task 12 → t-924, Task 13 → t-925, Task 14 → t-926, Task 15 → t-927, Task 16 → t-928, Task 17 → t-929 (parent t-692). Backlog from the plan review: t-901 to t-911.

**Drafting:** every task was implemented, built and tested in a draft worktree before being written down; the diffs in this plan are the draft commits' diffs, inserted mechanically, and each diff applies on the state the previous task left. Task 2's threshold comes from a live witness run of alto, `libreoffice.pptx` and `kitchen` (table in its commit message). Task 10's e2e imported alto in the real app (web mode) and ran the fake agent's fine-tuning turn. The draft was first written on `861d4304`, then replayed task by task onto `3213b0d0` (main had taken ~60 commits, among them the LibreOffice witness t-885, `CheckedPlan` t-892, the neutral `oklab` module t-889 and the t-816/t-817/t-863 fixes); each task's intro lists the main changes it carries, and the threshold was measured again on the replayed code (same table to the hundredth). The plan review then added Tasks 12–17 (see "Plan review").

## Decisions validated on 2026-10-15/16 (they override the spec)

1. **One pipeline, in the session.** The CLI's import orchestration moves into `oku_slides_session::import`; the session depends on `oku-slides-import` and `oku-slides-reference` (core never does). The CLI keeps its options, output and saving; rendering goes through the render worker only. The target is `ImportTarget`, tagged by `mode`: `{"mode":"retrofit","pack","theme"?}` or `{"mode":"hifi"}` (Tasks 3–4).
2. **t-884 first.** `metrics::WitnessLimit` (`autofit`, `tracking`, `chart`, `smart_art`) marks regions whose gap is a known office2pdf error, read from the `SourceDeck`; they rank after the others and never flag a slide. `autofit` follows office2pdf's own trigger (bare `normAutofit`, one unbulleted paragraph in a box of at most two lines, or text anchored middle/bottom), not every `normAutofit`: alto's real gaps are all `normAutofit`. Only under office2pdf: `metrics::Witness { Office2Pdf, Other }`, none under `--reference soffice` (user decision, 2026-10-16). Threshold recalibrated to `7.0` on a live run (Tasks 1–2): faithful slides ≤ 5.8, real gaps ≥ 8.7 (alto p. 6 9.38, p. 7 15.71); alto p. 6–7 flagged. Main's t-863 (`9914a1f2`) fixed the p. 8 bullet indents, which lot 4 had measured at 8.72: p. 8 is no longer flagged.
3. **Bounds held by the tools, one agent turn.** `import_report` gives the queue (slides not `done`, worst first; states `pending`, `exhausted`, `stalled`, `witness`, `unscored`; `tries_left`). `import_diff(slide, region?)` renders Oku now and rescores (Task 7). After the review (user decision, Task 12): a try is any scoring by a tool (diff or report) of a slide whose rendered RASTER changed; gain is a lower total excess of non-suspect regions above the threshold; only `pending` slides have tries (`[import] tune_iterations = 3`, `tune_stall = 2`); theme and layout-widget changes draw one try per new deck state on `[import] tune_global = 3`; `mean_before` is the imported deck's mean, `worse` the slides above their best.
4. **Deck-only packs and themes.** `PackScope { Library, Deck }` on `PackManifest` and `ThemeManifest` (not serialized when `library`, so existing hashes hold). Hi-fi pack and theme are `Deck`; the library refuses a `Deck` version; `set_widget` / `edit_theme` on them embed a version in one undo step and never write the library. Retrofit: a child pack of the target (copy, id from SHA-256 of the `.pptx` and the target version, `parent` = target version, "<pack> for <deck>"), library untouched (Task 5); after the review it is created at the first widget write, not at import (user decision, Task 15).
5. **`import_diff` output.** Two PNGs of the whole slide at 960 px plus JSON (score, state, 8 worst regions with source item, Oku elements or slide param, frame in page pt, score, shift, suspect); with `region`, both crops at 2× with a 16 px margin. `ImportPlan.targets` maps every hi-fi item to its elements or param; `ImportPlan.groups` lists source groups repeated on ≥ 3 slides (Task 7).
6. **What the agent may edit:** elements and params (`apply`), the import pack's widgets (`set_widget`), and in hi-fi the generated theme (`edit_theme`, user decision; no confirmation on a deck-only theme, Task 14). Any page change rescored at the next `import_report` (`mean_before`, `worse`); the instructions revert a change that raises the mean or worsens a slide. The turn is one undo group above the import's single step (Tasks 7–8).
7. **Start.** "Open" accepts `.pptx`; `ImportDialog` (mode, pack, theme, "Fine-tune with the agent" checked by default). `WorkspaceRequest::ImportTab { window, path, target, tune }` builds a new tab; with `tune`, `WorkspaceOutcome::Tune` makes the host send `AgentCommand::Tune` (Tasks 6, 8, 9).
8. **State in the tab's memory** (the imported deck itself is saved by autosave into the decks folder, like a new deck). `ImportState` (report, presentation, witness pages computed once per tab outside the session lock, tries) lives with the tab, never resumed; without it the tools answer a localized "no import in this tab" (Tasks 4, 6, 7).
9. **Witness in the app: office2pdf only** (`app_witness`, user decision 2026-10-16), no feature flag; LibreOffice (`--reference soffice`, t-885) stays a CLI witness, uncalibrated, and the app use is backlog.
10. **Instructions:** `crates/oku-slides-agent/src/instructions/import.md` (English, `include_str!`), sent hidden before the context on a `Tune` turn only; the thread shows `agent-tune-prompt` (Task 8).
11. **Tests:** MCP tools as a real server (live witness on `minimal`); `ui/e2e/220-import.cjs` imports alto through the dialog and plays the fake agent's `import_report`, `import_diff`, `report`, read back through `E2E_AGENT_LOG` (Task 10).

## Global Constraints

- Workspace: Rust 2024; `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`; no `unwrap`/`expect` outside tests, no silent fallback; `#[expect(..., reason = "...")]` rather than `#[allow]`; rustfmt width 120; `just check` passes.
- `oku-slides-import` stays free of any dependency on the session, the render and the CLI, and of I/O; `oku-slides-core` never depends on `oku-slides-import`.
- All Typst work and the witness run in bounded render workers; the session never creates a `Renderer` directly.
- Never hold a `std::sync::Mutex` guard across an await; MCP tools lock the session for one call only; the witness runs outside the session lock.
- Messages: every user-facing string through Fluent; new keys in the 20 locales (`ar bn de en es fr hi it ja ko nl pl pt ru th tr uk vi zh-Hans zh-Hant`), same variables and key order everywhere; MCP tool errors through `Tools::fail_with`.
- Files ≤ 500 lines target, never > 1000; tests side by side (`#[cfg(test)] #[path = "foo_tests.rs"] mod foo_tests;`); names `<unit>_<scenario>_<result>`; every pub item documented, first sentence under 15 words.
- Cargo: `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Users/matthieu/Projects/slider/target` (shared target, user decision) with `find crates src-tauri -path "*/src/*.rs" -exec touch {} + && touch crates/oku-slides-i18n/src/locales/*/*.ftl` in the same command as every build or test; a failure in a test the task does not touch is a stale artifact until a fresh run proves otherwise.
- Every run of the CLI or the app that writes data: `OKU_SLIDES_PATHS__DATA` and `OKU_SLIDES_PATHS__DECKS` set to a fresh temporary dir (`just e2e` does it).
- Commits: conventional, in French, `type(scope) : description (t-692)`; message in a file, `git commit -F <file>` alone; `git add` in its own command; no attribution line.

The draft commits stay on branch **`692-draft/import-pptx-lot5-r2`** until this plan is merged (its worktree is removed; the commits stay reachable from any worktree of the repository). Base: `3213b0d0`. Task → commit: Task 1 `5673cc45`, Task 2 `0cc4a3f4`, Task 3 `19be64e0`, Task 4 `534d633e`, Task 5 `abd79f23`, Task 6 `e637348e`, Task 7 `b3ecb60a`, Task 8 `65061826`, Task 9 `6665e0c6`, Task 10 `31110faa`, Task 11 `baa4ba34`, Task 12 `cd480285`, Task 13 `8ae36f79`, Task 14 `7f1c33bf`, Task 15 `32920b7c`, Task 16 `4eaac267`, Task 17 `339812c1`. (The first draft, on `861d4304`, is branch `692-draft/import-pptx-lot5`; it is superseded and kept only for reference.) Extraction commands run **in the implementer's worktree**, never with `git -C` on the draft: an implementer may extract a task's files from its commit with `git checkout <c> -- <file> …` — only the commit's own files (`git diff --no-renames --name-only <c>~1 <c>`), never a directory; `git diff --cached --name-only` must then equal that list. A file changed on `main` since `3213b0d0`, or by a review fix of an earlier task, is applied with `git show <c> -- <file> | git apply --3way`. A file the commit deletes is deleted with `git rm`.

## Plan review

Opus reviewed the plan by using the draft in the real app (web mode, isolated data): alto imported through the dialog in hi-fi with the fake agent and with the real `claude` agent (claude-agent-acp 0.81.2), `libreoffice.pptx` in retrofit with both, and the error cases; two read-only sub-reviews read the Rust code and the UI. The 15-agent review team (8 language-agnostic reviewers, 4 Rust and 3 TypeScript lenses) read the plan and the draft. No critical finding. What the real agent did on alto: it worked only on s7 and s6 (the real gaps), fixed s6/5 (9.38 → 2.81) and the s7 callout s7/21 (12.81 → 3.94), touched no suspect region, title or witness slide, ended with one `report`; s7 stalled because its worst region s7/20 (a 3 px shift) did not move. In retrofit it wrote one widget and replaced the fallback without asking. Findings became Tasks 12–17, appended without rewriting Tasks 1–11; each diff applies on the state the previous task left.

- **Major, from the real use** → Task 12: the page fingerprint was Typst's page hash, which changes on the next slide when one slide is edited (a try charged for nothing); progress was measured on the worst region alone (a real fix of another region counted as no gain and stalled s7); `import_report` and zooms scored for free, so the bound held only for an obedient agent; `mean_before`/`worse` missed regressions a diff had already seen. User decision (2026-10-17): the budget is held by the tools — tries counted on any scoring of a changed raster, gain on the total excess above the threshold, 0 tries for `done`/`witness`/`unscored`, a deck-wide budget `[import] tune_global` for theme and layout edits, one baseline for the import. → Task 14: `edit_theme` stopped the autonomous turn on a confirmation modal; on a deck-only theme it now asks nothing.
- **Major, from the team** → Task 13: concurrent tool calls ran the witness twice; the session API could run it under the session lock; slides deleted (or an undone import) stayed in the queue; one failing slide aborted the report; a too-wide zoom crop on frames past the page edge; `Raster::scaled` panicked on an empty raster. → Task 15: the app's import target accepted any directory as the retrofit pack, read without a size bound; a reader panic surfaced as a raw join error. → Task 14: `AgentCommand::Tune` could be sent by any view; `import.md` did not say slide content is untrusted. → Task 16: tab shortcuts fired behind the import dialog, losing a late error; the focus trap leaked; e2e 220 read a log filled by earlier specs.
- **Design, user decision** → Task 15: the retrofit deck keeps the target library pack (notice, Workshop) until its first widget write, which creates the deck-only child pack in the same undo step.
- **Minor, fixed** (Tasks 13–17): dead public API, silent fallbacks moved from the CLI, the imported deck's autosave documented (the "enregistré" header was true), retrofit `widget_requests` with a sample, `edit_templates` refusing a deck-only pack, empty pack list and per-mode note in the dialog, `api.ts`/`styles.css` split under the cap, `PackScope` serde tests, mode refusals, the Tune turn's undo group, `core/ARCHITECTURE.md` back to 50 lines, rules moved to the session's AGENTS.md, ADR-0009.
- **Deferred** (backlog, cited in the spec's known limits): t-901 "Fine-tune" box never disabled; t-902 editing a deck-only pack in templates mode; t-903 re-picking a deck-only theme; t-904 kitchen p. 2 at 8.7; t-905 LibreOffice witness in the app; t-906 a `.pptx` given by the OS; t-907 help decks; t-908 `[import] max_input_mib`; t-909 a varied calibration corpus; t-910 sandbox profile of the witness worker; t-911 `workspace.rs`/`App.tsx` size.

### Task 1: Suspect witness regions ranked last (t-884)

The office2pdf witness is known to get some items wrong, so a gap on those items says little about the Oku render. This task marks such regions `suspect` and keeps them from flagging a slide. A new `metrics/witness.rs` defines `Witness` (`Office2Pdf` or `Other`) and `WitnessLimit` (`Autofit`, `Tracking`, `Chart`, `SmartArt`), and `metrics::regions` reads the limit from the source item. `Autofit` covers `normAutofit` text with no recorded `fontScale` or `lnSpcReduction` that the witness shrinks itself (same conditions as its `single_line_fit_paragraph` and `wrapped_fit_paragraph`); a top-anchored bullet list is not shrunk and stays counted. `SmartArt` covers every child of a drawn SmartArt group (inherited from the group); an undrawn SmartArt stays counted. Under LibreOffice (`--reference soffice`), whose limits are not established, no region is suspect; the CLI maps the witness with `import_reference::limits_of`. `Region` and `RegionScore` carry `suspect`, written only when set. Deviation from the lot 5 decisions: this task changes no `score_threshold`; it only changes what counts toward it. `metrics::score` now returns every scored region, non-suspect first, then suspect, worst first within each group. The report writes only the first `REPORTED_REGIONS` through `serialize_with`, while the full list stays in memory for `import_diff`. `SlideScore::worst`, `SlideReport::is_above` and `ImportReport::above_threshold` read non-suspect regions only. `to_json` adds the localized `import-region-suspect` message to each written suspect region. The commit is the draft replayed onto main at `3213b0d0`; the replay onto t-863 (paragraph indents, ported from main) changed one test: with suspect regions ranked after the others, a bullet list of page 8 can stay among the written regions, so `import_hifi_of_alto_no_longer_designates_the_bullet_indents_on_page_8` now checks that none of the four lists scores above the report threshold instead of that none is listed. Later tasks use the in-memory ranked list and the `suspect` flag (the `witness` queue state of `import_report` and `import_diff`).

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `oku_slides_import::source::{Item, ItemKind, Autofit, Anchor, Bullet, Spacing, TextBox}` (`ItemKind::Group { items, smartart }`, `ItemKind::Chart`); `metrics::{Region, RegionScore, SlideScore, score, REPORTED_REGIONS}`; `oku_slides_reference::ReferenceWitness` (`Office2Pdf`, `Soffice { program, timeout_ms }`); `Localize`/`Localizer::tr_with`.
- Produces:
  - `pub enum Witness { Office2Pdf, Other }` and `pub enum WitnessLimit { Autofit, Tracking, Chart, SmartArt }` (serde `snake_case`), re-exported from `oku_slides_import::metrics`.
  - `pub fn regions(slide: &SourceSlide, scale: f64, witness: Witness) -> Vec<Region>`; `Region { …, suspect: Option<WitnessLimit> }`.
  - `RegionScore { item, score, shift, suspect: Option<WitnessLimit> }`, `suspect` omitted from JSON when `None`.
  - `metrics::score(reference, oku, regions) -> Option<SlideScore>`: all scored regions, non-suspect first, worst first; `SlideScore.regions` serializes only the first `REPORTED_REGIONS`.
  - `SlideScore::worst() -> Option<f64>`: first region's score only if it is not suspect.
  - `impl Localize for WitnessLimit`; report JSON region key `message` on suspect regions.
  - Fluent key `import-region-suspect` with selector `$limit` (`autofit`, `tracking`, `chart`, default `smart_art`).
  - CLI: private `import_reference::limits_of(&ReferenceWitness) -> Witness`.

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-import/src/metrics/witness_tests.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,81 @@
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+
+use rstest::rstest;
+use speculoos::prelude::*;
+
+use super::*;
+use crate::source::{Chart, ChartKind, Fill, Geometry, Shape};
+use crate::test_support::{bullet, item, para, run, run_with, text_box};
+
+/// `normAutofit` nu : ni échelle ni réduction enregistrées.
+const UNSAVED: Autofit = Autofit::Shrink { font_scale: 1.0, line_reduction: 0.0 };
+
+/// Une boîte de texte aux paragraphes `paragraphs`, ajustée `autofit`, ancrée `anchor`.
+fn boxed(autofit: Autofit, anchor: Anchor, paragraphs: Vec<Paragraph>) -> TextBox {
+    TextBox { autofit, anchor, ..text_box(paragraphs) }
+}
+
+/// Une boîte d'un paragraphe d'un run de 18 pt, ajustée `autofit`, ancrée en haut.
+fn line(autofit: Autofit) -> ItemKind {
+    ItemKind::Text(boxed(autofit, Anchor::Top, vec![para(vec![run("x")])]))
+}
+
+/// Une forme rectangulaire portant `text`.
+fn shape_with(text: TextBox) -> ItemKind {
+    let geom = Geometry::Preset { name: "rect".into(), adj: BTreeMap::new() };
+    ItemKind::Shape(Box::new(Shape { geom, fill: Fill::None, stroke: None, text: Some(text), connection: None }))
+}
+
+fn chart() -> ItemKind {
+    let kind = ChartKind::Column;
+    ItemKind::Chart(Chart { kind, grouping: Default::default(), title: None, categories: vec![], series: vec![] })
+}
+
+fn tracked(spacing: f64) -> TextBox {
+    text_box(vec![para(vec![run("x"), run_with("y", |s| s.char_spacing = spacing)])])
+}
+
+fn two_paragraphs(anchor: Anchor) -> ItemKind {
+    ItemKind::Text(boxed(UNSAVED, anchor, vec![para(vec![run("a")]), para(vec![run("b")])]))
+}
+
+/// Un paragraphe aux runs de corps `sizes`, en boîte `normAutofit` nue.
+fn sized(sizes: &[f64]) -> ItemKind {
+    let runs = sizes.iter().map(|&s| run_with("x", |r| r.size = s)).collect();
+    ItemKind::Text(boxed(UNSAVED, Anchor::Top, vec![para(runs)]))
+}
+
+// Boîte de 40 pt (marges de 3,6 pt : 32,8 pt utiles) ; un run de 18 pt a une
+// ligne de 21,6 pt, deux lignes de 43,2 pt : la boîte est courte.
+#[rstest]
+#[case::plain_text(line(Autofit::None), 40.0, false, None)]
+#[case::resize(line(Autofit::Resize), 40.0, false, None)]
+#[case::unsaved_short_line(line(UNSAVED), 40.0, false, Some(WitnessLimit::Autofit))]
+#[case::unsaved_tall_box(line(UNSAVED), 60.0, false, None)]
+#[case::saved_scale(line(Autofit::Shrink { font_scale: 0.9, line_reduction: 0.0 }), 40.0, false, None)]
+#[case::saved_reduction(line(Autofit::Shrink { font_scale: 1.0, line_reduction: 0.1 }), 40.0, false, None)]
+#[case::two_paragraphs_on_top(two_paragraphs(Anchor::Top), 40.0, false, None)]
+#[case::two_paragraphs_in_the_middle(two_paragraphs(Anchor::Middle), 400.0, false, Some(WitnessLimit::Autofit))]
+#[case::bullet_line(
+    ItemKind::Text(boxed(UNSAVED, Anchor::Top, vec![bullet(0, vec![run("x")])])), 40.0, false, None
+)]
+#[case::line_break(
+    ItemKind::Text(boxed(UNSAVED, Anchor::Top, vec![para(vec![run("a"), run("\n"), run("b")])])), 40.0, false, None
+)]
+#[case::mixed_sizes_short(sized(&[18.0, 24.0]), 60.0, false, Some(WitnessLimit::Autofit))]
+#[case::mixed_sizes_tall(sized(&[18.0, 24.0]), 70.0, false, None)]
+#[case::tracked_text(ItemKind::Text(tracked(2.0)), 40.0, false, Some(WitnessLimit::Tracking))]
+#[case::condensed_text(ItemKind::Text(tracked(-1.0)), 40.0, false, Some(WitnessLimit::Tracking))]
+#[case::tracked_shape(shape_with(tracked(1.5)), 40.0, false, Some(WitnessLimit::Tracking))]
+#[case::untracked_shape(shape_with(tracked(0.0)), 40.0, false, None)]
+#[case::chart(chart(), 40.0, false, Some(WitnessLimit::Chart))]
+#[case::smartart_child(line(Autofit::None), 40.0, true, Some(WitnessLimit::SmartArt))]
+fn witness_limit_reads_the_source_item(
+    #[case] kind: ItemKind,
+    #[case] height: f64,
+    #[case] in_smartart: bool,
+    #[case] expected: Option<WitnessLimit>,
+) {
+    let it = item("s1/1", (0.0, 0.0, 300.0, height), kind);
+    assert_that!(witness_limit(&it, in_smartart)).is_equal_to(expected);
+}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

The import crate: the witness module holds the limit rules; `metrics.rs` carries `suspect`, ranks all regions and filters `worst`; the report reads only non-suspect regions and adds the localized message to written suspect regions.

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-import/src/metrics/witness.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,120 @@
+//! Les limites connues du témoin (office2pdf 0.8.1), lues sur l'item source
+//! d'une région : là, son écart au rendu Oku est surtout celui du témoin.
+//!
+//! L'ajustement reprend les deux cas où office2pdf rétrécit lui-même un texte
+//! `normAutofit` dont PowerPoint n'a enregistré ni `fontScale` ni
+//! `lnSpcReduction` (`single_line_fit_paragraph`, `wrapped_fit_paragraph` de
+//! son `render/typst_gen.rs`, Apache-2.0) ; PowerPoint, lui, le garde à 100 %.
+//! Une liste à puces ou un texte de plusieurs paragraphes ancré en haut n'est
+//! pas ajusté : son écart reste celui d'Oku.
+
+use serde::Serialize;
+
+use crate::source::{Anchor, Autofit, Bullet, Item, ItemKind, Paragraph, Spacing, TextBox};
+
+/// Taille de police d'un run sans taille chez le témoin, et plancher du plus grand corps.
+const WITNESS_DEFAULT_SIZE: f64 = 12.0;
+
+/// Le témoin de la référence : seules les limites d'office2pdf sont établies.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum Witness {
+    /// office2pdf : ses régions [`WitnessLimit`] sont suspectes.
+    Office2Pdf,
+    /// Un autre témoin (LibreOffice) : aucune région n'est suspecte.
+    Other,
+}
+
+/// Pourquoi le témoin dessine faux l'item d'une région (limite connue).
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize)]
+#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
+pub enum WitnessLimit {
+    /// Texte `normAutofit` sans échelle enregistrée, que le témoin rétrécit à
+    /// sa boîte ; PowerPoint le garde à 100 %.
+    Autofit,
+    /// Texte interlettré : le témoin le dessine plus large de 2 à 5 px.
+    Tracking,
+    /// Graphique : le témoin le dessine à peu près.
+    Chart,
+    /// Item d'un SmartArt dessiné : le témoin en rend le texte trop petit.
+    SmartArt,
+}
+
+impl WitnessLimit {
+    /// Nom de la limite, argument `limit` du message `import-region-suspect`.
+    pub(crate) fn name(self) -> &'static str {
+        match self {
+            Self::Autofit => "autofit",
+            Self::Tracking => "tracking",
+            Self::Chart => "chart",
+            Self::SmartArt => "smart_art",
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// La limite du témoin sur `item`, enfant d'un SmartArt dessiné si `in_smartart`.
+pub(super) fn witness_limit(item: &Item, in_smartart: bool) -> Option<WitnessLimit> {
+    if in_smartart {
+        return Some(WitnessLimit::SmartArt);
+    }
+    if matches!(item.kind, ItemKind::Chart(_)) {
+        return Some(WitnessLimit::Chart);
+    }
+    let text = item.text()?;
+    if self_fitted(text, item.frame.h) {
+        return Some(WitnessLimit::Autofit);
+    }
+    let tracked = text.paragraphs.iter().flat_map(|p| &p.runs).any(|r| r.style.char_spacing != 0.0);
+    tracked.then_some(WitnessLimit::Tracking)
+}
+
+/// Le témoin rétrécit-il lui-même `text`, dans une boîte haute de `height` pt ?
+fn self_fitted(text: &TextBox, height: f64) -> bool {
+    // `normAutofit` nu : le lecteur le lit à 100 % et 0 %.
+    let Autofit::Shrink { font_scale, line_reduction } = text.autofit else { return false };
+    if font_scale < 1.0 || line_reduction > 0.0 {
+        return false;
+    }
+    // Un texte ancré au milieu ou en bas, à la ligne, est ramené à sa boîte.
+    if text.wrap && text.anchor != Anchor::Top {
+        return true;
+    }
+    // Un seul paragraphe sans puce ni saut de ligne, dans une boîte courte.
+    let [p] = text.paragraphs.as_slice() else { return false };
+    let breaks = p.runs.iter().any(|r| r.text.contains(['\n', '\r', '\u{b}']));
+    if p.runs.is_empty() || breaks || !matches!(p.style.bullet, Bullet::None) {
+        return false;
+    }
+    let inner = height - text.insets.t - text.insets.b;
+    let max = max_size(p);
+    if inner <= 0.0 {
+        return false;
+    }
+    if mixed_sizes(p) && inner <= max * 2.5 {
+        return true;
+    }
+    inner <= line_height(p, max) * 2.0
+}
+
+/// Le plus grand corps du paragraphe, au moins [`WITNESS_DEFAULT_SIZE`].
+fn max_size(p: &Paragraph) -> f64 {
+    p.runs.iter().map(|r| r.style.size).fold(WITNESS_DEFAULT_SIZE, f64::max)
+}
+
+/// Les runs du paragraphe ont-ils plusieurs corps (au centième de pt) ?
+fn mixed_sizes(p: &Paragraph) -> bool {
+    let key = |size: f64| (size * 100.0).round() as i64;
+    p.runs.windows(2).any(|w| key(w[0].style.size) != key(w[1].style.size))
+}
+
+/// La hauteur d'une ligne que le témoin estime, pour un corps `max`.
+fn line_height(p: &Paragraph, max: f64) -> f64 {
+    let default = max * 1.2;
+    match p.style.line_spacing {
+        Spacing::Points(points) => default.max(points),
+        Spacing::Percent(factor) => default.max(max * factor),
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+#[path = "witness_tests.rs"]
+mod witness_tests;
```

Docs and rules: the new rule in the import crate's AGENTS.md, the ARCHITECTURE.md lines.

```diff
--- a/crates/oku-slides-import/AGENTS.md
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-import/AGENTS.md
@@ -23,13 +23,13 @@ Read `ARCHITECTURE.md` first for what this code is. This file is how to work on
 - Clamp numeric text and fill values to their OOXML schema range and custGeom values to MAX_PATH_SPAN, listed with dropped color modifiers in bounds::clamped to warn Approximated; parse a shared theme once. (t-755, t-892, t-757)
 - Type every asset with media::sniff, refuse a raster whose header is unreadable or above max_image_pixels, and pass every SVG through svg::sanitize (literal internal entities only). (t-752, t-892, t-730)
 - Apply or write only a CheckedPlan, which only ImportPlan::check_budget returns. (t-753, t-892)
+- Mark regions suspect only under the office2pdf witness, rank them after the others and never let one flag a slide. (t-692)
 
 ## Pitfalls
```

### Task 2: Recalibrate the worst-region threshold on alto, suspect regions set aside (t-884)

This task is a calibration and test commit, with no logic change: Task 1 already marks the regions that office2pdf is known to draw wrong as `suspect` (normAutofit without fontScale, letter-spaced text, chart, SmartArt), ranks them last and keeps them from flagging a slide. With those regions set aside, `[import] score_threshold` goes from 10 to 7: the faithful slides score at most 3.4 on alto and 5.8 on the other fixtures, and alto's real gaps score 9.38 (p. 6 intro line) to 15.71 (p. 7 callout), so 7 lies between 5.8 and 8.7. The measurement was redone on main (`9914a1f2`, which carries the replayed commits t-863 paragraph indents, t-895, t-816, t-757, t-721 and t-727, office2pdf 0.8.1, σ = 2, fonts from `assets/fonts`, `--no-system-fonts`); the commit message carries the full per-page table. The replay onto main changed one result: since t-863 the alto p. 8 bullets sit at their PowerPoint indent (worst list 1.24, 8.72 before), so p. 8 is no longer a gap and is not flagged; alto is flagged on pp. 6 and 7 only, and the p. 6 intro line, cut elsewhere than in PowerPoint's PDF, is a real gap. Deviation from the lot 5 decision 2: LibreOffice (`--reference soffice`, t-885) is not calibrated, the same threshold applies with no suspect region (the app's fine-tuning goes only through office2pdf), and the `config.default.toml` comment says so instead of deferring the recalibration to t-884. The CLI tests (live witness) now assert that alto is flagged on pp. 6 and 7 only, keep the p. 7 callout designation and the t-863 test that no p. 8 list is above the threshold, and check that the libreoffice SmartArt on p. 3 is suspect, ranked last, without flagging the slide; the mean-gap bounds are unchanged (measure + 25 %). The `reference` crate's `ARCHITECTURE.md` Calibration section is tightened to stay within 50 lines (introduction, isolation, extension and dependencies), and the spec and README are updated. Later tasks (the shared session pipeline and the `import_report` queue's `witness` state) rely on this threshold value.

```diff
+time and memory (not in filesystem), a worker of its own, 20 slides at a time. office2pdf writes an
```

### Task 3: Import pipeline moves into the session

The PowerPoint import orchestration leaves `oku-slides-cli` and becomes `oku_slides_session::import`, so the CLI and the app (Tasks 4 onward) share one implementation (lot 5 decision 1). The module reads the `.pptx` with the size checked before any read and the parse on a thread of known stack (`Input`), projects it onto a target (`ImportTarget::Retrofit` on a pack by id, folder or name and a theme, or `ImportTarget::Hifi` with generated, embedded pack and theme and an identity derived from the SHA-256 of the file), probes the deck's pack through the render worker (`ProbedWidgets`, `sources_with_pack`, with the bounded probe relaunch and `probe_failed`), and applies the verified `CheckedPlan` as one history step, then validates it. Nothing is written: the caller renders and saves. Errors are an opaque, localized `ImportError` with an `ImportErrorKind`. The moved code keeps its behavior: the hifi preparation, `system_fonts`, `read_pack_dir`, `resolve_pack`, `embed_theme` and their tests come from the CLI files by move, and `PackLibrary::user` and `ThemeLibrary::user` replace the CLI's `pack_library` and `theme_library`. The CLI keeps its options, the rendering, the file writing, the reference witness (`office2pdf` or `soffice`), the atomic `--report` write, `deck_pack_version` and the output, and calls `oku_slides_session::import::import`. The `cli-import-*` Fluent keys that the session now owns are renamed `session-import-*` in the 20 locales, and the import rules (size, single transaction, single implementation, unreadable target theme) move from the CLI `AGENTS.md` to `crates/AGENTS.md`. Deviation from the lot 5 brief: the module also exports the helpers the CLI's other commands use (`resolve_pack`, `embed_theme`, `read_pack_dir`, `sources_with_pack`, `ProbedWidgets`), and the witness, overflow and `ImportState` parts are not here yet; Task 4 adds them to the session. This commit is replayed onto main (`3213b0d0`), so the code it moves already carries the main fixes of the CLI import (t-816, t-817: an unreadable target theme is an error, the `--report` write is atomic); the bounded probe relaunch and the size-before-read check are kept as they were.

```diff
-/// Rejoue `left` (fichiers non sondés après chaque appel) ; rend le résultat et le nombre d'appels.
-fn rounds(left: &[usize]) -> (Result<usize, &'static str>, usize) {
-    let mut calls = 0;

-        || {
-            calls += 1;
```

```diff
+use rstest::rstest;
+use speculoos::prelude::*;
+
+use super::*;
+
+fn fr() -> Localizer {
+    Localizer::new(Some("fr"))
+}
+
+#[rstest]
+#[case(ProbeMismatchSnafu { widget: "l1" }.build(), ImportErrorKind::Probe, "le pack généré ne se sonde pas comme il est déclaré (widget l1)")]
+#[case(ProbeLimitSnafu { widget: "l2" }.build(), ImportErrorKind::Probe, "le pack généré dépasse les bornes de la sonde (widget l2)")]
+#[case(UnknownPackSnafu { pack: "Nope" }.build(), ImportErrorKind::UnknownPack, "pack inconnu : Nope")]
+#[case(BadPackSnafu { pack: "x" }.build(), ImportErrorKind::BadPack, "pack illisible x")]
+#[case(ThresholdSnafu { value: -1.0 }.build(), ImportErrorKind::Threshold, "pas -1")]
+#[case(TooLargeSnafu.build(), ImportErrorKind::TooLarge, "")]
+#[case(BadThemeSnafu.build(), ImportErrorKind::BadTheme, "thème cible illisible")]
+#[case(PackMissingSnafu.build(), ImportErrorKind::Generated, "aucun pack")]
+#[case(ThemeMissingSnafu.build(), ImportErrorKind::Generated, "aucun thème")]
+#[case(ProbeFailedSnafu { error: "lien rompu" }.build(), ImportErrorKind::Probe, "processus de rendu : lien rompu")]
+fn import_error_has_its_kind_and_a_french_message(
+    #[case] inner: ImportInner,
+    #[case] kind: ImportErrorKind,
+    #[case] message: &str,
+) {
+    let e = ImportError::from(inner);
+    assert_that!(e.kind()).is_equal_to(kind);
+    let localized = e.localize(&fr());
+    assert_that!(localized.as_str()).contains(message);
+    assert_that!(localized.as_str()).does_not_contain("session-import");
+}
```

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/hifi_tests.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,93 @@
+use serde_json::json;
+use speculoos::prelude::*;
+
+use super::*;
+
+/// Un widget de slide `name` au paramètre texte `param`.
+fn schema(name: &str, param: &str) -> WidgetSchema {
+    serde_json::from_value(json!({ "name": name, "category": "slide", "params": [{ "name": param, "type": "plain" }] }))
+        .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("schéma : {e}"))
+}
+
+fn registry(schemas: &[WidgetSchema]) -> WidgetRegistry {
+    WidgetRegistry::from_probe(json!({ "base": schemas })).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("registre : {e}"))
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn identity_of_the_same_bytes_is_the_same_pair_of_v8_uuids() {
+    let (pack, theme) = identity(b"pptx");
+    assert_that!(identity(b"pptx")).is_equal_to((pack, theme));
+    assert_that!(pack).is_not_equal_to(theme);
+    assert_that!((pack.get_version_num(), theme.get_version_num())).is_equal_to((8, 8));
+    assert_that!(identity(b"autre pptx").0).is_not_equal_to(pack);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn check_probe_of_the_declared_schemas_passes() {
+    let declared = [schema("l1-titre", "titre"), schema("l2-corps", "corps")];
+    let probed = registry(&[declared[0].clone(), declared[1].clone(), schema("text", "body")]);
+    assert_that!(check_probe(&probed, &declared, &[])).is_ok();
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn check_probe_names_a_missing_widget() {
+    let declared = [schema("l1-titre", "titre"), schema("l2-corps", "corps")];
+    let probed = registry(&[declared[0].clone()]);
+    assert_that!(check_probe(&probed, &declared, &[])).is_err_containing("l2-corps".to_owned());
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn check_probe_names_a_widget_probed_differently() {
+    let declared = [schema("l1-titre", "titre")];
+    let probed = registry(&[schema("l1-titre", "title")]);
+    assert_that!(check_probe(&probed, &declared, &[])).is_err_containing("l1-titre".to_owned());
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn check_probe_names_a_pack_file_without_declared_schema() {
+    let declared = [schema("l1-titre", "titre")];
+    let probed = registry(&[declared[0].clone(), schema("l2-corps", "corps")]);
+    let files: Vec<WidgetFile> = ["l1-titre", "l2-corps"].iter().map(|n| WidgetFile::parse(n).unwrap()).collect();
+    assert_that!(check_probe(&probed, &declared, &files)).is_err_containing("l2-corps".to_owned());
+    let declared_only = [WidgetFile::common(), files[0].clone()];
+    assert_that!(check_probe(&probed, &declared, &declared_only)).is_ok();
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn pack_limits_of_the_default_config_are_those_of_the_projector() {
+    let settings = oku_slides_platform::config::Settings::defaults().unwrap();
+    assert_that!(pack_limits(&settings.render)).is_equal_to(PackLimits::default());
+}
+
+/// Un pack de `_commun` et des widgets `names`, chaque fichier de `len` octets.
+fn sizes(names: &[&str], len: usize) -> BTreeMap<WidgetFile, usize> {
+    let names = names.iter().map(|n| WidgetFile::parse(n).unwrap()).chain([WidgetFile::common()]);
+    names.map(|n| (n, len)).collect()
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn beyond_limits_names_a_file_past_the_loaded_count() {
+    let limits = PackLimits { max_files: 2, max_file_bytes: 100 };
+    let pack = sizes(&["l1-a", "l2-b"], 10);
+    // `_commun` et `l1-a` sont chargés, `l2-b` est le troisième fichier.
+    assert_that!(beyond_limits("l1-a", &pack, &BTreeSet::new(), limits)).is_false();
+    assert_that!(beyond_limits("l2-b", &pack, &BTreeSet::new(), limits)).is_true();
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn beyond_limits_names_a_too_large_file_or_common() {
+    let limits = PackLimits { max_files: 64, max_file_bytes: 100 };
+    let mut pack = sizes(&["l1-a", "l2-b"], 10);
+    pack.insert(WidgetFile::parse("l2-b").unwrap(), 101);
+    assert_that!(beyond_limits("l1-a", &pack, &BTreeSet::new(), limits)).is_false();
+    assert_that!(beyond_limits("l2-b", &pack, &BTreeSet::new(), limits)).is_true();
+    pack.insert(WidgetFile::common(), 101);
+    assert_that!(beyond_limits("l1-a", &pack, &BTreeSet::new(), limits)).is_true();
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn beyond_limits_names_an_unprobed_file() {
+    let pack = sizes(&["l1-a"], 10);
+    let unprobed = BTreeSet::from([WidgetFile::parse("l1-a").unwrap()]);
+    assert_that!(beyond_limits("l1-a", &pack, &unprobed, PackLimits::default())).is_true();
+}
```

```diff
+use oku_slides_core::PackManifest;
+use oku_slides_i18n::Localize;
+use speculoos::prelude::*;
+
+use super::*;
+use crate::import::ImportErrorKind;
+use crate::{DEFAULT_PACK, GRID_PACK, PRO_THEME};
+
+/// L'interface en français : les erreurs se testent hors de l'anglais.
+fn fr() -> &'static oku_slides_i18n::Localizer {
+    static FR: std::sync::LazyLock<oku_slides_i18n::Localizer> =
+        std::sync::LazyLock::new(|| oku_slides_i18n::Localizer::new(Some("fr")));
+    &FR
+}
+
+/// Une bibliothèque de packs vide dans un dossier temporaire (les intégrés seulement).
+fn library(dir: &Path) -> (Storage, PackLibrary) {
+    let storage = Storage::local().unwrap();
+    let library = PackLibrary::new(Some(dir.join("templates")), storage.clone());
+    (storage, library)
+}
+
+fn pack_id(files: &PackFiles) -> uuid::Uuid {
+    PackManifest::from_files(files).unwrap().id
+}
+
+/// Écrit dans `dir` le `pack.json` du pack intégré Grilles et un widget `citation`.
+fn write_pack_dir(dir: &Path) {
+    let json = include_str!("../../../../templates/grilles/pack.json");
+    std::fs::create_dir_all(dir.join("widgets")).unwrap();
+    std::fs::write(dir.join("pack.json"), json).unwrap();
+    std::fs::write(dir.join("widgets").join("citation.typ"), "// widget").unwrap();
+}
+
+/// Des sources vides, sur le registre de base figé.
+fn empty_bundle() -> SourceBundle {
+    SourceBundle::new(oku_slides_core::Deck::empty(), crate::test_support::registry()).unwrap()
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn read_pack_dir_reads_the_manifest_and_the_widget_files() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    write_pack_dir(tmp.path());
+    let (storage, _) = library(tmp.path());
+    let files = read_pack_dir(&storage, tmp.path()).unwrap();
+    let names: Vec<String> = files.widgets().keys().map(|w| w.file_name()).collect();
+    assert_that!((pack_id(&files), names)).is_equal_to((GRID_PACK, vec!["citation.typ".to_owned()]));
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn read_pack_dir_without_pack_json_is_none() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let (storage, _) = library(tmp.path());
+    assert_that!(read_pack_dir(&storage, tmp.path())).is_none();
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn resolve_pack_by_name_ignores_case() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let (storage, library) = library(tmp.path());
+    let files = resolve_pack(&storage, &library, "essentiel").unwrap();
+    assert_that!(pack_id(&files)).is_equal_to(DEFAULT_PACK);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn resolve_pack_by_id_takes_the_current_version() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let (storage, library) = library(tmp.path());
+    let files = resolve_pack(&storage, &library, &GRID_PACK.to_string()).unwrap();
+    assert_that!(files.version()).is_equal_to(library.current_version(GRID_PACK).unwrap().version);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn resolve_pack_by_folder_reads_it() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let dir = tmp.path().join("mon-pack");
+    write_pack_dir(&dir);
+    let (storage, library) = library(tmp.path());
+    let files = resolve_pack(&storage, &library, dir.to_str().unwrap()).unwrap();
+    assert_that!(files.widgets().len()).is_equal_to(1);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn resolve_pack_unknown_fails_with_a_localized_message() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let (storage, library) = library(tmp.path());
+    let err = resolve_pack(&storage, &library, "Nope").unwrap_err();
+    assert_that!(err.kind()).is_equal_to(ImportErrorKind::UnknownPack);
+    assert_that!(err.localize(fr())).is_equal_to("pack inconnu : Nope".to_owned());
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn resolve_pack_unknown_id_fails_too() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let (storage, library) = library(tmp.path());
+    let id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000";
+    assert_that!(resolve_pack(&storage, &library, id)).is_err();
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn embed_theme_by_name_or_id_embeds_the_same_version() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let themes = ThemeLibrary::new(Some(tmp.path().join("themes")), Storage::local().unwrap());
+    let mut bundle = empty_bundle();
+    let by_name = embed_theme(&themes, "PRO", &mut bundle).unwrap();
+    let by_id = embed_theme(&themes, &PRO_THEME.to_string(), &mut bundle).unwrap();
+    assert_that!(by_name).is_equal_to(by_id.clone());
+    assert_that!(by_id.id).is_equal_to(PRO_THEME);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn embed_theme_unknown_fails_with_a_localized_message() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let themes = ThemeLibrary::new(Some(tmp.path().join("themes")), Storage::local().unwrap());
+    let mut bundle = empty_bundle();
+    let err = embed_theme(&themes, "Nope", &mut bundle).unwrap_err();
+    assert_that!(err.kind()).is_equal_to(ImportErrorKind::UnknownTheme);
+    assert_that!(err.localize(fr())).is_equal_to("Thème inconnu : Nope".to_owned());
+}
```

```diff
+use oku_slides_core::PackManifest;
+use speculoos::prelude::*;
+
+use super::*;
+use crate::test_support::{fresh_dir, pptx_fixture, settings_on};
+use crate::{DEFAULT_PACK, PRO_THEME, PackLibrary, Settings};
+
+/// La plateforme de test sur `data`, en français.
+fn platform(settings: Settings) -> Platform {
+    Platform::with_settings(settings).unwrap()
+}
+
+/// Importe la fixture `minimal` vers `target`, avec les réglages de test sur `data`.
+fn import_minimal(data: &std::path::Path, target: ImportTarget) -> Result<Imported> {
+    let request = ImportRequest { pptx: pptx_fixture(data, "minimal"), target, system_fonts: false };
+    import(&platform(settings_on(data)), &Fonts::default(), &request)
+}
+
+fn retrofit(pack: &str, theme: Option<&str>) -> ImportTarget {
+    ImportTarget::Retrofit { pack: pack.to_owned(), theme: theme.map(str::to_owned) }
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_retrofit_is_one_history_step_on_the_target_pack_and_theme() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-retrofit-");
+    let mut imported = import_minimal(data.path(), retrofit("Essentiel", Some("Pro"))).unwrap();
+    let deck = imported.sources.deck();
+    assert_that!(deck.slides.len()).is_equal_to(3);
+    assert_that!(deck.templates.as_ref().map(|r| r.id)).is_equal_to(Some(DEFAULT_PACK));
+    assert_that!(deck.theme.as_ref().map(|r| r.id)).is_equal_to(Some(PRO_THEME));
+    assert_that!(imported.issues).is_empty();
+    assert_that!(imported.mode).is_equal_to(ImportMode::Retrofit);
+    assert_that!(imported.sources.undo_steps()).is_equal_to(1);
+    assert_that!(imported.sources.undo().unwrap()).is_true();
+    assert_that!(imported.sources.deck().slides).is_empty();
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_retrofit_embeds_the_target_pack_and_theme_versions() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-retrofit-embed-");
+    let imported = import_minimal(data.path(), retrofit("Essentiel", Some("Pro"))).unwrap();
+    let (deck, sources) = (imported.sources.deck(), &imported.sources);
+    let pack = deck.templates.as_ref().unwrap();
+    let theme = deck.theme.as_ref().unwrap();
+    assert_that!(sources.packs.contains_key(&pack.version)).is_true();
+    assert_that!(sources.themes.contains_key(&theme.version)).is_true();
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_hifi_is_one_history_step_on_its_generated_pack_and_theme() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-hifi-");
+    let mut imported = import_minimal(data.path(), ImportTarget::Hifi).unwrap();
+    let (pack_id, theme_id) = hifi::identity(&imported.input.bytes);
+    let deck = imported.sources.deck();
+    let pack = deck.templates.clone().unwrap();
+    let theme = deck.theme.clone().unwrap();
+    assert_that!((pack.id, theme.id)).is_equal_to((pack_id, theme_id));
+    let manifest = PackManifest::from_files(&imported.sources.packs[&pack.version]).unwrap();
+    assert_that!(manifest.name).is_equal_to("minimal".to_owned());
+    assert_that!(imported.sources.themes.contains_key(&theme.version)).is_true();
+    assert_that!(imported.issues).is_empty();
+    assert_that!(imported.sources.undo_steps()).is_equal_to(1);
+    assert_that!(imported.sources.undo().unwrap()).is_true();
+    assert_that!(imported.sources.deck().slides).is_empty();
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_hifi_leaves_the_pack_library_untouched() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-hifi-library-");
+    let imported = import_minimal(data.path(), ImportTarget::Hifi).unwrap();
+    let library = PackLibrary::user(&platform(settings_on(data.path())));
+    let id = imported.sources.deck().templates.as_ref().unwrap().id;
+    assert_that!(library.current_version(id)).is_none();
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_hifi_with_a_negative_threshold_is_refused_before_reading() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-threshold-");
+    let mut settings = settings_on(data.path());
+    settings.import.score_threshold = -1.0;
+    let request =
+        ImportRequest { pptx: data.path().join("absent.pptx"), target: ImportTarget::Hifi, system_fonts: false };
+    let err = import(&platform(settings), &Fonts::default(), &request).unwrap_err();
+    assert_that!(err.kind()).is_equal_to(ImportErrorKind::Threshold);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_of_a_missing_file_is_a_file_error() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-missing-");
+    let request = ImportRequest {
+        pptx: data.path().join("absent.pptx"),
+        target: retrofit("Essentiel", None),
+        system_fonts: false,
+    };
+    let err = import(&platform(settings_on(data.path())), &Fonts::default(), &request).unwrap_err();
+    assert_that!(err.kind()).is_equal_to(ImportErrorKind::File);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_on_an_unknown_pack_is_refused() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-unknown-pack-");
+    let err = import_minimal(data.path(), retrofit("Nope", None)).unwrap_err();
+    assert_that!(err.kind()).is_equal_to(ImportErrorKind::UnknownPack);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_mode_serializes_in_snake_case() {
+    assert_that!(serde_json::to_string(&ImportMode::Hifi).unwrap()).is_equal_to("\"hifi\"".to_owned());
+    assert_that!(ImportTarget::Hifi.mode()).is_equal_to(ImportMode::Hifi);
+}
```

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/widgets_tests.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,71 @@
+use speculoos::prelude::*;
+
+use super::*;
+
+/// Rejoue `left` (fichiers non sondés après chaque appel) ; rend le résultat et le nombre d'appels.
+fn rounds(left: &[usize]) -> (Result<usize, &'static str>, usize) {
+    let mut calls = 0;
+    let out = probe_rounds(
+        || {
+            calls += 1;
+            Ok(left[(calls - 1).min(left.len() - 1)])
+        },
+        |n| *n,
+        || false,
+    );
+    (out, calls)
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn probe_rounds_stops_once_every_file_is_probed() {
+    let (out, calls) = rounds(&[3, 1, 0, 0]);
+    assert_that!(out).is_equal_to(Ok(0));
+    assert_that!(calls).is_equal_to(3);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn probe_rounds_stops_when_a_round_probes_nothing() {
+    // Processus de rendu indisponible : le deuxième appel ne sonde rien, on s'arrête.
+    let (out, calls) = rounds(&[5, 5, 5]);
+    assert_that!(out).is_equal_to(Ok(5));
+    assert_that!(calls).is_equal_to(2);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn probe_rounds_makes_at_most_the_bounded_number_of_calls() {
+    let left: Vec<usize> = (0..20).rev().collect();
+    let (out, calls) = rounds(&left[..19]);
+    assert_that!(calls).is_equal_to(PROBE_ROUNDS);
+    assert_that!(out).is_equal_to(Ok(19 - PROBE_ROUNDS + 1));
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn probe_rounds_stops_at_the_first_error() {
+    let mut calls = 0;
+    let out: Result<usize, &str> = probe_rounds(
+        || {
+            calls += 1;
+            if calls == 1 { Ok(4) } else { Err("lien rompu") }
+        },
+        |n| *n,
+        || false,
+    );
+    assert_that!(out).is_equal_to(Err("lien rompu"));
+    assert_that!(calls).is_equal_to(2);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn probe_rounds_stops_once_the_total_time_is_spent() {
+    // Chaque appel épuise son budget : le temps total est écoulé après le troisième.
+    let calls = std::cell::Cell::new(0);
+    let out: Result<usize, &str> = probe_rounds(
+        || {
+            calls.set(calls.get() + 1);
+            Ok(10 - calls.get())
+        },
+        |n| *n,
+        || calls.get() >= PROBE_BUDGETS as usize,
+    );
+    assert_that!(calls.get()).is_equal_to(PROBE_BUDGETS as usize);
+    assert_that!(out).is_equal_to(Ok(10 - PROBE_BUDGETS as usize));
+}
```

Move the code, then adapt it. `git mv` the CLI files so the history follows: `import_hifi.rs` to `import/hifi.rs`, `system_fonts.rs` to `import/system_fonts.rs`, `pack_render.rs`'s `DeckWidgets` to `import/widgets.rs` as `ProbedWidgets` (the probe takes the platform and its localizer, no `l` argument), the pack and theme resolution of the CLI `library.rs` to `import/library.rs`. Errors become `ImportError` (Snafu, backtrace in every variant, opaque, localized by `session-import-*` keys). `mod.rs` holds `import`: the threshold is checked before any read in hi-fi, the pptx is read by `input::read_input`, the base registry comes from `oku_slides_render::base_registry`, the plan's assets are added to the bundle, and `apply_all` plus `bundle.apply` make the one history step labelled `session-import-label`. Then the CLI is rewired to these items.

Session code, in order: manifests and library constructors, the module and its parts, then the shared test helper.

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/error.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,151 @@
+//! Erreurs de l'import d'une présentation : lecture, cible, sonde du pack,
+//! application du plan. Messages localisés (`session-import-*`).
+
+use std::path::PathBuf;
+
+use oku_slides_i18n::{Localize, Localizer};
+use oku_slides_platform::storage::StorageError;
+use snafu::{Backtrace, Snafu};
+
+/// Un import qui n'a pas abouti ; rien n'a été écrit.
+#[derive(Debug, Snafu)]
+pub struct ImportError(Box<ImportInner>);
+
+/// Nature d'une [`ImportError`].
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
+#[non_exhaustive]
+pub enum ImportErrorKind {
+    /// Le `.pptx` ne se lit pas.
+    File,
+    /// Le `.pptx` dépasse la taille d'entrée (`max_input_bytes`).
+    TooLarge,
+    /// La présentation est refusée par le lecteur, ou le plan dépasse son budget.
+    Presentation,
+    /// `[import] score_threshold` n'est pas un nombre fini positif.
+    Threshold,
+    /// Pack cible introuvable.
+    UnknownPack,
+    /// Pack cible dont le `pack.json` ne décrit pas un pack de modèles.
+    BadPack,
+    /// Thème cible introuvable.
+    UnknownTheme,
+    /// Thème cible dont les jetons ne se lisent pas.
+    BadTheme,
+    /// Le projecteur n'a produit aucun pack ou aucun thème pour le deck : un bogue.
+    Generated,
+    /// Le pack généré se sonde autrement que déclaré, hors des bornes, ou sa sonde échoue.
+    Probe,
+    /// Pack ou thème par défaut impossible à adopter.
+    Library,
+    /// Widgets de base illisibles.
+    Render,
+    /// Le plan n'a pas pu s'appliquer aux sources.
+    Apply,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Snafu)]
+#[snafu(visibility(pub(crate)))]
+pub(crate) enum ImportInner {
+    #[snafu(display("cannot read {}", path.display()))]
+    Read { path: PathBuf, source: StorageError, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("cannot start the thread reading {}", path.display()))]
+    ReadThread { path: PathBuf, source: std::io::Error, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("presentation too large"))]
+    TooLarge { backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("presentation refused"))]
+    Presentation { source: oku_slides_import::ImportError, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("invalid score_threshold: {value}"))]
+    Threshold { value: f64, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("unknown pack: {pack}"))]
+    UnknownPack { pack: String, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("unreadable pack: {pack}"))]
+    BadPack { pack: String, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("unknown theme: {theme}"))]
+    UnknownTheme { theme: String, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("unreadable target theme tokens"))]
+    BadTheme { backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("the importer produced no pack"))]
+    PackMissing { backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("the importer produced no theme"))]
+    ThemeMissing { backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("generated pack probed differently: {widget}"))]
+    ProbeMismatch { widget: String, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("generated pack beyond the probe limits: {widget}"))]
+    ProbeLimit { widget: String, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("generated pack probe failed: {error}"))]
+    ProbeFailed { error: String, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("default pack or theme unavailable"))]
+    Library { source: crate::SessionError, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("widgets unavailable"))]
+    Registry { source: oku_slides_render::RegistryError, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("unreadable sources"))]
+    Sources { source: oku_slides_core::SourcesError, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("import plan refused"))]
+    Op { source: oku_slides_core::TransactionError, backtrace: Backtrace },
+}
+
+impl ImportError {
+    /// Nature de l'erreur, pour choisir quoi en dire.
+    pub fn kind(&self) -> ImportErrorKind {
+        use ImportInner::*;
+        match *self.0 {
+            Read { .. } | ReadThread { .. } => ImportErrorKind::File,
+            TooLarge { .. } => ImportErrorKind::TooLarge,
+            Presentation { .. } => ImportErrorKind::Presentation,
+            Threshold { .. } => ImportErrorKind::Threshold,
+            UnknownPack { .. } => ImportErrorKind::UnknownPack,
+            BadPack { .. } => ImportErrorKind::BadPack,
+            UnknownTheme { .. } => ImportErrorKind::UnknownTheme,
+            BadTheme { .. } => ImportErrorKind::BadTheme,
+            PackMissing { .. } | ThemeMissing { .. } => ImportErrorKind::Generated,
+            ProbeMismatch { .. } | ProbeLimit { .. } | ProbeFailed { .. } => ImportErrorKind::Probe,
+            Library { .. } => ImportErrorKind::Library,
+            Registry { .. } => ImportErrorKind::Render,
+            Sources { .. } | Op { .. } => ImportErrorKind::Apply,
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// L'erreur et ses causes, sur une ligne.
+    pub fn one_line(&self) -> String {
+        oku_slides_platform::errors::one_line(self)
+    }
+}
+
+/// Le résultat d'une étape de l'import.
+pub(crate) type Result<T, E = ImportError> = std::result::Result<T, E>;
+
+impl Localize for ImportError {
+    /// Le message, ou celui de l'erreur d'en dessous quand elle dit quelque chose à l'utilisateur.
+    fn localize(&self, l: &Localizer) -> String {
+        use ImportInner::*;
+        match &*self.0 {
+            Read { path, .. } | ReadThread { path, .. } => {
+                l.tr_with("session-read", &[("path", path.display().to_string().into())])
+            }
+            TooLarge { .. } => l.tr("import-too-large"),
+            Presentation { source, .. } => source.localize(l),
+            Threshold { value, .. } => {
+                l.tr_with("session-import-bad-threshold", &[("value", value.to_string().into())])
+            }
+            UnknownPack { pack, .. } => l.tr_with("session-import-unknown-pack", &[("pack", pack.as_str().into())]),
+            BadPack { pack, .. } => l.tr_with("session-import-bad-pack", &[("pack", pack.as_str().into())]),
+            UnknownTheme { theme, .. } => l.tr_with("session-unknown-theme", &[("theme", theme.as_str().into())]),
+            BadTheme { .. } => l.tr("session-import-bad-theme"),
+            PackMissing { .. } => l.tr("session-import-pack-missing"),
+            ThemeMissing { .. } => l.tr("session-import-theme-missing"),
+            ProbeMismatch { widget, .. } => {
+                l.tr_with("session-import-probe-mismatch", &[("widget", widget.as_str().into())])
+            }
+            ProbeLimit { widget, .. } => l.tr_with("session-import-probe-limit", &[("widget", widget.as_str().into())]),
+            ProbeFailed { error, .. } => l.tr_with("session-import-probe-failed", &[("error", error.as_str().into())]),
+            Library { source, .. } => source.localize(l),
+            Registry { source, .. } => source.localize(l),
+            Sources { source, .. } => source.localize(l),
+            Op { source, .. } => source.localize(l),
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+#[path = "error_tests.rs"]
+mod error_tests;
```

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/hifi.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,162 @@
+//! Le hi-fi : la présentation reproduite fidèlement (`oku_slides_import::hifi`),
+//! sur un thème et un pack générés pour elle.
+//!
+//! Le catalogue des polices réunit celles de l'app (celles du rendu) et, si
+//! demandé, celles du système des seules familles que cherche la présentation
+//! ([`super::system_fonts`]). Le pack et le thème générés ont une identité
+//! tirée des octets du `.pptx` (deux imports du même fichier donnent le même
+//! pack) ; ils ne vivent que dans le deck : la bibliothèque n'est pas touchée.
+//!
+//! Le pack généré est sondé par le processus de rendu, comme tout pack
+//! embarqué ; le registre sondé doit porter exactement les schémas que le
+//! projecteur a déclarés et avec lesquels il a construit ses ops. Le
+//! projecteur tient le pack dans les bornes de la sonde (`[render]` :
+//! `max_widgets`, `max_widget_kib`) ; un écart sur un fichier qui les dépasse
+//! ou que le budget (`probe_budget_ms`) a laissé non sondé est dit comme tel
+//! (`ProbeLimit`), tout autre écart est un bogue du générateur
+//! (`ProbeMismatch`), comme un fichier du pack sans schéma déclaré. Une sonde
+//! tout entière échouée (processus de rendu) est dite comme telle
+//! (`ProbeFailed`). Tous sont refusés avant toute écriture.
+
+use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
+use std::sync::Arc;
+
+use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
+use snafu::{OptionExt, ResultExt};
+use uuid::{Builder, Uuid};
+
+use oku_slides_core::{Deck, PackRef, WidgetFile, WidgetRegistry, WidgetSchema, now_created};
+use oku_slides_import::fonts::{FontCatalog, FontOrigin};
+use oku_slides_import::hifi;
+use oku_slides_import::{HifiTarget, PackLimits};
+use oku_slides_platform::Platform;
+use oku_slides_platform::config::RenderSettings;
+use oku_slides_render::Fonts;
+
+use super::error::{
+    PackMissingSnafu, PresentationSnafu, ProbeFailedSnafu, ProbeLimitSnafu, ProbeMismatchSnafu, Result,
+    ThemeMissingSnafu,
+};
+use super::{Input, Prepared, sources_with_pack};
+use crate::PackLibrary;
+
+/// Ce que le hi-fi prend de la demande d'import.
+pub(crate) struct HifiArgs<'a> {
+    /// Les polices de l'app, celles du rendu.
+    pub(crate) fonts: &'a Fonts,
+    /// Le registre de base.
+    pub(crate) base: &'a Arc<WidgetRegistry>,
+    /// Le nom du pack et du thème générés.
+    pub(crate) name: String,
+    /// Chercher aussi les polices de la présentation parmi celles du système.
+    pub(crate) system_fonts: bool,
+}
+
+/// Le hi-fi de `input` : les sources du deck, avec le pack, le thème et les
+/// polices générés pour lui, et le pack sondé.
+pub(crate) fn prepare(platform: &Platform, args: HifiArgs<'_>, input: &Input) -> Result<Prepared> {
+    let mut catalog = FontCatalog::new();
+    for data in args.fonts.shared_files() {
+        catalog.add(FontOrigin::App, data);
+    }
+    if args.system_fonts {
+        super::system_fonts::add(&mut catalog, &hifi::sought_fonts(&input.source));
+    }
+    let (pack_id, theme_id) = identity(&input.bytes);
+    let target = HifiTarget {
+        registry: args.base,
+        fonts: &catalog,
+        pack_id,
+        theme_id,
+        name: args.name,
+        created: now_created(),
+        limits: pack_limits(&platform.settings.render),
+    };
+    let mut plan = hifi::project(&input.source, &target).check_budget(&input.limits).context(PresentationSnafu)?;
+    // Sans pack ou sans thème, le projecteur n'a pu sérialiser son manifeste : un bogue, dit pour lui.
+    let pack = plan.take_pack().context(PackMissingSnafu)?;
+    let theme = plan.take_theme().context(ThemeMissingSnafu)?;
+
+    let version = pack.version();
+    let sizes: BTreeMap<WidgetFile, usize> = pack.widgets().iter().map(|(n, s)| (n.clone(), s.len())).collect();
+    let mut deck = Deck::empty();
+    deck.templates = Some(PackRef { id: pack_id, version: version.clone() });
+    let packs = BTreeMap::from([(version, pack)]);
+    let library = PackLibrary::user(platform);
+    let (mut bundle, widgets) = sources_with_pack(platform, &library, args.base, deck, packs)?;
+    // Une sonde tout entière échouée (processus de rendu) n'est pas un écart du générateur.
+    if let Some(error) = &widgets.probe_failed {
+        return Err(ProbeFailedSnafu { error: error.as_str() }.build().into());
+    }
+    let files: Vec<WidgetFile> = sizes.keys().cloned().collect();
+    if let Err(widget) = check_probe(&widgets.registry, &plan.schemas, &files) {
+        let refused = if beyond_limits(&widget, &sizes, &widgets.unprobed, target.limits) {
+            ProbeLimitSnafu { widget }.build()
+        } else {
+            ProbeMismatchSnafu { widget }.build()
+        };
+        return Err(refused.into());
+    }
+    bundle.add_theme(theme);
+    bundle.fonts.extend(plan.take_fonts());
+    Ok(Prepared { bundle, widgets, plan })
+}
+
+/// Ids du pack et du thème générés pour un `.pptx`.
+///
+/// Ce sont les deux moitiés du SHA-256 de ses octets, en UUID v8 (version et variante posées).
+pub(crate) fn identity(bytes: &[u8]) -> (Uuid, Uuid) {
+    let digest: [u8; 32] = Sha256::digest(bytes).into();
+    let half = |at: usize| {
+        let mut b = [0u8; 16];
+        b.copy_from_slice(&digest[at..at + 16]);
+        Builder::from_custom_bytes(b).into_uuid()
+    };
+    (half(0), half(16))
+}
+
+/// Les bornes de la sonde d'un pack, lues dans `[render]`.
+fn pack_limits(render: &RenderSettings) -> PackLimits {
+    PackLimits { max_files: render.max_widgets, max_file_bytes: render.max_widget_bytes() }
+}
+
+/// Le widget `widget` est-il hors des bornes de la sonde ?
+///
+/// `sizes` : les tailles des fichiers du pack (ordre des noms, `_commun` en
+/// tête). Hors bornes : au-delà du nombre de fichiers chargés, plus gros que
+/// la taille chargée (lui, ou `_commun` dont il dépend), ou laissé non sondé
+/// (`unprobed`).
+fn beyond_limits(
+    widget: &str,
+    sizes: &BTreeMap<WidgetFile, usize>,
+    unprobed: &BTreeSet<WidgetFile>,
+    limits: PackLimits,
+) -> bool {
+    let Some(name) = WidgetFile::parse(widget) else { return false };
+    let rank = sizes.keys().position(|n| *n == name);
+    let large = |n: &WidgetFile| sizes.get(n).is_some_and(|len| *len > limits.max_file_bytes);
+    unprobed.contains(&name)
+        || rank.is_some_and(|r| r >= limits.max_files)
+        || large(&name)
+        || large(&WidgetFile::common())
+}
+
+/// Chaque schéma déclaré est-il celui que la sonde a lu, et chaque fichier du pack est-il déclaré ?
+///
+/// `files` : les fichiers de widget du pack, `_commun` mis à part. Sinon, le
+/// nom du premier widget en écart (absent, différent ou non déclaré). Le
+/// registre sondé porte aussi la base : ses autres widgets ne sont pas du
+/// pack, d'où le contrôle des fichiers plutôt que du registre entier.
+fn check_probe(probed: &WidgetRegistry, declared: &[WidgetSchema], files: &[WidgetFile]) -> Result<(), String> {
+    if let Some(s) = declared.iter().find(|s| probed.get(&s.name) != Some(*s)) {
+        return Err(s.name.clone());
+    }
+    match files.iter().filter(|f| !f.is_common()).find(|f| !declared.iter().any(|s| s.name == f.as_str())) {
+        Some(f) => Err(f.as_str().to_owned()),
+        None => Ok(()),
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+#[path = "hifi_tests.rs"]
+mod hifi_tests;
```

```diff
@@ -0,0 +1,80 @@
+//! La présentation lue : sa taille vue avant toute lecture, ses octets, sa
+//! source et les bornes de l'import. La lecture se fait sur un fil dédié à
+//! pile connue ([`read_on_own_thread`]).
+
+use std::path::Path;
+
+use snafu::{IntoError, ResultExt};
+
+use oku_slides_import::source::SourceDeck;
+use oku_slides_import::{ReadLimits, read_pptx};
+use oku_slides_platform::Platform;
+use oku_slides_platform::storage::StorageErrorKind;
+
+use super::error::{PresentationSnafu, ReadSnafu, ReadThreadSnafu, Result, TooLargeSnafu};
+
+/// La présentation lue, et les bornes de son import.
+///
+/// Ses octets servent à l'identité du hi-fi et au témoin ; le budget de
+/// sortie de `limits` borne le plan.
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct Input {
+    /// Les octets du `.pptx`.
+    pub bytes: Vec<u8>,
+    /// Sa source lue.
+    pub source: SourceDeck,
+    pub(crate) limits: ReadLimits,
+}
+
+/// `n` octets en `u64`.
+fn bytes(n: usize) -> u64 {
+    // Saturé, jamais atteint : `usize` tient dans `u64` sur toutes les cibles (64 bits au plus),
+    // et les réglages en Mio sont déjà saturés en `usize`.
+    u64::try_from(n).unwrap_or(u64::MAX)
+}
+
+/// Lit `path`, borné par [`ReadLimits::default`].
+///
+/// La sortie l'est, approximativement, par la taille des sources et de
+/// l'historique qu'un deck peut avoir pour se rouvrir.
+pub(crate) fn read_input(platform: &Platform, path: &Path) -> Result<Input> {
+    let sources = &platform.settings.sources;
+    let limits = ReadLimits {
+        max_output_bytes: bytes(sources.max_sources_bytes()),
+        max_replica_bytes: bytes(sources.max_replica_bytes()),
+        ..ReadLimits::default()
+    };
+    // Taille vue avant toute lecture : un fichier trop gros n'entre jamais en mémoire.
+    let bytes = match platform.storage.read_limited(path, limits.max_input_bytes) {
+        Ok(bytes) => bytes,
+        Err(e) if e.kind() == StorageErrorKind::TooLarge => return Err(TooLargeSnafu.build().into()),
+        Err(e) => return Err(ReadSnafu { path }.into_error(e).into()),
+    };
+    let source = read_on_own_thread(&bytes, &limits).context(ReadThreadSnafu { path })?.context(PresentationSnafu)?;
+    Ok(Input { bytes, source, limits })
+}
+
+/// Pile du fil de lecture : la lecture est bornée en profondeur (XML, groupes), et cette pile
+/// ne dépend ni du fil appelant ni d'un runtime.
+const READ_STACK_BYTES: usize = 16 << 20;
+
+/// [`read_pptx`] sur un fil dédié à pile connue ([`READ_STACK_BYTES`]).
+///
+/// L'erreur externe est celle du lancement du fil ; une panique de la lecture
+/// est relancée telle quelle.
+pub(crate) fn read_on_own_thread(
+    bytes: &[u8],
+    limits: &ReadLimits,
+) -> std::io::Result<std::result::Result<SourceDeck, oku_slides_import::ImportError>> {
+    std::thread::scope(|scope| {
+        let reader = std::thread::Builder::new()
+            .name("import-read".to_owned())
+            .stack_size(READ_STACK_BYTES)
+            .spawn_scoped(scope, || read_pptx(bytes, limits))?;
+        Ok(reader.join().unwrap_or_else(|panic| std::panic::resume_unwind(panic)))
+    })
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+#[path = "input_tests.rs"]
+mod input_tests;
```

```diff
@@ -0,0 +1,79 @@
+//! Packs et thèmes désignés par l'utilisateur : un pack lu dans un dossier,
+//! un pack ou un thème trouvé par son id, son dossier ou son nom, embarqué
+//! dans des sources. L'import et la CLI passent par ici.
+
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::path::Path;
+
+use snafu::OptionExt;
+
+use oku_slides_core::{PackFiles, SourceBundle, ThemeRef, WidgetFile};
+use oku_slides_platform::storage::Storage;
+
+use super::error::{Result, UnknownPackSnafu, UnknownThemeSnafu};
+use crate::{PackLibrary, ThemeLibrary};
+
+/// Le contenu d'un fichier existant, `None` s'il manque ou ne se lit pas (journalisé).
+fn read_existing(storage: &Storage, path: &Path) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
+    match storage.len(path) {
+        Ok(Some(_)) => storage
+            .read(path)
+            .inspect_err(|e| tracing::warn!(path = %path.display(), error = %e, "fichier du pack illisible"))
+            .ok(),
+        _ => None,
+    }
+}
+
+/// Les fichiers du pack rangé dans `dir` (`pack.json`, `widgets/<nom>.typ`).
+///
+/// C'est la disposition d'une version de pack ; `None` sans `pack.json` lisible.
+pub fn read_pack_dir(storage: &Storage, dir: &Path) -> Option<PackFiles> {
+    let mut widgets = BTreeMap::new();
+    let listed = storage.list_files(&dir.join("widgets")).unwrap_or_default();
+    for path in listed {
+        let Some(name) = path.file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str()).and_then(WidgetFile::from_file_name) else {
+            continue;
+        };
+        widgets.insert(name, read_existing(storage, &path)?);
+    }
+    PackFiles::from_bytes(
+        &read_existing(storage, &dir.join("pack.json"))?,
+        widgets.iter().map(|(n, b)| (n.clone(), b.as_slice())),
+    )
+}
+
+/// Le pack désigné par `wanted` : un id, un dossier de pack, sinon un nom.
+///
+/// Un id donne la version courante de la bibliothèque ; un dossier se lit
+/// (`pack.json`, `widgets/`) ; un nom est celui d'un pack intégré ou de la
+/// bibliothèque, sans casse. Introuvable : `UnknownPack`.
+pub fn resolve_pack(storage: &Storage, library: &PackLibrary, wanted: &str) -> Result<PackFiles> {
+    let unknown = || UnknownPackSnafu { pack: wanted };
+    if let Ok(id) = uuid::Uuid::parse_str(wanted) {
+        return Ok(library.current_version(id).context(unknown())?.files);
+    }
+    let dir = Path::new(wanted);
+    if matches!(storage.len(&dir.join("pack.json")), Ok(Some(_))) {
+        return Ok(read_pack_dir(storage, dir).context(unknown())?);
+    }
+    let info = library.packs().into_iter().find(|p| p.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(wanted)).context(unknown())?;
+    Ok(library.current_version(info.id).context(unknown())?.files)
+}
+
+/// Embarque dans `bundle` la version courante du thème désigné par `wanted`.
+///
+/// `wanted` est son id, sinon son nom (intégré ou de la bibliothèque, sans
+/// casse) ; rend sa référence. Inconnu : `UnknownTheme`.
+pub fn embed_theme(themes: &ThemeLibrary, wanted: &str, bundle: &mut SourceBundle) -> Result<ThemeRef> {
+    let unknown = || UnknownThemeSnafu { theme: wanted };
+    let id = match uuid::Uuid::parse_str(wanted) {
+        Ok(id) => id,
+        Err(_) => themes.themes().into_iter().find(|t| t.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(wanted)).context(unknown())?.id,
+    };
+    let current = themes.current_version(id).context(unknown())?;
+    Ok(ThemeRef { id, version: bundle.add_theme(current.files) })
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+#[path = "library_tests.rs"]
+mod library_tests;
```

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/mod.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,153 @@
+//! L'import d'une présentation PowerPoint en deck Oku, partagé par la CLI
+//! (`oku-slides import`) et l'app : une seule implémentation.
+//!
+//! [`import`] lit le `.pptx` (taille vue avant toute lecture, puis lu sur un
+//! fil à pile connue), projette son
+//! contenu ([`ImportTarget`] : retrofit sur un pack et un thème existants, ou
+//! hi-fi sur un pack et un thème générés, embarqués dans le deck seulement),
+//! sonde le pack du deck dans le processus de rendu, puis applique le plan aux
+//! sources en une transaction : une seule étape d'historique, que l'annulation
+//! défait d'un coup, validée par les règles ordinaires du cœur.
+//! Le retrofit refuse un thème cible dont les jetons ne se lisent pas : ses
+//! couleurs et sa page guident la projection.
+//!
+//! La lecture et la taille du plan sont bornées (`ReadLimits` ;
+//! `max_output_bytes` et `max_replica_bytes` viennent de `[sources]
+//! max_sources_mib` et `max_replica_mib`, bornes de réouverture d'un deck :
+//! une estimation précoce du contenu produit, pas une garantie). Rien n'est
+//! écrit : l'appelant rend et enregistre le deck obtenu.
+//!
+//! Les aides de ce module (packs et thèmes désignés par id, dossier ou nom,
+//! widgets sondés d'un deck hors session) servent aussi aux autres commandes
+//! de la CLI.
+
+mod error;
+mod hifi;
+mod input;
+mod library;
+mod retrofit;
+mod system_fonts;
+mod widgets;
+
+use std::collections::HashSet;
+use std::path::PathBuf;
+
+use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
+use snafu::ResultExt;
+
+use oku_slides_core::{Issue, SourceBundle, apply_all, validate};
+use oku_slides_import::CheckedPlan;
+use oku_slides_platform::Platform;
+use oku_slides_render::Fonts;
+
+pub use error::{ImportError, ImportErrorKind};
+use error::{OpSnafu, RegistrySnafu, Result, SourcesSnafu, ThresholdSnafu};
+pub use input::Input;
+pub use library::{embed_theme, read_pack_dir, resolve_pack};
+pub use widgets::{ProbedWidgets, sources_with_pack};
+
+/// Le mode d'un import.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
+pub enum ImportMode {
+    /// Contenu projeté sur un pack et un thème existants.
+    Retrofit,
+    /// Copie fidèle, sur un pack et un thème générés.
+    Hifi,
+}
+
+/// Où va le contenu importé.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub enum ImportTarget {
+    /// Sur un pack et un thème existants.
+    Retrofit {
+        /// Le pack : son id, son dossier ou son nom.
+        pack: String,
+        /// Le thème : son id ou son nom ; `None` : le thème par défaut.
+        theme: Option<String>,
+    },
+    /// Sur un pack et un thème générés pour la présentation.
+    Hifi,
+}
+
+impl ImportTarget {
+    /// Le mode de cette cible.
+    pub fn mode(&self) -> ImportMode {
+        match self {
+            Self::Retrofit { .. } => ImportMode::Retrofit,
+            Self::Hifi => ImportMode::Hifi,
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// Une demande d'import.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct ImportRequest {
+    /// Le `.pptx` à importer ; son nom de fichier nomme le pack et le thème générés.
+    pub pptx: PathBuf,
+    /// Le mode et sa cible.
+    pub target: ImportTarget,
+    /// Hi-fi : chercher aussi les polices de la présentation parmi celles du système.
+    pub system_fonts: bool,
+}
+
+/// Un import appliqué, pas encore rendu ni enregistré.
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct Imported {
+    /// Le mode de l'import.
+    pub mode: ImportMode,
+    /// Les sources du deck : le plan en une étape d'historique, packs, thèmes, assets et polices embarqués.
+    pub sources: SourceBundle,
+    /// Les widgets sondés de son pack, et le processus de rendu qui les rend.
+    pub widgets: ProbedWidgets,
+    /// Le plan appliqué, vérifié dans ses budgets, ses ops passées aux sources : rapport, demandes de widget.
+    pub plan: CheckedPlan,
+    /// Les problèmes du deck obtenu ; vide pour un plan valide, comme il doit l'être.
+    pub issues: Vec<Issue>,
+    /// La présentation lue (le témoin du hi-fi en a besoin).
+    pub input: Input,
+}
+
+/// Un import prêt à s'appliquer : les sources (packs et thèmes embarqués),
+/// les widgets sondés de leur pack et le plan, dont la sortie tient dans les budgets.
+struct Prepared {
+    bundle: SourceBundle,
+    widgets: ProbedWidgets,
+    plan: CheckedPlan,
+}
+
+/// Importe `request` : lu, projeté, sondé et appliqué en une étape d'historique.
+///
+/// `fonts` : les polices de l'app, celles du rendu (le catalogue du hi-fi en
+/// part). En hi-fi, `[import] score_threshold` est vérifié avant toute
+/// lecture. Rien n'est écrit.
+pub fn import(platform: &Platform, fonts: &Fonts, request: &ImportRequest) -> Result<Imported> {
+    if matches!(request.target, ImportTarget::Hifi) {
+        let threshold = platform.settings.import.score_threshold;
+        snafu::ensure!(threshold.is_finite() && threshold >= 0.0, ThresholdSnafu { value: threshold });
+    }
+    let input = input::read_input(platform, &request.pptx)?;
+    let base = oku_slides_render::base_registry(fonts).context(RegistrySnafu)?;
+    let prepared = match &request.target {
+        ImportTarget::Retrofit { pack, theme } => retrofit::prepare(platform, &base, pack, theme.as_deref(), &input)?,
+        ImportTarget::Hifi => {
+            let name = request.pptx.file_stem().map(|s| s.to_string_lossy().into_owned()).unwrap_or_default();
+            let args = hifi::HifiArgs { fonts, base: &base, name, system_fonts: request.system_fonts };
+            hifi::prepare(platform, args, &input)?
+        }
+    };
+    let Prepared { mut bundle, widgets, mut plan } = prepared;
+    for asset in plan.assets.values() {
+        bundle.add_asset(asset.bytes.clone());
+    }
+    let mut deck = bundle.deck().clone();
+    apply_all(&mut deck, plan.take_ops(), &widgets.registry).context(OpSnafu)?;
+    bundle.apply(deck, &platform.localizer.tr("session-import-label"), None).context(SourcesSnafu)?;
+    let ids: HashSet<String> = bundle.assets.keys().cloned().collect();
+    let issues = validate(bundle.deck(), &widgets.registry, Some(&ids));
+    Ok(Imported { mode: request.target.mode(), sources: bundle, widgets, plan, issues, input })
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+#[path = "mod_tests.rs"]
+mod mod_tests;
```
