```diff
+    let lib = library(dir.path());
+    let id = Uuid::new_v4();
+    let a = add_version(&lib, &manifest(id, "A", None, "2026-10-01T10:00:00Z"), &[]);
+    let mut deck_only = manifest(id, "B", Some(&a.version), "2026-10-02T10:00:00Z");
+    deck_only.scope = oku_slides_core::PackScope::Deck;
+    let files = deck_only.to_files(Default::default()).unwrap();
+    assert_that!(lib.add_version(id, &files).map_err(|e| e.kind())).is_equal_to(Err(crate::SessionErrorKind::DeckOnly));
+    assert_that!(lib.receive_version(id, &files).map_err(|e| e.kind()))
+        .is_equal_to(Err(crate::SessionErrorKind::DeckOnly));
+    let listed = lib.versions(id).into_iter().map(|s| s.version).collect::<Vec<_>>();
+    assert_that!(listed).is_equal_to(vec![a.version.clone()]);
+    assert_that!(lib.current(id)).is_equal_to(Some(a.version));
+    assert_that!(lib.version(id, &files.version())).is_none();
+}
```

```diff
+#[test]
+fn import_retrofit_puts_the_deck_on_a_deck_only_child_of_the_target_pack() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-retrofit-child-");
+    let library = PackLibrary::user(&platform(settings_on(data.path())));
+    let target = library.current_version(DEFAULT_PACK).unwrap();
+    let packs = library.packs();
+    let imported = import_minimal(data.path(), retrofit("Essentiel", None)).unwrap();
+    let r = imported.sources.deck().templates.clone().unwrap();
+    let pptx = std::fs::read(data.path().join("minimal.pptx")).unwrap();
+    assert_that!(r.id).is_equal_to(retrofit::child_id(&pptx, &target.version));
+    let child = &imported.sources.packs[&r.version];
+    let manifest = PackManifest::from_files(child).unwrap();
+    assert_that!(manifest.scope).is_equal_to(oku_slides_core::PackScope::Deck);
+    assert_that!(manifest.parent).is_equal_to(Some(target.version.clone()));
+    assert_that!(manifest.name.as_str()).is_equal_to("Essentiel pour minimal");
+    assert_that!(manifest.templates).is_equal_to(&target.manifest.templates);
+    assert_that!(child.widgets()).is_equal_to(target.files.widgets());
+    // Le pack cible et la bibliothèque n'ont pas changé.
+    assert_that!(library.current(DEFAULT_PACK)).is_equal_to(Some(target.version));
+    assert_that!(library.packs()).is_equal_to(&packs);
+    assert_that!(library.versions(r.id).is_empty()).is_true();
+}

+fn retrofit_child_id_depends_on_the_pptx_and_the_target_version() {
+    let version = |name: &str| {
+        let m = serde_json::json!({ "name": name });
+        let serde_json::Value::Object(m) = m else { unreachable!() };
+        oku_slides_core::PackFiles::new(m, Default::default()).version()
+    };
+    let (a, b) = (version("a"), version("b"));
+    assert_that!(retrofit::child_id(b"pptx", &a)).is_equal_to(retrofit::child_id(b"pptx", &a));
+    assert_that!(retrofit::child_id(b"pptx", &a)).is_not_equal_to(retrofit::child_id(b"pptx", &b));
+    assert_that!(retrofit::child_id(b"pptx", &a)).is_not_equal_to(retrofit::child_id(b"other", &a));
+}
```

```diff
-/// Le retrofit de `input` sur le pack `wanted` et le thème `theme`.
+/// Id du pack enfant du retrofit de `pptx` sur la version `target`.
+///
+/// La moitié haute du SHA-256 de l'empreinte du `.pptx` suivie de la
+/// version cible, en UUID v8 : le même fichier sur la même version donne le
+/// même pack, une autre cible un autre pack.
+pub(crate) fn child_id(pptx: &[u8], target: &PackVersion) -> Uuid {
+    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
+    hasher.update(Sha256::digest(pptx));
+    hasher.update(target.as_str().as_bytes());
+    let digest: [u8; 32] = hasher.finalize().into();
+    let mut bytes = [0u8; 16];
+    bytes.copy_from_slice(&digest[..16]);
+    Builder::from_custom_bytes(bytes).into_uuid()
+}
+
+/// Le pack enfant de `target` pour le deck `deck` : ses modèles, valeurs
+/// d'exemple et widgets, sous l'id [`child_id`], du deck seul, issu de la
+/// version cible. `None` si son `pack.json` ne s'écrit pas.
+pub(crate) fn child_pack(
+    l: &Localizer,
+    target: &PackFiles,
+    manifest: &PackManifest,
+    pptx: &[u8],
+    deck: &str,
+) -> Option<PackFiles> {
+    let parent = target.version();
+    let id = child_id(pptx, &parent);
+    let name =
+        l.tr_with("session-import-retrofit-pack", &[("pack", manifest.name.as_str().into()), ("deck", deck.into())]);
+    let child = PackManifest {
+        id,
+        name,
+        parent: Some(parent),
+        created: now_created(),
+        scope: PackScope::Deck,
+        ..manifest.clone()
+    };
+    child.to_files(target.widgets().clone()).ok()
+}
+
+/// Le retrofit de `input` (le `.pptx` nommé `name`) sur le pack `wanted` et le thème `theme`.
 pub(crate) fn prepare(
     platform: &Platform,
     base: &Arc<WidgetRegistry>,
-    wanted: &str,
-    theme: Option<&str>,
+    (wanted, theme): (&str, Option<&str>),
+    name: &str,
     input: &Input,
 ) -> Result<Prepared> {
     let library = PackLibrary::user(platform);
-    let files = resolve_pack(&platform.storage, &library, wanted)?;
-    let manifest = PackManifest::from_files(&files).ok().context(BadPackSnafu { pack: wanted })?;
+    let target = resolve_pack(&platform.storage, &library, wanted)?;
+    let manifest = PackManifest::from_files(&target).ok().context(BadPackSnafu { pack: wanted })?;
+    let files = child_pack(&platform.localizer, &target, &manifest, &input.bytes, name)
+        .context(BadPackSnafu { pack: wanted })?;
     let version = files.version();
     let mut deck = Deck::empty();
-    deck.templates = Some(PackRef { id: manifest.id, version: version.clone() });
+    deck.templates = Some(PackRef { id: child_id(&input.bytes, &target.version()), version: version.clone() });
     let packs = BTreeMap::from([(version, files)]);
     let (mut bundle, widgets) = sources_with_pack(platform, &library, base, deck, packs)?;
     let themes = ThemeLibrary::user(platform);
```

```text
feat(session) : packs et thèmes du deck seulement ; pack enfant du retrofit à l'import (t-692)

Lot 5, tâche 5. Un pack ou un thème peut n'appartenir qu'à son deck :

- oku_slides_core::PackScope (library par défaut, non écrit dans le
  manifeste : les versions existantes gardent leur empreinte ; deck) et le
  champ `scope` de PackManifest et ThemeManifest, gardé par les versions
  issues d'eux. Le pack et le thème du hi-fi sont du deck seul (seules les
  empreintes des instantanés hifi__*_ops changent).
- La bibliothèque refuse une version du deck seul (Library::add_version,
  donc replace_version, et receive_version avant d'écrire la marque
  `received` : SessionErrorKind::DeckOnly, clé session-deck-only,
  20 langues) ; VersionManifest::scope. Le refus vient avant toute
  écriture, sur le disque comme dans l'index en mémoire de la bibliothèque
  (t-355) : un test vérifie que la même instance ne liste ni ne charge la
  version refusée.
- set_widget en mode deck sur un pack du deck seul : même séance (version
  embarquée, une étape d'annulation), sans écrire la bibliothèque ni poser
  d'avis ; pas de bandeau de pack pour lui ; un fichier ouvert ne fait
  jamais entrer un tel pack dans la bibliothèque (receive_packs).
- edit_theme et theme_info sur un thème du deck seul partent de la version
  du deck ; la nouvelle version, du deck seul, est embarquée et adoptée en
  une étape. En mode modèles, le brouillon d'un thème du deck seul
  s'enregistre de même, hors de la bibliothèque.
- Retrofit : le deck prend le pack enfant du pack cible (copie de ses
  fichiers, id tiré du SHA-256 du .pptx et de la version cible, parent =
  la version cible, du deck seul, nommé « <pack> pour <deck> », clé
  session-import-retrofit-pack) ; le pack cible et la bibliothèque ne
  changent pas.

Règle « jamais une version du deck seul dans la bibliothèque » dans
crates/AGENTS.md (ceux de core et de session sont pleins, 60 lignes).
```

### Task 6: Workspace opens a `.pptx` as an imported tab

This task makes the app's workspace able to import a PowerPoint file, using the session pipeline of Tasks 2 and 3 (`oku_slides_session::import`). A new request `WorkspaceRequest::ImportTab { window, path, mode, pack, theme, tune }` builds a new tab outside the locks, like an opened file: the tab replaces the active tab when that one is pristine (the `OpenTab` rule), is never the tab of a previous import (every import is a fresh deck), and two imports of the same file make two tabs. `Session::load_import` loads the imported deck without a file, unsaved, keeping the import's undo step (undoing it empties the deck), titles it from the `.pptx` name when the deck has no title, notes overflows on the session's own render, persists the new tab, and keeps the `ImportState` in memory (`import_state`, `import_state_mut`); any other document loaded forgets it and a resumed tab never has one. A deviation from the lot 5 decisions: `ImportTarget` is flat in JSON, tagged by `mode` (`{"mode": "retrofit", "pack", "theme"?}` or `{"mode": "hifi"}`), and the request flattens it, with a mirror type in `ui/src/api.ts`. A failed import is the new `SessionErrorKind::Import` carrying the import's localized message, shown like a failed open, and the tabs do not change. With `tune`, the outcome is `WorkspaceOutcome::Tune { json, tab }` (`tune_tab()`), which names the imported tab the host will have the agent fine-tune; the Tauri host classifies and broadcasts the request like `OpenTab`, and the dev server returns the view like an opened file. Task 7 and later tasks (MCP tools, the agent launch, the UI dialog) build on `import_state_mut`, `Tune` and the `import_tab` request. This commit also carries the replay onto main: the `oku-slides-session` ARCHITECTURE.md lines (already reflowed on main) were re-flowed again to stay within 50 lines.

- Create: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/tab.rs` (`Session::load_import`, `import_state`, `import_state_mut`)
- Create: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/tab_tests.rs` (state kept, one undo step, state forgotten, JSON shape of `ImportTarget`)
- Create: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/workspace_import_tests.rs` (imported tabs through the workspace: hi-fi, retrofit, pristine replaced, edited kept, `Tune`, errors, resume)
- Modify: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/mod.rs` (`mod tab;`, `ImportTarget` deserialized, tagged by `mode`)
- Modify: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/lib.rs` (`Session.import: Option<import::ImportState>`)
- Modify: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/deck_file.rs` (`load_document` forgets the import state)
- Modify: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/error.rs` (`SessionErrorKind::Import`, `SessionInner::Import`, localization through the import error)

- Modify: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/workspace_tabs.rs` (`Opening::Import`, `ImportOpening`, `Pending::tunes`, `Workspace::import_tab`, `to_wake`, classification)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: from Tasks 2 and 3, `oku_slides_session::import::{import, ImportRequest { pptx, target, system_fonts }, ImportTarget, ImportMode, ImportState, Imported { sources, state, .. }, ImportError, note_overflows}`, where `import(&Platform, &Fonts, &ImportRequest) -> Result<Imported, ImportError>` and `ImportError: Localize`; from existing code `Session::load(sources, None)`, `Session::persist(bool)`, `Sources::apply_silent`, `Workspace::pending`, `resolve`, `Step`, `Pending::build`, `Workspace::finish`.
- Produces:
  - `Session::load_import(&mut self, imported: Imported, name: &str) -> Result<()>`, `Session::import_state(&self) -> Option<&ImportState>`, `Session::import_state_mut(&mut self) -> Option<&mut ImportState>`
  - `ImportTarget` now `Deserialize` with `#[serde(tag = "mode", rename_all = "snake_case")]`: `{"mode":"retrofit","pack":"…","theme":"…"?}` or `{"mode":"hifi"}`
  - `WorkspaceRequest::ImportTab { window: String, path: PathBuf, #[serde(flatten)] target: ImportTarget, #[serde(default)] tune: bool }`, wire form `{"cmd":"import_tab","window":"w-1","path":"…","mode":"hifi","tune":true}`
  - `WorkspaceOutcome::Tune { json: String, tab: String }` and `WorkspaceOutcome::tune_tab(&self) -> Option<&str>`; `into_json` also returns the `Tune` view
  - `SessionErrorKind::Import`
  - TypeScript: `export type ImportTarget = { mode: "retrofit"; pack: string; theme?: string | null } | { mode: "hifi" }` and the request `{ cmd: "import_tab"; window: string; path: string; tune?: boolean } & ImportTarget`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests**

The session tests cover the state kept by `load_import`, its single undo step and its loss on another document, the mode-tagged JSON of `ImportTarget`, and the workspace behaviours (pristine tab replaced, edited tab kept, two imports two tabs, `Tune` naming the tab, an unreadable `.pptx` as a localized import error leaving the tabs unchanged, retrofit without a pack refused at read time, a resumed tab without `ImportState`). The CLI test drives the dev server's `/api/workspace` route.

Session: the new `import/tab.rs` holds `load_import` and the state accessors; `Session` gets the `import` field, `load_document` clears it (so `load_import` sets it after loading), and `ImportTarget` becomes deserializable and `mode`-tagged.
```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/tab.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+//! Un onglet importé : le deck d'un `.pptx`, sans fichier, et l'état de son import.
+//!
+//! [`Session::load_import`] charge le deck obtenu par [`super::import`] comme
+//! un deck neuf non enregistré (titre de la présentation, sinon le nom du
+//! `.pptx`), relève ses débordements sur le rendu de la session, et garde
+//! l'[`ImportState`] en mémoire tant que la session vit. Un autre document
+//! chargé l'oublie ; la reprise ne l'écrit pas : un onglet repris n'en a pas.
+
+use snafu::ResultExt;
+
+use super::{ImportState, Imported, note_overflows};
+use crate::error::SourcesSnafu;
+use crate::{Result, Session};
+
+impl Session {
+    /// Charge l'import `imported` du `.pptx` nommé `name` : un deck sans fichier, à enregistrer.
+    ///
+    /// Le deck garde l'étape d'historique de l'import (l'annuler le vide) ;
+    /// sans titre, il prend `name`. Ses widgets sont sondés de nouveau par le
+    /// processus de rendu de la session, qui le rend.
+    pub fn load_import(&mut self, imported: Imported, name: &str) -> Result<()> {
+        let Imported { mut sources, mut state, .. } = imported;
+        if sources.deck().params.title.is_none() && !name.trim().is_empty() {
+            let mut deck = sources.deck().clone();
+            deck.params.title = Some(name.to_owned());
+            // Un nom, pas une modification : l'étape de l'import reste la seule.
+            sources.apply_silent(deck).context(SourcesSnafu)?;
+        }
+        self.load(sources, None)?;
+        if let Some(compiled) = &self.compiled {
+            note_overflows(compiled.layout(), state.report_mut());
+        }
+        self.doc.dirty = true;
+        self.import = Some(state);
+        self.persist(true);
+        Ok(())
+    }
+
+    /// L'état de l'import d'où vient le deck, s'il en vient (onglet importé, pas repris).
+    pub fn import_state(&self) -> Option<&ImportState> {
+        self.import.as_ref()
+    }
+
+    /// L'état de l'import, modifiable (essais, scores, référence du témoin).
+    pub fn import_state_mut(&mut self) -> Option<&mut ImportState> {
+        self.import.as_mut()
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+#[path = "tab_tests.rs"]
+mod tab_tests;
```

### Task 7: import_report and import_diff MCP tools, bounded tries per slide

The agent tunes a hi-fi import slide by slide, in bounded tries, from the session of the imported tab. The commit adds two MCP tools in `oku-slides-mcp` (`import_tools.rs`) over a new session layer (`oku_slides_session::import`: `queue.rs` for the report and queue, `diff.rs` for the diff, `tune.rs` for the bounds, `tune_error.rs` for the localized refusals). `import_report` returns the mode, losses by kind and frozen (Opaque) items; for a retrofit the widget requests; for a hi-fi import the threshold, mean, witness and the queue of slides not yet `done` (worst region first, with `state` in `pending`, `exhausted`, `stalled`, `witness`, `unscored` and `tries_left`), plus source groups repeated on at least 3 slides. Every slide whose Oku page changed since its last score (a render fingerprint of the page) is rescored, so theme, widget, slide or undo changes show in the next report with `mean_before` and `worse`; this fingerprint replaces the `stale` flag of lot 4 (`is_stale` / `mark_stale` removed). `import_diff(slide, region?)` returns the two whole pages (960 px) then JSON (score, state, the 8 worst regions with frame in page pt, elements or the slide parameter to fix); a try is a whole-slide diff of a slide whose page changed since the previous one (the first is the base), refused when `tries_left` is zero (`tune_iterations` done, or `tune_stall` tries in a row without gain). With `region` it returns both crops, 16 px margin, enlarged twice, and does not count. Deviation from decision 3/8: the witness for tuning is office2pdf alone (`app_witness`); it runs outside the session lock (`ReferenceJob` in a blocking task, once per tab) and `ReferenceDone` carries the witness name, its limits (suspect regions) and its pages or failure, logged in the current language by the state that keeps it; `import_report` receives the agent language (`LiveLocalizer::current`) to report a missing reference. Prerequisite in `oku-slides-import`: in hi-fi, `ImportPlan.targets` gives each item its elements (shapes, images, tables, charts, groups included) or the slide parameter it fills, and `ImportPlan.groups` lists repeated source groups (SmartArt drawn excluded); both are read by the `CheckedPlan`; `origins` stays the coverage one. Also adds `[import] tune_iterations = 3` and `tune_stall = 2` (at least 1), `Raster::scaled`, and the `session-import-tune-*` refusals in the 20 locales. Later tasks (agent instructions, app entry point, e2e) call these two tools by name and rely on the report and diff JSON shapes below.

```diff
+        text_item(&format!("{id}/b"), (x + 120.0, 0.0, 100.0, 50.0), "b"),

+    item(id, (x, 0.0, 220.0, 50.0), ItemKind::Group { items, smartart })
+}

+#[test]
+fn repeated_keeps_a_group_found_on_three_slides() {
+    let slides = (1..=3).map(|n| source_slide(n, None, vec![pair(&format!("s{n}/1"), f64::from(n) * 10.0, false)]));
+    let groups = repeated(&source_deck(slides.collect()));

+    assert_that!(repeated(&source_deck(slides.collect()))).is_empty();
```

```diff
+/// Le `.pptx` de la fixture décompressée `fixtures/import/<name>`, zippé dans `dir` ; son chemin.
+pub fn pptx(dir: &std::path::Path, name: &str) -> std::path::PathBuf {
+    use std::io::Write;
+    fn files(dir: &std::path::Path, out: &mut Vec<std::path::PathBuf>) {
+        for e in std::fs::read_dir(dir).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{}: {e}", dir.display())) {
+            let p = e.unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{e}")).path();
+            if p.file_name().is_some_and(|n| n == ".DS_Store") {
+                continue;
+            }
+            if p.is_dir() { files(&p, out) } else { out.push(p) }
+        }
+    }
+    let root = std::path::PathBuf::from(concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/../../fixtures/import")).join(name);
+    let mut paths = Vec::new();
+    files(&root, &mut paths);
+    // `[Content_Types].xml` en tête, comme l'écrit PowerPoint.
+    paths.sort_by_key(|p| (p.file_name() != Some("[Content_Types].xml".as_ref()), p.clone()));
+    let mut w = zip::ZipWriter::new(std::io::Cursor::new(Vec::new()));
+    for p in paths {
+        let rel = p.strip_prefix(&root).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{e}")).to_string_lossy().replace('\\', "/");
+        w.start_file(rel, zip::write::SimpleFileOptions::default()).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("zip : {e}"));
+        w.write_all(&std::fs::read(&p).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{e}"))).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("zip : {e}"));
+    }
+    let bytes = w.finish().unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("zip : {e}")).into_inner();
+    let path = dir.join(format!("{name}.pptx"));
+    std::fs::write(&path, bytes).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{e}"));
+    path
+}
+
+/// Un serveur sur un onglet tout juste importé de `fixtures/import/minimal` vers `target`,
+/// réglages retouchés par `tweak` ; le témoin y rend pour de vrai.
+pub async fn start_imported(
+    target: oku_slides_session::import::ImportTarget,
+    tweak: impl FnOnce(&mut Settings) + Send + 'static,
+) -> Harness {
+    let (platform, session, data) = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || {
+        use oku_slides_session::import::{ImportRequest, import};
+        let (platform, data) = platform_with(tweak);
+        let request = ImportRequest { pptx: pptx(data.path(), "minimal"), target, system_fonts: false };
+        let imported = import(&platform, &Fonts::default(), &request).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("import : {e}"));
+        let mut session = Session::new(Fonts::default(), &platform).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("session de test : {e}"));
+        session.load_import(imported, "minimal").unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("chargement de l'import : {e}"));
+        (platform, session, data)
+    })
+    .await
+    .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("tâche bloquante de l'import : {e}"));
+    let session = Arc::new(Mutex::new(session));
+    start_with((platform, data), session.clone(), session).await
+}
+
```

```diff
+//! Les outils de l'ajustement d'un import : `import_report` et `import_diff`,
+//! sur un onglet importé de `fixtures/import/minimal` (le témoin rend pour de vrai).
+
+mod common;
+
+use base64::Engine as _;
+use common::*;
+use oku_slides_session::import::ImportTarget;
+use rust_mcp_sdk::McpClient;
+use rust_mcp_sdk::schema::{CallToolResult, ContentBlock};
+use serde_json::{Value, json};
+use speculoos::prelude::*;
+
+/// Largeur et hauteur du PNG du bloc `index` (en-tête IHDR).
+fn png_size(r: &CallToolResult, index: usize) -> (u32, u32) {
+    let Some(ContentBlock::ImageContent(image)) = r.content.get(index) else { panic!("image attendue en {index}") };
+    let bytes = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.decode(&image.data).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{e}"));
+    let be = |at: usize| u32::from_be_bytes([bytes[at], bytes[at + 1], bytes[at + 2], bytes[at + 3]]);
+    (be(16), be(20))
+}
+
+/// Le JSON du bloc texte qui suit les deux images d'un diff.
+fn diff_json(r: &CallToolResult) -> Value {
+    let Some(ContentBlock::TextContent(t)) = r.content.get(2) else { panic!("texte attendu après les images") };
+    serde_json::from_str(&t.text).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("JSON du diff : {e}"))
+}
+
+/// Le premier élément des slots de la slide `slide`, lu dans la session.
+fn first_element(h: &Harness, slide: &str) -> String {
+    let session = h.session.lock().unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner);
+    let s = session.deck().slide(slide).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("slide {slide}"));
+    s.params.slots().flat_map(|(_, list)| list.iter().map(|e| e.id.clone())).next().unwrap_or_default()
+}
+
+#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
+async fn import_tools_are_listed() {
+    let h = start().await;
+    let c = client(h.server.url(), Some(h.server.authorization())).await.unwrap();
+    let names: Vec<String> = c.request_tool_list(None).await.unwrap().tools.into_iter().map(|t| t.name).collect();
+    for tool in ["import_report", "import_diff"] {
+        assert_that!(names.contains(&tool.to_owned())).named(tool).is_true();
+    }
+}
+
+#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
+async fn import_tools_on_a_deck_not_imported_say_so_in_the_user_language() {
+    let h = start().await;
+    let c = client(h.server.url(), Some(h.server.authorization())).await.unwrap();
+    let expected = h.localizer.tr("session-import-tune-none");
+    assert_that!(expected.as_str()).starts_with("Aucun import");
+    for (tool, args) in [("import_report", json!({})), ("import_diff", json!({ "slide": "s1" }))] {
+        let r = call(&c, tool, args).await;
+        assert_that!(r.is_error).named(tool).is_equal_to(Some(true));
+        assert_that!(text_of(&r)).named(tool).is_equal_to(expected.clone());
+    }
+}
+
+#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
+async fn import_report_hifi_gives_the_queue_worst_first() {
+    let h = start_imported(ImportTarget::Hifi, |_| {}).await;
+    let c = client(h.server.url(), Some(h.server.authorization())).await.unwrap();
+    let report = json_of(&call(&c, "import_report", json!({})).await);
+    assert_that!(report["mode"].as_str()).is_equal_to(Some("hifi"));
+    assert_that!(report["witness"].as_str().unwrap_or_default()).starts_with("office2pdf");
+    assert_that!(report["threshold"].as_f64()).is_equal_to(Some(7.0));
+    let slides = report["slides"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
+    assert_that!(slides.len() as u64 + report["done"].as_u64().unwrap_or_default()).is_equal_to(3);
+    let worst: Vec<f64> = slides.iter().filter_map(|s| s["worst"].as_f64()).collect();
+    assert_that!(worst.windows(2).all(|w| w[0] >= w[1])).is_true();
+    for s in &slides {
+        assert_that!(s["tries_left"].as_u64()).is_equal_to(Some(3));
+    }
+}
+
+#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
+async fn import_diff_gives_both_pages_then_the_regions_and_bounds_the_tries() {
+    let h = start_imported(ImportTarget::Hifi, |s| s.import.tune_iterations = std::num::NonZeroU32::MIN).await;
+    let c = client(h.server.url(), Some(h.server.authorization())).await.unwrap();
+    // `s2` a des éléments (la première slide n'a que des paramètres).
+    let slide = "s2";
+    let first = call(&c, "import_diff", json!({ "slide": slide })).await;
+    assert_that!(first.is_error).is_not_equal_to(Some(true));
+    assert_that!(png_size(&first, 0)).is_equal_to((960, 540));
+    assert_that!(png_size(&first, 1)).is_equal_to((960, 540));
+    let json = diff_json(&first);
+    assert_that!((json["counted"].as_bool(), json["tries_left"].as_u64())).is_equal_to((Some(false), Some(1)));
+    // Une slide modifiée : le diff suivant compte l'essai, le dernier ; puis le refus.
+    let element = first_element(&h, slide);
+    let ops = json!([{ "op": "remove_element", "slide": slide, "element": element }]);
+    let applied = call(&c, "apply", json!({ "label": "Retirer", "ops": ops })).await;
+    assert_that!(applied.is_error).is_not_equal_to(Some(true));
+    let second = diff_json(&call(&c, "import_diff", json!({ "slide": slide })).await);
+    assert_that!((second["counted"].as_bool(), second["tries_left"].as_u64())).is_equal_to((Some(true), Some(0)));
+    let refused = call(&c, "import_diff", json!({ "slide": slide })).await;
+    assert_that!(refused.is_error).is_equal_to(Some(true));
+    assert_that!(text_of(&refused)).contains(slide);
+}
+
+#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
+async fn import_diff_of_a_region_crops_it_at_twice_the_size() {
+    let h = start_imported(ImportTarget::Hifi, |_| {}).await;
+    let c = client(h.server.url(), Some(h.server.authorization())).await.unwrap();
+    let whole = diff_json(&call(&c, "import_diff", json!({ "slide": "s2" })).await);
+    let item = whole["regions"][0]["item"].as_str().unwrap_or_default().to_owned();
+    let zoom = call(&c, "import_diff", json!({ "slide": "s2", "region": item })).await;
+    let json = diff_json(&zoom);
+    let crop: Vec<u32> = (0..4).map(|i| json["crop"][i].as_u64().unwrap_or_default() as u32).collect();
+    assert_that!(png_size(&zoom, 0)).is_equal_to((crop[2] * 2, crop[3] * 2));
+    assert_that!(png_size(&zoom, 1)).is_equal_to((crop[2] * 2, crop[3] * 2));
+    assert_that!(json["region"]["item"].as_str()).is_equal_to(Some(item.as_str()));
+}
+
+#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]
+async fn import_report_retrofit_gives_the_widget_requests_and_import_diff_is_refused() {
+    let target = ImportTarget::Retrofit { pack: "Essentiel".into(), theme: None };
+    let h = start_imported(target, |_| {}).await;
+    let c = client(h.server.url(), Some(h.server.authorization())).await.unwrap();
+    let report = json_of(&call(&c, "import_report", json!({})).await);
+    assert_that!(report["mode"].as_str()).is_equal_to(Some("retrofit"));
+    assert_that!(report["widget_requests"].is_array()).is_true();
+    let r = call(&c, "import_diff", json!({ "slide": "s1" })).await;
+    assert_that!(r.is_error).is_equal_to(Some(true));
+    assert_that!(text_of(&r)).is_equal_to(h.localizer.tr("session-import-tune-hifi-only"));
+}
```

```diff
+use oku_slides_core::Op;
+use oku_slides_reference::Raster;
+use speculoos::prelude::*;
+
+use super::super::{ImportTarget, TuneErrorKind};
+use super::{MARGIN, ZOOM};
+use crate::Request;
+use crate::test_support::{WhiteWitness, fresh_dir, imported_fixture};
+
+/// Le hi-fi de `kitchen` sur une référence blanche, à `tries` essais par slide, et sa
+/// première slide `pending` de la file.
+fn pending(data: &std::path::Path, tries: u32) -> (crate::Session, String) {
+    let mut s = imported_fixture(data, "kitchen", ImportTarget::Hifi, |settings| {
+        settings.import.tune_iterations = std::num::NonZeroU32::new(tries).unwrap();
+    });
+    let report = s.import_report(&WhiteWitness::default(), &crate::Localizer::new(Some("en"))).unwrap();
+    let slides = report["slides"].as_array().unwrap();
+    let pending = slides.iter().find(|e| e["state"] == "pending").unwrap();
+    (s, pending["slide"].as_str().unwrap().to_owned())
+}
+
+/// Retire le `n`-ième élément des slots de `slide` : sa page change.
+fn change(s: &mut crate::Session, slide: &str, n: usize) {
+    let slide_ref = s.deck().slide(slide).unwrap();
+    let element = slide_ref.params.slots().flat_map(|(_, list)| list.iter().map(|e| e.id.clone())).nth(n).unwrap();
+    let ops = vec![Op::RemoveElement { slide: slide.to_owned(), element }];
+    s.handle(Request::Apply { label: "Retirer".into(), ops, merge: None }).unwrap();
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_diff_of_a_whole_slide_gives_both_pages_at_960_px_and_its_regions() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-diff-whole-");
+    let (mut s, slide) = pending(data.path(), 3);
+    let diff = s.import_diff(&slide, None, &WhiteWitness::default()).unwrap();
+    for png in [&diff.reference, &diff.oku] {
+        let r = Raster::from_png(png).unwrap();
+        assert_that!((r.width(), r.height())).is_equal_to((960, 540));
+    }
+    let region = &diff.json["regions"][0];
+    assert_that!(region["item"].is_string()).is_true();
+    assert_that!(region["frame"]["w"].as_f64().unwrap()).is_greater_than(0.0);
+    assert_that!(region["elements"].is_array() || region["param"].is_string()).is_true();
+    assert_that!(diff.json["regions"].as_array().unwrap().len()).is_less_than_or_equal_to(super::LISTED);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_diff_first_look_and_unchanged_page_count_no_try() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-diff-free-");
+    let (mut s, slide) = pending(data.path(), 3);
+    let witness = WhiteWitness::default();
+    for _ in 0..2 {
+        let diff = s.import_diff(&slide, None, &witness).unwrap();
+        assert_that!(diff.json["counted"].as_bool()).is_equal_to(Some(false));
+        assert_that!(diff.json["tries_left"].as_u64()).is_equal_to(Some(3));
+    }
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_diff_after_a_change_counts_a_try_and_is_refused_once_none_is_left() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-diff-tries-");
+    let (mut s, slide) = pending(data.path(), 1);
+    let witness = WhiteWitness::default();
+    s.import_diff(&slide, None, &witness).unwrap();
+    change(&mut s, &slide, 0);
+    let diff = s.import_diff(&slide, None, &witness).unwrap();
+    assert_that!(diff.json["counted"].as_bool()).is_equal_to(Some(true));
+    assert_that!(diff.json["tries_left"].as_u64()).is_equal_to(Some(0));
+    let e = s.import_diff(&slide, None, &witness).unwrap_err();
+    assert_that!(e.tune_kind()).is_equal_to(Some(TuneErrorKind::TriesUsed));
+    // Le zoom reste permis : il ne compte pas.
+    let item = diff.json["regions"][0]["item"].as_str().unwrap().to_owned();
+    assert_that!(s.import_diff(&slide, Some(&item), &witness).is_ok()).is_true();
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_diff_of_a_region_crops_both_pages_around_it_at_twice_the_size() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-diff-zoom-");
+    let (mut s, slide) = pending(data.path(), 3);
+    let witness = WhiteWitness::default();
+    let whole = s.import_diff(&slide, None, &witness).unwrap();
+    let item = whole.json["regions"][0]["item"].as_str().unwrap().to_owned();
+    let zoom = s.import_diff(&slide, Some(&item), &witness).unwrap();
+    let [_, _, w, h] = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(|i| zoom.json["crop"][i].as_u64().unwrap() as u32);
+    for png in [&zoom.reference, &zoom.oku] {
+        let r = Raster::from_png(png).unwrap();
+        assert_that!((r.width(), r.height())).is_equal_to((w * ZOOM, h * ZOOM));
+    }
+    let frame = &zoom.json["region"]["frame"];
+    // Le cadre (pt, à 0,5 px par pt) plus la marge de chaque côté, borné à la page.
+    let expected_w = ((frame["w"].as_f64().unwrap() * 0.5).round() as u32 + 2 * MARGIN).min(960);
+    assert_that!(w).is_less_than_or_equal_to(expected_w);
+    assert_that!(zoom.json["region"]["item"].as_str()).is_equal_to(Some(item.as_str()));
+    // Le zoom ne compte pas d'essai.
+    let again = s.import_diff(&slide, None, &witness).unwrap();
+    assert_that!(again.json["tries_left"].as_u64()).is_equal_to(Some(3));
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_diff_of_an_unknown_slide_or_region_is_refused() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-diff-unknown-");
+    let (mut s, slide) = pending(data.path(), 3);
+    let witness = WhiteWitness::default();
+    let e = s.import_diff("nope", None, &witness).unwrap_err();
+    assert_that!(e.tune_kind()).is_equal_to(Some(TuneErrorKind::UnknownSlide));
+    let e = s.import_diff(&slide, Some("nope"), &witness).unwrap_err();
+    assert_that!(e.tune_kind()).is_equal_to(Some(TuneErrorKind::UnknownRegion));
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_diff_of_a_retrofit_import_is_refused() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-diff-retrofit-");
+    let target = ImportTarget::Retrofit { pack: "Essentiel".into(), theme: None };
+    let mut s = imported_fixture(data.path(), "minimal", target, |_| {});
+    let slide = s.deck().slides[0].id.clone();
+    let e = s.import_diff(&slide, None, &WhiteWitness::default()).unwrap_err();
+    assert_that!(e.tune_kind()).is_equal_to(Some(TuneErrorKind::HifiOnly));
+}
```

```diff
+use oku_slides_core::Op;

+fn hifi(data: &std::path::Path) -> crate::Session {
+    imported_fixture(data, "kitchen", ImportTarget::Hifi, |_| {})
+}

+fn entry<'v>(report: &'v Value, id: &str) -> Option<&'v Value> {
+    report["slides"].as_array()?.iter().find(|s| s["slide"] == id)
+}
+
+#[test]

+    assert_that!(report["mode"].as_str()).is_equal_to(Some("hifi"));
+    assert_that!(report["witness"].as_str()).is_equal_to(Some("témoin 1.0"));
+    assert_that!(report["tries_per_slide"].as_u64()).is_equal_to(Some(3));
+    let slides = report["slides"].as_array().unwrap();
+    let listed = slides.len() as u64 + report["done"].as_u64().unwrap();
+    assert_that!(listed).is_equal_to(3);

+    assert_that!(worst.windows(2).all(|w| w[0] >= w[1])).is_true();

+    assert_that!(pending["tries_left"].as_u64()).is_equal_to(Some(3));
+    assert_that!(report.get("worse")).is_none();

+}

+    let witness = WhiteWitness::default();
+    let first = s.import_report(&witness, &crate::Localizer::new(Some("en"))).unwrap();
+    let slide = first["slides"][0]["slide"].as_str().unwrap().to_owned();
+    // Sur une référence blanche, retirer les éléments de la pire région rapproche la slide ;
+    // l'annuler l'en éloigne.
+    let diff = s.import_diff(&slide, None, &witness).unwrap();
+    let elements = diff.json["regions"][0]["elements"].as_array().unwrap().clone();
+    assert_that!(elements).is_not_empty();
+    let ops: Vec<Op> = elements
+        .iter()
+        .map(|e| Op::RemoveElement { slide: slide.clone(), element: e.as_str().unwrap().to_owned() })
+        .collect();
+    s.handle(Request::Apply { label: "Retirer".into(), ops, merge: None }).unwrap();
+    let better = s.import_report(&witness, &crate::Localizer::new(Some("en"))).unwrap();

+    s.handle(Request::Undo).unwrap();

+    assert_that!(worse["worse"].as_array().unwrap().iter().any(|w| w == slide.as_str())).is_true();

+    assert_that!(report["losses"]["total"].is_u64()).is_true();
+    assert_that!(witness.calls.get()).is_equal_to(0);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_reference_job_is_none_in_retrofit_and_once_done_in_hifi() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-queue-job-");
+    let mut s = hifi(data.path());

+    assert_that!(s.import_reference_job().unwrap()).is_none();
+    let target = ImportTarget::Retrofit { pack: "Essentiel".into(), theme: None };
+    let mut r = imported_fixture(data.path(), "minimal", target, |_| {});
+    assert_that!(r.import_reference_job().unwrap()).is_none();
+}
```

```diff
+use rstest::rstest;
+use speculoos::prelude::*;
+
+use super::*;
+
+#[rstest]
+#[case(NoImportSnafu.build(), TuneErrorKind::NoImport, "session-import-tune-none", "Aucun import")]
+#[case(HifiOnlySnafu.build(), TuneErrorKind::HifiOnly, "session-import-tune-hifi-only", "retrofit")]
+#[case(
+    NoReferenceSnafu { cause: ReferenceCause::Timeout }.build(),
+    TuneErrorKind::NoReference,
+    "session-import-tune-no-reference",
+    "trop de temps"
+)]
+#[case(UnknownSlideSnafu { slide: "s9" }.build(), TuneErrorKind::UnknownSlide, "session-import-tune-unknown-slide", "s9")]
+#[case(
+    UnknownRegionSnafu { slide: "s1", region: "s1/42" }.build(),
+    TuneErrorKind::UnknownRegion,
+    "session-import-tune-unknown-region",
+    "s1/42"
+)]
+#[case(TriesUsedSnafu { slide: "s2", tries: 3u32 }.build(), TuneErrorKind::TriesUsed, "session-import-tune-tries-used", "s2")]
+#[case(CompareSnafu { detail: "x" }.build(), TuneErrorKind::Compare, "session-import-tune-compare", "")]
+fn tune_error_has_its_kind_and_a_french_message(
+    #[case] inner: TuneInner,
+    #[case] kind: TuneErrorKind,
+    #[case] key: &str,
+    #[case] fragment: &str,
+) {
+    let e = TuneError::from(inner);
+    assert_that!(e.kind()).is_equal_to(kind);
+    let fr = Localizer::new(Some("fr"));
+    let localized = e.localize(&fr);
+    assert_that!(fr.has(key)).is_true();
+    assert_that!(localized.as_str()).contains(fragment);
+    assert_that!(localized.as_str()).does_not_contain("session-import");
+}
```

```diff
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/tune_tests.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,97 @@
+use oku_slides_import::metrics::{RegionScore, WitnessLimit};
+use rstest::rstest;
+use speculoos::prelude::*;
+
+use super::*;
+
+const LIMITS: TuneLimits = TuneLimits { tries: 3, stall: 2 };
+const THRESHOLD: f64 = 7.0;
+
+/// Une slide notée : ses régions `(score, suspecte)`, déjà classées.
+fn scored(regions: &[(f64, bool)]) -> SlideScore {
+    let regions = regions
+        .iter()
+        .enumerate()
+        .map(|(i, &(score, suspect))| RegionScore {
+            item: format!("s1/{i}"),
+            score,
+            shift: [0, 0],
+            suspect: suspect.then_some(WitnessLimit::Chart),
+        })
+        .collect();
+    SlideScore { score: 1.0, regions }
+}
+
+fn tuning(tries: u32, without_gain: u32) -> Tuning {
+    Tuning { tries, best: Some(9.0), without_gain, diffed: Some(1) }
+}
+
+#[rstest]
+#[case::above_with_tries_left(&[(9.0, false)], None, SlideState::Pending)]
+#[case::under_the_threshold(&[(6.0, false), (3.0, true)], None, SlideState::Done)]
+#[case::only_a_suspect_above(&[(6.0, false), (12.0, true)], None, SlideState::Witness)]
+#[case::only_suspects_all_above(&[(12.0, true)], None, SlideState::Witness)]
+#[case::no_region(&[], None, SlideState::Done)]
+#[case::every_try_used(&[(9.0, false)], Some(tuning(3, 0)), SlideState::Exhausted)]
+#[case::two_tries_without_gain(&[(9.0, false)], Some(tuning(2, 2)), SlideState::Stalled)]
+#[case::stalled_wins_over_exhausted(&[(9.0, false)], Some(tuning(3, 2)), SlideState::Stalled)]
+#[case::done_after_every_try(&[(5.0, false)], Some(tuning(3, 2)), SlideState::Done)]
+fn state_of_a_scored_slide_follows_its_worst_region_and_tries(
+    #[case] regions: &[(f64, bool)],
+    #[case] tries: Option<Tuning>,
+    #[case] expected: SlideState,
+) {
+    let score = scored(regions);
+    assert_that!(SlideState::of(Some(&score), tries.as_ref(), THRESHOLD, LIMITS)).is_equal_to(expected);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn state_without_a_score_is_unscored() {
+    assert_that!(SlideState::of(None, None, THRESHOLD, LIMITS)).is_equal_to(SlideState::Unscored);
+}
+
+#[rstest]
+#[case::fresh(SlideState::Pending, None, 3)]
+#[case::one_try(SlideState::Pending, Some(tuning(1, 0)), 2)]
+#[case::stalled(SlideState::Stalled, Some(tuning(2, 2)), 0)]
+#[case::exhausted(SlideState::Exhausted, Some(tuning(3, 1)), 0)]
+fn tries_left_counts_down_and_is_zero_once_stalled(
+    #[case] state: SlideState,
+    #[case] tries: Option<Tuning>,
+    #[case] expected: u32,
+) {
+    assert_that!(state.tries_left(tries.as_ref(), LIMITS)).is_equal_to(expected);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn observe_first_diff_is_the_free_baseline() {
+    let mut t = Tuning::default();
+    assert_that!(t.observe(1, 9.0)).is_false();
+    assert_that!(t).is_equal_to(Tuning { tries: 0, best: Some(9.0), without_gain: 0, diffed: Some(1) });
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn observe_unchanged_page_is_not_a_try() {
+    let mut t = Tuning::default();
+    t.observe(1, 9.0);
+    assert_that!(t.observe(1, 9.0)).is_false();
+    assert_that!((t.tries, t.without_gain)).is_equal_to((0, 0));
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn observe_changed_page_with_a_gain_is_a_try_that_resets_the_streak() {
+    let mut t = Tuning::default();
+    t.observe(1, 9.0);
+    t.observe(2, 9.5);
+    assert_that!(t.observe(3, 8.0)).is_true();
+    assert_that!(t).is_equal_to(Tuning { tries: 2, best: Some(8.0), without_gain: 0, diffed: Some(3) });
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn observe_changed_page_without_gain_extends_the_streak() {
+    let mut t = Tuning::default();
+    t.observe(1, 9.0);
+    t.observe(2, 9.0);
+    t.observe(3, 9.4);
+    assert_that!(t).is_equal_to(Tuning { tries: 2, best: Some(9.0), without_gain: 2, diffed: Some(3) });
+}
```

```diff
--- a/crates/oku-slides-session/src/test_support.rs
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/test_support.rs
@@ -248,3 +248,63 @@ pub(crate) fn pptx_fixture(dir: &std::path::Path, name: &str) -> std::path::Path
     std::fs::write(&path, bytes).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("{e}"));
     path
 }
+
+/// Un PNG blanc de `width` × `height` pixels.
+pub(crate) fn white_png(width: u32, height: u32) -> Vec<u8> {
+    let mut out = Vec::new();
+    let mut encoder = png::Encoder::new(&mut out, width, height);
+    encoder.set_color(png::ColorType::Rgba);
+    encoder.set_depth(png::BitDepth::Eight);
+    let mut writer = encoder.write_header().unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("png : {e}"));
+    writer.write_image_data(&vec![255; width as usize * height as usize * 4]).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("png : {e}"));
+    writer.finish().unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("png : {e}"));
+    out
+}
+
+/// Un témoin de test aux pages blanches, de proportion 16:9 (celle des fixtures d'import) ; compte ses appels.
+#[derive(Debug, Default)]
+pub(crate) struct WhiteWitness {
+    pub(crate) calls: std::cell::Cell<usize>,
+}
+
+impl crate::import::Witness for WhiteWitness {
+    fn name(&self) -> &str {
+        "témoin"
+    }
+
+    fn limits(&self) -> oku_slides_import::metrics::Witness {
+        oku_slides_import::metrics::Witness::Office2Pdf
+    }
+
+    fn render(
+        &self,
+        _: &[u8],
+        _: &Fonts,
+        span: oku_slides_reference::SlideSpan,
+        width: u32,
+    ) -> Result<crate::import::WitnessPages, oku_slides_render::RenderError> {
+        self.calls.set(self.calls.get() + 1);
+        let count = (span.last - span.first + 1) as usize;
+        let height = (f64::from(width) * 9.0 / 16.0).round() as u32;
+        let pages = (0..count).map(|_| white_png(width, height)).collect();
+        Ok(crate::import::WitnessPages { witness: "témoin 1.0".to_owned(), count, pages })
+    }
+}
+
+/// Une session sur `data`, chargée de l'import de la fixture `name` vers `target` ; réglages retouchés par `tweak`.
+pub(crate) fn imported_fixture(
+    data: &std::path::Path,
+    name: &str,
+    target: crate::import::ImportTarget,
+    tweak: impl FnOnce(&mut Settings),
+) -> Session {
+    let mut settings = settings_on(data);
+    tweak(&mut settings);
+    let platform = Platform::with_settings(settings.clone()).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("plateforme : {e}"));
+    let request = crate::import::ImportRequest { pptx: pptx_fixture(data, name), target, system_fonts: false };
+    let imported = crate::import::import(&platform, &Fonts::default(), &request)
+        .unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("import : {}", e.one_line()));
+    let mut s = session_with(settings);
+    s.load_import(imported, name).unwrap_or_else(|e| panic!("chargement : {}", e.one_line()));
+    s
+}
```

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-import/src/hifi/groups.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+//! Les groupes source répétés d'une présentation : candidats hi-fi à un
+//! widget d'élément du pack généré.
+//!
+//! Un groupe de premier niveau d'une slide (pas un SmartArt dessiné, qui
+//! reste tel quel) a la signature de ses enfants ([`signature`]) ; une
+//! signature présente sur [`GROUP_MIN_SLIDES`] slides au moins fait un
+//! candidat. L'agent le propose à l'utilisateur ; rien n'est changé ici.
+
+use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
+
+use crate::pattern::signature;
+use crate::plan::GroupCandidate;
+use crate::source::{ItemKind, SourceDeck};
+
+/// Slides distinctes, au moins, où un groupe doit se répéter pour être candidat.
+pub const GROUP_MIN_SLIDES: usize = 3;
+
+/// Les groupes répétés de `deck`, les plus répandus d'abord, puis par signature.
+///
+/// Chaque occurrence nomme la slide Oku (`s<numéro>`) et l'item source du groupe.
+pub(crate) fn repeated(deck: &SourceDeck) -> Vec<GroupCandidate> {
+    let mut by_signature: BTreeMap<String, Vec<(String, String)>> = BTreeMap::new();
+    for slide in &deck.slides {
+        for item in &slide.items {
+            if let ItemKind::Group { items, smartart: None } = &item.kind
+                && !items.is_empty()
+            {
+                let occurrence = (format!("s{}", slide.number), item.id.clone());
+                by_signature.entry(signature(items)).or_default().push(occurrence);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let mut groups: Vec<GroupCandidate> = by_signature
+        .into_iter()
+        .filter(|(_, occurrences)| {
+            occurrences.iter().map(|(slide, _)| slide).collect::<BTreeSet<_>>().len() >= GROUP_MIN_SLIDES
+        })
+        .map(|(signature, occurrences)| GroupCandidate { signature, occurrences })
+        .collect();
+    groups.sort_by(|a, b| b.occurrences.len().cmp(&a.occurrences.len()).then_with(|| a.signature.cmp(&b.signature)));
+    groups
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+#[path = "groups_tests.rs"]
+mod groups_tests;
```

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-mcp/src/import_tools.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+//! Outils de l'ajustement d'un import par l'agent : `import_report` (le
+//! rapport et la file des slides) et `import_diff` (une slide, ou une de ses
+//! régions, contre sa référence).
+//!
+//! Le rendu de référence (le témoin, dans son propre processus de rendu) est
+//! fait au premier besoin, hors du verrou de la session : la session donne le
+//! travail ([`Session::import_reference_job`]), il tourne dans une tâche
+//! bloquante, puis son résultat lui revient. Le reste passe par
+//! `with_session`, un appel de la session à la fois. Les refus (pas d'import,
+//! plus d'essai…) sont ceux de la session, localisés.
+//!
+//! [`Session::import_reference_job`]: oku_slides_session::Session::import_reference_job
+
+use oku_slides_session::import::{ImportDiff, app_witness};
+use rust_mcp_sdk::schema::{CallToolResult, TextContent};
+use schemars::JsonSchema;
+use serde::Deserialize;
+use serde_json::Value;
+use snafu::ResultExt;
+
+use crate::tool_error::{ResponseSnafu, TaskSnafu, ToolError};
+use crate::tools::{Tools, png};
+
+#[derive(Debug, Deserialize, JsonSchema)]
+pub(crate) struct ImportDiffArgs {
+    /// Identifiant de la slide (voir `import_report`).
+    pub slide: String,
+    /// Une région : l'id d'item source d'une région de la slide (voir `import_diff`) ; sans elle, la slide entière.
+    #[serde(default)]
+    pub region: Option<String>,
+}
+
+impl Tools {
+    /// Fait le rendu de référence de l'import s'il manque, hors du verrou de la session.
+    async fn ensure_reference(&self) -> Result<(), ToolError> {
+        let Some(job) = self.with_session(|s| s.import_reference_job()).await? else { return Ok(()) };
+        let platform = self.platform.clone();
+        let done = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || job.run(&app_witness(&platform))).await.context(TaskSnafu)?;
+        self.with_session(move |s| {
+            s.import_reference_done(done);
+            Ok(())
+        })
+        .await
+    }
+
+    pub(crate) async fn import_report(&self) -> CallToolResult {
+        if let Err(e) = self.ensure_reference().await {
+            return self.fail_with(e);
+        }
+        let (platform, l) = (self.platform.clone(), self.localizer.current());
+        let report = self.with_session(move |s| s.import_report(&app_witness(&platform), &l)).await;
+        self.reply(report, |v: Value| self.json_result(&v))
+    }
+
+    pub(crate) async fn import_diff(&self, args: Value) -> CallToolResult {
+        let ImportDiffArgs { slide, region } = match self.parse(args) {
+            Ok(a) => a,
+            Err(r) => return r,
+        };
+        if let Err(e) = self.ensure_reference().await {
+            return self.fail_with(e);
+        }
+        let platform = self.platform.clone();
+        let diff = self.with_session(move |s| s.import_diff(&slide, region.as_deref(), &app_witness(&platform))).await;
+        let ImportDiff { reference, oku, json } = match diff {
+            Ok(d) => d,
+            Err(e) => return self.fail_with(e),
+        };
+        let text = match serde_json::to_string(&json).context(ResponseSnafu) {
+            Ok(t) => t,
+            Err(e) => return self.fail_with(e),
+        };
+        let mut result = png(&reference);
+        result.content.extend(png(&oku).content);
+        result.content.push(TextContent::new(text, None, None).into());
+        result
+    }
+}
```

```diff
+    /// L'image agrandie `factor` fois, chaque pixel répété en carré (plus proche voisin).
+    ///
+    /// Les pixels restent ceux de l'image : deux images agrandies ainsi se comparent comme
+    /// avant. Un facteur nul vaut 1 ; un côté qui dépasserait [`MAX_RASTER_SIDE`] est une erreur `Size`.
+    pub fn scaled(&self, factor: u32) -> Result<Self, ReferenceError> {
+        let factor = factor.max(1);
+        let (width, height) = (self.width.saturating_mul(factor), self.height.saturating_mul(factor));
+        ensure!(width <= MAX_RASTER_SIDE && height <= MAX_RASTER_SIDE, SizeSnafu { width, height });
+        let (k, row) = (factor as usize, self.width as usize * 4);
+        let mut rgba = Vec::with_capacity(width as usize * height as usize * 4);
+        for line in self.rgba.chunks_exact(row) {
+            let wide: Vec<u8> =
+                line.as_chunks::<4>().0.iter().flat_map(|px| std::iter::repeat_n(*px, k)).flatten().collect();
+            for _ in 0..k {
+                rgba.extend_from_slice(&wide);
+            }
+        }
+        Ok(Self { width, height, rgba })
+    }
+
```

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/diff.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,180 @@
+//! Le diff d'une slide importée (`import_diff`) : sa page de référence et sa
+//! page Oku rendue maintenant, la note qui en sort et l'essai qu'il compte.
+//!
+//! Sans région : les deux pages entières (la page source, [`super::REFERENCE_WIDTH`]
+//! pixels de large), la slide notée de nouveau, un essai compté si sa page a
+//! changé depuis le diff précédent ([`super::tune`]) ; refusé quand il n'en
+//! reste plus. Avec une région (un item source de la slide) : les deux
+//! rognures de son cadre, à [`MARGIN`] pixels de marge (bornée à la page),
+//! agrandies [`ZOOM`] fois ; rien n'est noté ni compté.
+//!
+//! Les cadres sont en pt de la page Oku : en hi-fi, la zone de corps est la
+//! page (marges nulles), ce sont donc les cadres des éléments pour `apply`.
+
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+
+use serde_json::{Value, json};
+
+use oku_slides_core::Frame;
+use oku_slides_import::metrics::{RegionScore, SlideScore};
+use oku_slides_import::report::ReferenceCause;
+use oku_slides_reference::Raster;
+
+use super::queue::{LISTED, compare_failed, element_ids, refused};
+use super::reference::Witness;
+use super::state::SlideRegion;
+use super::tune::SlideState;
+use super::tune_error::{HifiOnlySnafu, NoReferenceSnafu, TriesUsedSnafu, UnknownRegionSnafu, UnknownSlideSnafu};
+use super::{ImportMode, ImportState};
+use crate::{Result, Session};
+
+/// Agrandissement des rognures d'une région.
+pub const ZOOM: u32 = 2;
+
+/// Marge autour du cadre d'une région rognée, en pixels de la page source (avant agrandissement).
+pub const MARGIN: u32 = 16;
+
+/// Le diff d'une slide : deux images PNG, puis le JSON qui les accompagne.
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct ImportDiff {
+    /// L'image de référence : la page entière, ou la rognure de la région.
+    pub reference: Vec<u8>,
+    /// L'image Oku, rendue maintenant, au même cadre.
+    pub oku: Vec<u8>,
+    /// La note et l'état de la slide, ou la région montrée.
+    pub json: Value,
+}
+
+impl Session {
+    /// Compare la slide `slide` à sa référence, ou seulement sa région `region` (un item source).
+    ///
+    /// La référence est faite par `witness` si elle manque encore (voir
+    /// [`Self::import_reference_job`]). Refusé hors hi-fi, pour une slide ou une
+    /// région inconnue, et pour un diff entier quand la slide n'a plus d'essai.
+    pub fn import_diff(&mut self, slide: &str, region: Option<&str>, witness: &dyn Witness) -> Result<ImportDiff> {
+        let state = self.tuned_import()?;
+        if state.mode() != ImportMode::Hifi {
+            return Err(refused(HifiOnlySnafu.build()));
+        }
+        if let Err(cause) = state.reference(witness) {
+            return Err(refused(NoReferenceSnafu { cause }.build()));
+        }
+        state.settle_reference_report();
+        let unknown = || refused(UnknownSlideSnafu { slide }.build());
+        let report = state.report().slides.iter().find(|r| r.slide == slide).ok_or_else(unknown)?;
+        if region.is_none() {
+            let (tuning, limits) = (state.tuning(slide), state.limits());
+            let current = SlideState::of(report.score.as_ref(), tuning, state.threshold(), limits);
+            if current.tries_left(tuning, limits) == 0 {
+                let tries = tuning.map_or(0, |t| t.tries);
+                return Err(refused(TriesUsedSnafu { slide, tries }.build()));
+            }
+        }
+        let ppp = state.pixel_per_pt();
+        // Une slide supprimée depuis l'import n'a plus de page.
+        let page = self.page_of(slide).map(|p| p - 1).ok_or_else(unknown)?;
+        let (png, hash) = self.with_compiled(|c| Ok((c.png(page, ppp)?, c.page_hash(page))))?;
+        let oku = Raster::from_png(&png).map_err(|e| compare_failed((ReferenceCause::Failed, e.to_string())))?;
+        let state = self.tuned_import()?;
+        match region {
+            None => {
+                let hash =
+                    hash.ok_or_else(|| compare_failed((ReferenceCause::Failed, format!("{slide} sans empreinte"))))?;
+                whole(state, slide, &oku, hash)
+            }
+            Some(item) => zoom(state, slide, item, &oku),
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// Le diff entier : la slide notée de nouveau, l'essai noté, les deux pages.
+fn whole(state: &mut ImportState, slide: &str, oku: &Raster, hash: u128) -> Result<ImportDiff> {
+    let score = state.rescore(slide, oku, hash).map_err(compare_failed)?;
+    let counted = state.tuning_mut(slide).observe(hash, score.worst().unwrap_or(0.0));
+    let (refr, oku) = state.pair(slide, oku).map_err(compare_failed)?;
+    let (tuning, limits, threshold) = (state.tuning(slide), state.limits(), state.threshold());
+    let current = SlideState::of(Some(&score), tuning, threshold, limits);
+    let json = json!({
+        "slide": slide,
+        "score": score.score,
+        "worst": score.worst(),
+        "threshold": threshold,
+        "state": current,
+        "tries_left": current.tries_left(tuning, limits),
+        "counted": counted,
+        "regions": ranked(state, slide, &score),
+        "regions_more": score.regions.len().saturating_sub(LISTED),
+        "suspect": score.regions.iter().filter(|r| r.suspect.is_some()).count(),
+    });
+    Ok(ImportDiff { reference: png(&refr)?, oku: png(&oku)?, json })
+}
+
+/// Les [`LISTED`] premières régions classées de `score`, avec leur cadre et leur cible.
+fn ranked(state: &ImportState, slide: &str, score: &SlideScore) -> Vec<Value> {
+    let regions: BTreeMap<String, SlideRegion> =
+        state.regions(slide).into_iter().map(|r| (r.item.clone(), r)).collect();
+    score.regions.iter().take(LISTED).map(|r| region_json(state, regions.get(&r.item), Some(r), &r.item)).collect()
+}
+
+/// Une région : son item, sa note s'il y en a une, son cadre (pt de la page Oku) et ce qui la corrige.
+fn region_json(state: &ImportState, region: Option<&SlideRegion>, score: Option<&RegionScore>, item: &str) -> Value {
+    let mut v = json!({ "item": item });
+    let Some(o) = v.as_object_mut() else { return v };
+    if let Some(s) = score {
+        o.insert("score".into(), json!(s.score));
+        o.insert("shift".into(), json!(s.shift));
+    }
+    if let Some(limit) = score.and_then(|s| s.suspect).or(region.and_then(|r| r.suspect)) {
+        o.insert("suspect".into(), json!(limit));
+    }
+    if let Some(r) = region {
+        let round = |v: f64| (v * 100.0).round() / 100.0;
+        let Frame { x, y, w, h } = r.frame;
+        o.insert("frame".into(), json!({ "x": round(x), "y": round(y), "w": round(w), "h": round(h) }));
+        match state.target(item) {
+            Some(oku_slides_import::plan::ItemTarget::Param(param)) => {
+                o.insert("param".into(), json!(param));
+            }
+            target => {
+                o.insert("elements".into(), json!(element_ids(target)));
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    v
+}
+
+/// Le zoom : les deux rognures du cadre de la région `item`, agrandies ; rien n'est noté.
+fn zoom(state: &ImportState, slide: &str, item: &str, oku: &Raster) -> Result<ImportDiff> {
+    let unknown = || refused(UnknownRegionSnafu { slide, region: item }.build());
+    let region = state.regions(slide).into_iter().find(|r| r.item == item).ok_or_else(unknown)?;
+    let (refr, oku) = state.pair(slide, oku).map_err(compare_failed)?;
+    let [x, y, w, h] = state.frame_px(region.frame);
+    let (width, height) = (refr.width(), refr.height());
+    if width == 0 || height == 0 {
+        return Err(compare_failed((ReferenceCause::Failed, format!("{slide} : page vide"))));
+    }
+    // Bornée à la page, et d'un pixel au moins : un cadre hors de la page montre son bord.
+    let (x0, y0) = (x.saturating_sub(MARGIN).min(width - 1), y.saturating_sub(MARGIN).min(height - 1));
+    let x1 = x.saturating_add(w).saturating_add(MARGIN).clamp(x0 + 1, width);
+    let y1 = y.saturating_add(h).saturating_add(MARGIN).clamp(y0 + 1, height);
+    let crop = |r: &Raster| r.crop(x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0).scaled(ZOOM);
+    let image = |r: &Raster| crop(r).map_err(|e| compare_failed((ReferenceCause::Failed, e.to_string())));
+    let score = state.report().slides.iter().find(|r| r.slide == slide).and_then(|r| r.score.as_ref());
+    let scored = score.and_then(|s| s.regions.iter().find(|r| r.item == item));
+    let json = json!({
+        "slide": slide,
+        "zoom": ZOOM,
+        "crop": [x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0],
+        "region": region_json(state, Some(&region), scored, item),
+    });
+    Ok(ImportDiff { reference: png(&image(&refr)?)?, oku: png(&image(&oku)?)?, json })
+}
+
+/// `r` en PNG ; un échec est un refus `Compare`.
+fn png(r: &Raster) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
+    r.to_png().map_err(|e| compare_failed((ReferenceCause::Failed, e.to_string())))
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+#[path = "diff_tests.rs"]
+mod diff_tests;
```

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/queue.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,269 @@
+//! L'ajustement d'un import par l'agent : le rapport et la file des slides
+//! (`import_report`), servis par la session de l'onglet importé.
+//!
+//! Hi-fi : chaque slide dont la page Oku a changé depuis sa dernière note
+//! (toutes au premier appel) est notée de nouveau sur le rendu courant ; une
+//! modification du thème, d'un widget du pack ou d'une slide se voit donc au
+//! rapport suivant, qui nomme les slides dont la pire région a monté
+//! (`worse`). Le JSON reste court : une file des slides pas encore `done`,
+//! au plus [`LISTED`] éléments par liste annexe, le reste compté.
+
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+
+use serde_json::{Value, json};
+use snafu::IntoError;
+
+use oku_slides_i18n::{Localize, Localizer};
+use oku_slides_import::plan::ItemTarget;
+use oku_slides_import::report::{LossKind, ReferenceCause};
+use oku_slides_reference::Raster;
+
+use super::reference::{ReferenceDone, ReferenceJob, Witness};
+use super::tune::SlideState;
+use super::tune_error::{CompareSnafu, NoImportSnafu, TuneError, TuneInner};
+use super::{ImportMode, ImportState};
+use crate::error::{EditingTemplatesSnafu, InHistorySnafu, ReadOnlySnafu, TuneSnafu};
+use crate::{Mode, Result, Session, SessionError};
+
+/// Éléments d'une liste annexe du rapport (pertes figées, groupes, régions), au plus.
+pub const LISTED: usize = 8;
+
+/// Le refus `inner` d'un outil d'ajustement, en erreur de la session.
+pub(crate) fn refused(inner: TuneInner) -> SessionError {
+    TuneSnafu.into_error(TuneError::from(inner)).into()
+}
+
+/// L'échec d'une comparaison : son détail au journal, un refus `Compare` à l'agent.
+pub(crate) fn compare_failed((cause, detail): (ReferenceCause, String)) -> SessionError {
+    tracing::warn!(?cause, error = %detail, "comparaison à la référence impossible");
+    refused(CompareSnafu { detail }.build())
+}
+
+/// Les ids d'éléments de `target`, vides pour un paramètre de slide.
+pub(crate) fn element_ids(target: Option<&ItemTarget>) -> &[String] {
+    match target {
+        Some(ItemTarget::Elements(ids)) => ids,
+        _ => &[],
+    }
+}
+
+impl Session {
+    /// L'import de l'onglet, sur le deck montré ; sinon le refus qui convient.
+    pub(crate) fn tuned_import(&mut self) -> Result<&mut ImportState> {
+        match self.mode {
+            Mode::Deck => {}
+            Mode::Templates { .. } => return EditingTemplatesSnafu.fail()?,
+            Mode::History { .. } => return InHistorySnafu.fail()?,
+            Mode::Help { .. } => return ReadOnlySnafu.fail()?,
+        }
+        self.import.as_mut().ok_or_else(|| refused(NoImportSnafu.build()))
+    }
+
+    /// Le rendu de référence de l'import à faire hors du verrou de la session, s'il manque.
+    ///
+    /// `None` en retrofit, ou s'il est déjà fait ; sans import dans l'onglet, le refus `NoImport`.
+    pub fn import_reference_job(&mut self) -> Result<Option<ReferenceJob>> {
+        let state = self.tuned_import()?;
+        Ok(match state.mode() {
+            ImportMode::Hifi => state.reference_job(),
+            ImportMode::Retrofit => None,
+        })
+    }
+
+    /// Garde le rendu de référence fait hors du verrou ; sans effet si l'onglet n'a plus d'import.
+    pub fn import_reference_done(&mut self, done: ReferenceDone) {
+        if let Some(state) = self.import.as_mut() {
+            state.set_reference(done);
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// Le rapport de l'import et la file de l'ajustement, en JSON pour l'agent.
+    ///
+    /// Hi-fi : la référence est faite par `witness` si elle manque encore
+    /// (l'app la fait d'abord hors du verrou, [`Self::import_reference_job`]) ;
+    /// les slides dont la page a changé depuis leur dernière note sont notées
+    /// de nouveau. Aucun essai n'est compté. `l` : la langue de l'agent, celle
+    /// d'une référence manquante.
+    pub fn import_report(&mut self, witness: &dyn Witness, l: &Localizer) -> Result<Value> {
+        self.tuned_import()?;
+        self.ensure_rendered()?;
+        let rescored = match self.import.as_ref().map(ImportState::mode) {
+            Some(ImportMode::Hifi) => Some(self.rescore_changed(witness)?),
+            _ => None,
+        };
+        let state = self.tuned_import()?;
+        let mut v = common_json(state);
+        let extra = match (state.mode(), rescored) {
+            (ImportMode::Hifi, Some(rescored)) => hifi_json(state, &rescored, l),
+            _ => retrofit_json(state),
+        };
+        if let (Some(o), Value::Object(extra)) = (v.as_object_mut(), extra) {
+            o.extend(extra);
+        }
+        Ok(v)
+    }
+
+    /// Note de nouveau, contre la référence, chaque slide dont la page Oku a changé.
+    fn rescore_changed(&mut self, witness: &dyn Witness) -> Result<Rescored> {
+        let state = self.tuned_import()?;
+        if state.reference(witness).is_err() {
+            state.settle_reference_report();
+            return Ok(Rescored::default());
+        }
+        let before = state.report().mean_score();
+        let slides: Vec<String> = state.report().slides.iter().map(|r| r.slide.clone()).collect();
+        let ppp = state.pixel_per_pt();
+        let mut rescored = Rescored::default();
+        for slide in slides {
+            // Une slide supprimée depuis l'import n'a plus de page : elle sort de la file.
+            let Some(page) = self.page_of(&slide).map(|p| p - 1) else { continue };
+            let hash = self.compiled.as_ref().and_then(|c| c.page_hash(page));
+            let state = self.tuned_import()?;
+            if hash.is_some() && hash == state.scored_page(&slide) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            let (png, hash) = self.with_compiled(|c| Ok((c.png(page, ppp)?, c.page_hash(page))))?;
+            let oku = Raster::from_png(&png).map_err(|e| compare_failed((ReferenceCause::Failed, e.to_string())))?;
+            let state = self.tuned_import()?;
+            let old = state.report().slides.iter().find(|r| r.slide == slide).and_then(|r| r.score.clone());
+            let hash =
+                hash.ok_or_else(|| compare_failed((ReferenceCause::Failed, format!("{slide} sans empreinte"))))?;
+            let new = state.rescore(&slide, &oku, hash).map_err(compare_failed)?;
+            if let (Some(old), Some(new)) = (old.as_ref().and_then(|s| s.worst()), new.worst())
+                && new > old
+            {
+                rescored.worse.push(slide.clone());
+            }
+            rescored.again |= old.is_some();
+        }
+        let state = self.tuned_import()?;
+        state.settle_reference_report();
+        rescored.before = before.filter(|_| rescored.again);
+        Ok(rescored)
+    }
+}
+
+/// Ce qu'a changé une nouvelle note des slides modifiées.
+#[derive(Debug, Default)]
+struct Rescored {
+    /// Une slide déjà notée l'a été de nouveau.
+    again: bool,
+    /// La moyenne d'avant, s'il y en avait une et qu'une slide notée l'a été de nouveau.
+    before: Option<f64>,
+    /// Les slides dont la pire région non suspecte a monté.
+    worse: Vec<String>,
+}
+
+/// Les champs des deux modes : le mode, les pertes comptées par sorte, les items figés.
+fn common_json(state: &ImportState) -> Value {
+    let report = state.report();
+    let mut kinds: BTreeMap<String, usize> = BTreeMap::new();
+    let mut frozen = Vec::new();
+    for slide in &report.slides {
+        for loss in &slide.losses {
+            // Une perte s'écrit toujours `{"type": …}` : sa sorte est ce nom.
+            let kind = serde_json::to_value(&loss.kind).ok().and_then(|v| Some(v.get("type")?.as_str()?.to_owned()));
+            match kind {
+                Some(kind) => *kinds.entry(kind).or_default() += 1,
+                None => tracing::warn!(?loss, "perte sans sorte écrite"),
+            }
+            if let (LossKind::Opaque(_), Some(item)) = (&loss.kind, &loss.item) {
+                frozen.push(json!({ "slide": slide.slide, "item": item }));
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    let more = frozen.len().saturating_sub(LISTED);
+    frozen.truncate(LISTED);
+    json!({
+        "mode": state.mode(),
+        "losses": { "total": report.loss_count(), "by_kind": kinds },
+        "frozen": frozen,
+        "frozen_more": more,
+    })
+}
+
+/// Le retrofit : les demandes de widget (motif, slides, repli employé).
+fn retrofit_json(state: &ImportState) -> Value {
+    let requests: Vec<Value> = state
+        .widget_requests()
+        .iter()
+        .map(|r| json!({ "signature": r.signature, "slides": r.slides, "fallback": r.fallback }))
+        .collect();
+    json!({ "widget_requests": requests })
+}
+
+/// Le hi-fi : le témoin, le seuil, la file des slides et les groupes répétés.
+fn hifi_json(state: &ImportState, rescored: &Rescored, l: &Localizer) -> Value {
+    let report = state.report();
+    let (threshold, limits) = (state.threshold(), state.limits());
+    let mut queue: Vec<(Option<f64>, u32, Value)> = Vec::new();
+    let mut done = 0;
+    for slide in &report.slides {
+        let tuning = state.tuning(&slide.slide);
+        let score = slide.score.as_ref();
+        let slide_state = SlideState::of(score, tuning, threshold, limits);
+        if slide_state == SlideState::Done {
+            done += 1;
+            continue;
+        }
+        let worst = score.and_then(oku_slides_import::metrics::SlideScore::worst);
+        queue.push((
+            worst,
+            slide.source,
+            json!({
+                "slide": slide.slide,
+                "source": slide.source,
+                "score": score.map(|s| s.score),
+                "worst": worst,
+                "state": slide_state,
+                "tries_left": slide_state.tries_left(tuning, limits),
+            }),
+        ));
+    }
+    // Les pires d'abord ; une slide sans score après, dans l'ordre source.
+    queue.sort_by(|a, b| b.0.unwrap_or(f64::MIN).total_cmp(&a.0.unwrap_or(f64::MIN)).then(a.1.cmp(&b.1)));
+    let groups: Vec<Value> = state
+        .groups()
+        .iter()
+        .take(LISTED)
+        .map(|g| {
+            let occurrences: Vec<Value> = g
+                .occurrences
+                .iter()
+                .map(|(slide, item)| {
+                    json!({ "slide": slide, "item": item, "elements": element_ids(state.target(item)) })
+                })
+                .collect();
+            json!({ "signature": g.signature, "occurrences": occurrences })
+        })
+        .collect();
+    let mut v = json!({
+        "threshold": threshold,
+        "tries_per_slide": limits.tries,
+        "mean": report.mean_score(),
+        "slides": queue.into_iter().map(|(_, _, v)| v).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
+        "done": done,
+        "groups": groups,
+        "groups_more": state.groups().len().saturating_sub(LISTED),
+    });
+    if let Some(o) = v.as_object_mut() {
+        match state.reference_status() {
+            Some(Ok(witness)) => {
+                o.insert("witness".into(), json!(witness));
+            }
+            Some(Err(cause)) => {
+                o.insert("reference_unavailable".into(), json!(cause.localize(l)));
+            }
+            None => {}
+        }
+        if let Some(before) = rescored.before {
+            o.insert("mean_before".into(), json!(before));
+            o.insert("worse".into(), json!(rescored.worse));
+        }
+    }
+    v
+}
+

+#[path = "queue_tests.rs"]
+mod queue_tests;
```

```diff
+/// Le rendu de référence gardé, échec compris.
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub(crate) struct Reference {
+    /// Nom et version du témoin ; son nom seul s'il a échoué.
+    pub(crate) witness: String,
+    /// Ses limites connues : les régions suspectes.
+    pub(crate) limits: WitnessKind,
+    /// Page PNG du témoin, par id de slide Oku ; ou la cause de son échec.
+    pub(crate) pages: Result<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>, ReferenceCause>,
+}
+
+/// Le rendu de référence d'un import, à faire hors de son état.
+///
+/// Se clone sans copier la présentation ; obtenu par `ImportState::reference_job`.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
+pub struct ReferenceJob {
+    pub(crate) bytes: Arc<[u8]>,
+    pub(crate) fonts: Fonts,
+    /// Id de slide Oku et numéro source, dans l'ordre du rapport.
+    pub(crate) slides: Vec<(String, u32)>,
+    /// Largeur des pages, en pixels.
+    pub(crate) width: u32,
+}
+
+/// Le rendu de référence fait : ses pages, ou son échec, journalisé par l'état qui le garde.
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct ReferenceDone {
+    /// Nom et version du témoin ; son nom seul s'il a échoué.
+    pub(crate) witness: String,
+    /// Ses limites connues.
+    pub(crate) limits: WitnessKind,
+    /// Ses pages par id de slide Oku, ou l'échec (cause et détail).
+    pub(crate) pages: Result<BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>, Failure>,
+}
+
+impl ReferenceJob {
+    /// Rend les pages par `witness`, tranche par tranche.
+    pub fn run(&self, witness: &dyn Witness) -> ReferenceDone {
+        let limits = witness.limits();
+        match self.pages(witness) {
+            Ok((name, pages)) => ReferenceDone { witness: name, limits, pages: Ok(pages) },
+            Err(failure) => ReferenceDone { witness: witness.name().to_owned(), limits, pages: Err(failure) },
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// Le nom du témoin et ses pages, tranche par tranche, par id de slide Oku.
+    fn pages(&self, witness: &dyn Witness) -> Result<(String, BTreeMap<String, Vec<u8>>), Failure> {
+        let numbers: Vec<u32> = self.slides.iter().map(|(_, n)| *n).collect();
+        let mut name = witness.name().to_owned();
+        let mut pages = BTreeMap::new();
+        for span in spans(&numbers, SPAN) {
+            let rendered =
+                witness.render(&self.bytes, &self.fonts, span, self.width).map_err(|e| render_failure(&e, "témoin"))?;
+            let expected = span_len(span);
+            if rendered.count != expected || rendered.pages.len() != expected {
+                let count = |n: usize| u32::try_from(n).unwrap_or(u32::MAX);
+                let cause = ReferenceCause::Pages { reference: count(rendered.count), deck: count(expected) };
+                return Err((cause, format!("slides {}..={}", span.first, span.last)));
+            }
+            name = rendered.witness;
+            let mut by_index = rendered.pages;
+            for (slide, number) in self.slides.iter().filter(|(_, n)| (span.first..=span.last).contains(n)) {
+                let at = (number - span.first) as usize;
+                let page = by_index.get_mut(at).ok_or_else(|| (ReferenceCause::Failed, format!("page {at}")))?;
+                pages.insert(slide.clone(), std::mem::take(page));
+            }
+        }
+        Ok((name, pages))
+    }
+}
+
 /// Nombre de slides de `span`, masquées comprises.
 pub(crate) fn span_len(span: SlideSpan) -> usize {
     span.last.saturating_sub(span.first) as usize + 1
```
