```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/tune.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,114 @@
+//! Les bornes de l'ajustement d'un import hi-fi par l'agent, et l'état de
+//! chaque slide dans sa file.
+//!
+//! Un essai est un `import_diff` d'une slide entière dont la page Oku a
+//! changé (son empreinte de rendu) depuis le précédent : le premier diff
+//! d'une slide est sa base, un diff sans changement ne compte pas, un zoom
+//! sur une région non plus. Chaque essai compare la pire région non suspecte
+//! au meilleur score atteint : un gain le remplace, sinon l'essai compte
+//! « sans gain ». Une slide s'arrête après [`TuneLimits::tries`] essais
+//! (`exhausted`) ou [`TuneLimits::stall`] essais de suite sans gain
+//! (`stalled`) ; ses diffs entiers sont alors refusés.
+
+use serde::Serialize;
+
+use oku_slides_import::metrics::SlideScore;
+use oku_slides_platform::config::ImportSettings;
+
+/// Les bornes de l'ajustement, lues de `[import]`.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub struct TuneLimits {
+    /// Essais par slide (`tune_iterations`).
+    pub tries: u32,
+    /// Essais de suite sans gain avant d'arrêter la slide (`tune_stall`).
+    pub stall: u32,
+}
+
+impl TuneLimits {
+    /// Les bornes des réglages `settings`.
+    pub fn of(settings: &ImportSettings) -> Self {
+        Self { tries: settings.tune_iterations.get(), stall: settings.tune_stall.get() }
+    }
+}
+
+/// Les essais d'ajustement d'une slide par l'agent.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, PartialEq)]
+pub struct Tuning {
+    /// Essais faits.
+    pub tries: u32,
+    /// Le meilleur score de sa pire région non suspecte vu par un diff ; `None` avant le premier.
+    pub best: Option<f64>,
+    /// Essais de suite sans gain sur `best`.
+    pub without_gain: u32,
+    /// L'empreinte de sa page Oku au dernier diff entier ; `None` avant le premier.
+    pub diffed: Option<u128>,
+}
+
+impl Tuning {
+    /// Note un diff entier de la page d'empreinte `page`, de pire région `worst` ; vrai si c'est un essai.
+    pub fn observe(&mut self, page: u128, worst: f64) -> bool {
+        let counted = self.diffed.is_some_and(|d| d != page);
+        self.diffed = Some(page);
+        match self.best {
+            Some(best) if counted && worst >= best => self.without_gain += 1,
+            Some(best) if !counted => self.best = Some(best.min(worst)),
+            _ => {
+                self.best = Some(worst);
+                self.without_gain = 0;
+            }
+        }
+        self.tries += u32::from(counted);
+        counted
+    }
+}
+
+/// L'état d'une slide dans la file de l'ajustement.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize)]
+#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
+pub enum SlideState {
+    /// Une région non suspecte dépasse le seuil ; il reste des essais.
+    Pending,
+    /// Aucune région ne dépasse le seuil.
+    Done,
+    /// Toujours au-delà du seuil, tous ses essais faits.
+    Exhausted,
+    /// Toujours au-delà du seuil, sans gain depuis [`TuneLimits::stall`] essais.
+    Stalled,
+    /// Seules des régions suspectes (erreurs connues du témoin) dépassent le seuil : rien à corriger.
+    Witness,
+    /// Pas de score : le rendu de référence manque.
+    Unscored,
+}
+
+impl SlideState {
+    /// L'état d'une slide notée `score`, aux essais `tuning`, contre le seuil `threshold`.
+    pub fn of(score: Option<&SlideScore>, tuning: Option<&Tuning>, threshold: f64, limits: TuneLimits) -> Self {
+        let Some(score) = score else { return Self::Unscored };
+        let tuning = tuning.cloned().unwrap_or_default();
+        if score.worst().is_some_and(|w| w > threshold) {
+            if tuning.without_gain >= limits.stall {
+                Self::Stalled
+            } else if tuning.tries >= limits.tries {
+                Self::Exhausted
+            } else {
+                Self::Pending
+            }
+        } else if score.regions.iter().any(|r| r.suspect.is_some() && r.score > threshold) {
+            Self::Witness
+        } else {
+            Self::Done
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// Les essais qui restent dans cet état : aucun une fois la slide arrêtée sans gain.
+    pub fn tries_left(self, tuning: Option<&Tuning>, limits: TuneLimits) -> u32 {
+        match self {
+            Self::Stalled => 0,
+            _ => limits.tries.saturating_sub(tuning.map_or(0, |t| t.tries)),
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+#[path = "tune_tests.rs"]
+mod tune_tests;
```
```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/tune_error.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,94 @@
+//! Les refus des outils d'ajustement d'un import (`import_report`,
+//! `import_diff`), dits à l'agent (`session-import-tune-*`).
+
+use oku_slides_i18n::{Localize, Localizer};
+use oku_slides_import::report::ReferenceCause;
+use snafu::{Backtrace, Snafu};
+
+/// Un appel d'ajustement refusé ; l'import et le deck sont intacts.
+#[derive(Debug, Snafu)]
+pub struct TuneError(TuneInner);
+
+/// Nature d'une [`TuneError`].
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
+#[non_exhaustive]
+pub enum TuneErrorKind {
+    /// L'onglet ne montre pas un deck importé (fermé, repris, ou un autre document).
+    NoImport,
+    /// `import_diff` sur un import retrofit : il n'a pas de référence.
+    HifiOnly,
+    /// Le rendu de référence manque.
+    NoReference,
+    /// Pas une slide de l'import (inconnue, ou supprimée depuis).
+    UnknownSlide,
+    /// Pas une région de la slide.
+    UnknownRegion,
+    /// La slide n'a plus d'essai : tous faits, ou arrêtée sans gain.
+    TriesUsed,
+    /// La comparaison de la slide à sa référence a échoué.
+    Compare,
+}
+
+#[derive(Debug, Snafu)]
+#[snafu(visibility(pub(crate)))]
+pub(crate) enum TuneInner {
+    #[snafu(display("no import in this tab"))]
+    NoImport { backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("a retrofit import has no reference to compare with"))]
+    HifiOnly { backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("no reference rendering: {cause:?}"))]
+    NoReference { cause: ReferenceCause, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("{slide} is not a slide of the import"))]
+    UnknownSlide { slide: String, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("{region} is not a region of slide {slide}"))]
+    UnknownRegion { slide: String, region: String, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("no try left for slide {slide} ({tries} used)"))]
+    TriesUsed { slide: String, tries: u32, backtrace: Backtrace },
+    #[snafu(display("comparison failed: {detail}"))]
+    Compare { detail: String, backtrace: Backtrace },
+}
+
+impl TuneError {
+    /// Nature du refus.
+    pub fn kind(&self) -> TuneErrorKind {
+        use TuneInner::*;
+        match self.0 {
+            NoImport { .. } => TuneErrorKind::NoImport,
+            HifiOnly { .. } => TuneErrorKind::HifiOnly,
+            NoReference { .. } => TuneErrorKind::NoReference,
+            UnknownSlide { .. } => TuneErrorKind::UnknownSlide,
+            UnknownRegion { .. } => TuneErrorKind::UnknownRegion,
+            TriesUsed { .. } => TuneErrorKind::TriesUsed,
+            Compare { .. } => TuneErrorKind::Compare,
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+impl Localize for TuneError {
+    fn localize(&self, l: &Localizer) -> String {
+        use TuneInner::*;
+        match &self.0 {
+            NoImport { .. } => l.tr("session-import-tune-none"),
+            HifiOnly { .. } => l.tr("session-import-tune-hifi-only"),
+            NoReference { cause, .. } => {
+                l.tr_with("session-import-tune-no-reference", &[("reason", cause.localize(l).into())])
+            }
+            UnknownSlide { slide, .. } => {
+                l.tr_with("session-import-tune-unknown-slide", &[("slide", slide.as_str().into())])
+            }
+            UnknownRegion { slide, region, .. } => l.tr_with(
+                "session-import-tune-unknown-region",
+                &[("slide", slide.as_str().into()), ("region", region.as_str().into())],
+            ),
+            TriesUsed { slide, tries, .. } => l.tr_with(
+                "session-import-tune-tries-used",
+                &[("slide", slide.as_str().into()), ("tries", (*tries).into())],
+            ),
+            Compare { .. } => l.tr("session-import-tune-compare"),
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+#[path = "tune_error_tests.rs"]
+mod tune_error_tests;
```

```text
feat(mcp) : outils import_report et import_diff, essais bornés par slide (t-692)

L'agent ajuste un import hi-fi slide par slide, en essais bornés, depuis
la session de l'onglet importé.

- import_report : mode, pertes par sorte, items figés (Opaque) ; retrofit :
  demandes de widget ; hi-fi : seuil, moyenne, témoin, file des slides pas
  encore done (pire région d'abord : state pending, exhausted, stalled,
  witness ou unscored, tries_left), groupes répétés sur 3 slides au moins.
  Chaque slide dont la page Oku a changé depuis sa dernière note (empreinte
  du rendu) est notée de nouveau : thème, widget, slide ou annulation se
  voient au rapport suivant, avec mean_before et worse.
- import_diff : les deux pages entières (960 px), puis le JSON (note, état,
  8 pires régions avec cadre en pt de page, éléments ou paramètre à
  corriger). Un essai = un diff entier d'une slide dont la page a changé
  depuis le précédent ; le premier est la base. Refus quand tries_left est
  nul (tune_iterations faits, ou tune_stall essais de suite sans gain).
  Avec region : les deux rognures de la région, marge 16 px, agrandies 2
  fois ; ne compte pas.
- Le témoin de l'ajustement est office2pdf seul (app_witness) ; il rend
  hors du verrou de la session (ReferenceJob, tâche bloquante), une fois
  par onglet. ReferenceDone porte le nom du témoin, ses limites (régions
  suspectes) et ses pages ou son échec, journalisé dans la langue courante
  par l'état qui le garde.
- import_report reçoit la langue de l'agent (LiveLocalizer::current de
  l'outil) pour dire une référence manquante.
- Les scores périmés (stale) cèdent la place à l'empreinte de la page Oku
  de chaque note.
- Prérequis : en hi-fi, ImportPlan.targets donne pour chaque item ses
  éléments (formes, images, tableaux, graphiques, groupes compris) ou le
  paramètre de slide qu'il remplit ; origins reste celui de la couverture.
  ImportPlan.groups : groupes source répétés (hors SmartArt dessiné) ;
  tous deux lus par le CheckedPlan.
- [import] tune_iterations = 3 et tune_stall = 2 (au moins 1).
- Raster::scaled ; refus localisés session-import-tune-* (20 langues).
```

### Task 8: Agent: versioned fine-tuning instructions and launch after an import

This task teaches the agent to fine-tune an imported deck and gives the hosts a way to start it. `instructions/import.md` (English, `include_str!` as `IMPORT`) is the bounded loop: `import_report` first; in hi-fi, the queue slides in order and only the `pending` ones, `import_diff` (the first diff of a slide is free), the worst region without a `suspect` field fixed through `apply` (`set_frame` in page pt, `set_style`, `set_param`, including a slide param), a free zoom with `region`, `set_widget` for a layout of the import pack, `edit_theme` for a common cause, each later diff counts as one try, revert when the score does not go down, stop on `done` / `exhausted` / `stalled` / `tries_left` 0; never a `suspect` region, a `witness` or `unscored` slide or a `frozen` item; after `set_widget` or `edit_theme`, `import_report` and restore if `mean` is above `mean_before`, `worse` lists a slide or a slide went over the threshold; `groups`: `ask_confirm` then an element widget. In retrofit every `widget_requests` entry becomes a widget of the import pack, the fallback replaced on its slides, without asking. It ends with one `report`; templates mode is never used on an imported deck. `AgentCommand::Tune { tab, ui? }` plays one turn in the slides conversation: the prompt carries the import instructions hidden before the context, and the short Fluent text `agent-tune-prompt` last (and in the thread), in the language of `ui.locale`, else the current interface language (`LiveLocalizer::current`, like the other agent texts); the key is added to the 20 locales. `Stack::tune` and `AgentHandle::tune` serve the hosts, and `Command::Prompt` now carries an `Instruction { scope, text, ui, tune }`, so a `Tune` arriving during a turn replaces it with its instructions. Hosts: the Tauri `workspace` command reads `outcome.tune_tab()` (from Task 6) before building the view and starts the turn (`AppState::tune`); `serve` calls `stack.tune` on `WorkspaceOutcome::Tune`. The commit was rebased onto main at 3213b0d0 without any ported main commit changing it; the instruction text uses the tool names of Task 7 (`import_report`, `import_diff`); the later UI dialog (Task 9) and the e2e spec (Task 10) build on `Tune`, and the docs task (Task 11) re-tags the rule added to the agent `AGENTS.md`.

Instructions: the new text file, and its constant with the module doc updated (`INSTRUCTIONS` and `WIDGETS` on a first turn, `IMPORT` on the Tune turn only).

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-agent/src/instructions/import.md
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+Fine-tuning an imported deck: this tab's deck was just imported from PowerPoint. Improve it on your own in this one turn, through the oku-slides tools; every change can be undone. Ask the user nothing except the group question below. Never use edit_templates on an imported deck.
+
+Start with import_report. Its mode is hifi or retrofit.
+
+Hi-fi (mode hifi): the goal is to look like the reference, the original PowerPoint rendering. Work through slides in the given order (worst first), only those whose state is pending. For each one:
+1. import_diff {slide}: two PNGs, reference then Oku, then JSON with regions ranked worst first. This first diff of the slide costs no try.
+2. Take the worst region without a suspect field. Fix it with apply on its elements: set_frame {slide, element, frame {x, y, w, h}} in pt, the same unit as the region frame; set_style; set_param. A region with param instead of elements is a slide parameter: set_param on the slide. import_diff {slide, region: <its item>} zooms on it and costs no try. Use set_widget on a widget of the deck's import pack only when its layout is the cause, and edit_theme only for a cause shared by many slides (a font, a size, a color); before either, read the current widget source or token values so you can restore them.
+3. import_diff {slide} again. A diff after a change costs one try. If score did not go down, undo your change by applying the previous values.
+4. Repeat from 2 until state is done, exhausted or stalled, or tries_left is 0 (further diffs are refused), then go to the next slide.
+Never change a region that has a suspect field (the reference itself is wrong there), a slide whose state is witness or unscored, or an item listed in frozen (kept as drawn).
+After any set_widget or edit_theme, call import_report: if mean is above mean_before, if worse lists a slide, or if a slide went over threshold, restore what you changed.
+groups lists patterns repeated on 3 or more slides. For each group, ask_confirm "<N> slides share this pattern: turn it into an element widget?". On yes, write an element widget for it in the deck's import pack (set_widget, then preview_widget until it renders well), then with apply replace the elements of each occurrence by one element of that widget at the same place, carrying their content over. On no, leave it.
+
+Retrofit (mode retrofit): there is no queue and no reference. For each entry of widget_requests, without asking: write an element widget for that pattern in the deck's import pack (set_widget, then preview_widget until it renders well); then on every slide of its slides, read the slide and replace the element of kind fallback by an element of the new widget carrying the same content (apply replace_element, or set_kind then set_param).
+
+End with one report: the slides you changed, the slides still above threshold, the frozen items, and the witness slides (left as imported because the reference is wrong there).
\ No newline at end of file
```

The actor: `Instruction` replaces the three fields of `Command::Prompt`, `AgentHandle::tune` sends one with `tune: true` in the slides conversation, `turn::run` takes it whole and pushes the `IMPORT` block before the context (five blocks at most), and the command pending at the end of a turn is an `Instruction`, so a Tune received mid-turn keeps its instructions.

The hosts: the Tauri `workspace` command starts the turn as soon as the imported tab exists (the view follows), and `serve` does the same on `WorkspaceOutcome::Tune`.

```diff
--- a/src-tauri/src/commands.rs
+++ b/src-tauri/src/commands.rs
@@ -145,6 +145,10 @@ pub async fn workspace(app: AppHandle, req: WorkspaceRequest) -> Result<Response
         // Onglets fermés (ou vierge remplacé) : leur agent s'arrête.
         state.stop_closed_agents(&closed);
         let outcome = outcome.map_err(|e| state.refuse(e))?;
+        // Un onglet importé à fine-tuner : son tour part dès que l'onglet existe (la vue suit).
+        if let Some(tab) = outcome.tune_tab() {
+            state.tune(tab);
+        }
         if outcome.is_last_window() {
             state::shutdown(app);
             return Ok(outcome.into_json());
```

### Task 9: Open accepts a .pptx and the import dialog

This task puts the import in front of the user. "Open" now offers `.pptx` files: `pickOpenPath(pptx)` adds a first "Presentations" filter (pdf, json, pptx) in Tauri, then the Oku Slides and PowerPoint filters, while "Merge" keeps its old prompt (`ui-file-merge-prompt`) and never offers a `.pptx`. A chosen `.pptx` does not open directly: `App` shows the new `ImportDialog` (faithful copy, hi-fi, by default, or "Use my templates", retrofit, with a library pack, the default one preselected, and a theme where "Default theme" means `theme: null`; a "Fine-tune with the agent" checkbox, checked by default; Import and Cancel). The dialog takes and keeps the focus, Escape abandons it (not during the import), no key starts the import, clicks in the first 500 ms (`ARMING_MS`) are ignored, it is busy while the import runs, and it shows the host's localized message when the host refuses. The dialog calls `workspace.importTab(window, path, target, tune)`, which sends the `import_tab` workspace command added in Task 6; `Workspace` passes `onImport` to `App` and the imported deck becomes a new active tab. While the dialog is open the keys of `App` and of the agent are silent (`dialogOpen`; the `KeyHolds.picking` field becomes `dialog`, read by `appKeyScope`). The task also makes deck-only packs (the hi-fi generated pack and the retrofit child pack of Task 5, scope `Deck`) visible to the UI: `Snapshot.deck_pack` is true when the deck's pack belongs to the deck alone, the workshop menu entry is then disabled with its explanation (a new `hint` on `ActionMenu` items, `ui-menu-workshop-deck-only`), `editTemplates` refuses, and the stage no longer offers to open a widget. The session helper `deck_pack_is_deck_only` is shared with the pack notice. The `ui-import-*`, `ui-file-*` and `ui-menu-workshop-deck-only` Fluent keys exist in the 20 locales. The commit body lists no change ported from main (the draft was rebased onto main 3213b0d0 without changes to this task). Task 10 (end-to-end spec) drives this dialog; the fine-tuning prompt it triggers is sent by the host (Task 8).

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ui/src/ImportDialog.render.test.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,197 @@
+// Rendu du dialogue d'import d'un .pptx dans un DOM happy-dom.
+
+import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeEach, expect, spyOn, test } from "bun:test";
+import "./test/dom";
+import { resetMessages } from "./test/messages";
+import type { ImportTarget, PackInfo, ThemeInfo } from "./api";
+
+// Voir ./a2ui/catalog.render.test.tsx : React se charge après le DOM.
+const { act, createElement } = await import("react");
+const { createRoot } = await import("react-dom/client");
+const ImportDialog = (await import("./ImportDialog")).default;
+const { ARMING_MS } = await import("./agent/useQuickKeys");
+const { setMessages } = await import("./i18n");
+
+afterAll(resetMessages);
+setMessages("fr", [
+  [
+    "ui-import-title = Importer une présentation PowerPoint",
+    "ui-import-hifi = Copie fidèle",
+    "ui-import-retrofit = Utiliser mes modèles",
+    "ui-import-theme-default = Thème par défaut",
+    "ui-import-tune = Peaufiner avec l'agent",
+    "ui-import-submit = Importer",
+    "ui-import-busy = Import en cours…",
+    "ui-close-cancel = Annuler",
+    "ui-picker-set-mine = { $name } · à moi",
+  ].join("\n") + "\n",
+]);
+
+const PACKS: PackInfo[] = [
+  { id: "p-base", version: "v1", name: "Base", description: "", builtin: true, default: false, count: 3 },
+  { id: "p-pro", version: "v1", name: "Pro", description: "", builtin: true, default: true, count: 5 },
+  { id: "p-moi", version: "v2", name: "Maison", description: "", builtin: false, default: false, count: 2 },
+];
+const THEMES: ThemeInfo[] = [
+  { id: "t-papier", version: "v1", name: "Papier", builtin: true, default: true },
+  { id: "t-nuit", version: "v1", name: "Nuit", builtin: true, default: false },
+];
+
+type Root = ReturnType<typeof createRoot>;
+let mounted: { root: Root; host: HTMLElement } | null = null;
+let now = 0;
+beforeEach(() => {
+  now = 1_000_000;
+  spyOn(Date, "now").mockImplementation(() => now);
+});
+afterEach(async () => {
+  (Date.now as unknown as { mockRestore: () => void }).mockRestore();
+  const m = mounted;
+  mounted = null;
+  if (!m) return;
+  await act(async () => m.root.unmount());
+  m.host.remove();
+});
+
+interface Calls {
+  imports: { target: ImportTarget; tune: boolean }[];
+  closed: number;
+}
+
+async function mount(onImport?: (target: ImportTarget, tune: boolean) => Promise<void>) {
+  const calls: Calls = { imports: [], closed: 0 };
+  const host = document.createElement("div");
+  document.body.append(host);
+  const root = createRoot(host);
+  mounted = { root, host };
+  const props = {
+    path: "/Users/moi/Présentations/Alto Wealth.pptx",
+    api: { templateSets: () => Promise.resolve(PACKS) },
+    themes: THEMES,
+    onImport: (target: ImportTarget, tune: boolean) => {
+      calls.imports.push({ target, tune });
+      return onImport ? onImport(target, tune) : Promise.resolve();
+    },
+    onClose: () => void calls.closed++,
+  };
+  await act(async () => root.render(createElement(ImportDialog, props)));
+  const radio = (value: string) => host.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>(`input[type="radio"][value="${value}"]`)!;
+  const selects = () => [...host.querySelectorAll("select")] as HTMLSelectElement[];
+  const tune = () => host.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>('input[type="checkbox"]')!;
+  const button = (label: string) => [...host.querySelectorAll("button")].find((b) => b.textContent === label)!;
+  return { host, calls, radio, selects, tune, button };
+}
+
+/** Clique après la garde des 500 ms. */
+async function click(el: HTMLElement) {
+  now += ARMING_MS + 1;
+  await act(async () => el.click());
+}
+
+async function choose(select: HTMLSelectElement, value: string) {
+  await act(async () => {
+    select.value = value;
+    select.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", { bubbles: true }));
+  });
+}
+
+test("ImportDialog s'ouvre en copie fidèle, sans pack ni thème, peaufinage coché", async () => {
+  const { host, radio, selects, tune } = await mount();
+  expect(host.querySelector('[role="dialog"]')?.getAttribute("aria-modal")).toBe("true");
+  expect(host.querySelector("h2")?.textContent).toBe("Importer une présentation PowerPoint");
+  expect(host.querySelector(".import-file")?.textContent).toBe("Alto Wealth.pptx");
+  expect(radio("hifi").checked).toBe(true);
+  expect(selects()).toHaveLength(0);
+  expect(tune().checked).toBe(true);
+  expect(tune().disabled).toBe(false);
+});
+
+test("ImportDialog prend le focus à l'ouverture", async () => {
+  const { host } = await mount();
+  expect(document.activeElement).toBe(host.querySelector('[role="dialog"]'));
+});
+
+test("ImportDialog en retrofit montre les packs (défaut choisi) et les thèmes, défaut en tête", async () => {
+  const { radio, selects } = await mount();
+  await click(radio("retrofit"));
+  const [pack, theme] = selects();
+  expect([...pack!.options].map((o) => o.textContent)).toEqual(["Base", "Pro", "Maison · à moi"]);
+  expect(pack!.value).toBe("p-pro");
+  expect([...theme!.options].map((o) => o.textContent)).toEqual(["Thème par défaut", "Papier", "Nuit"]);
+  expect(theme!.value).toBe("");
+});
+
+test("ImportDialog revenu en copie fidèle cache de nouveau pack et thème", async () => {
+  const { radio, selects } = await mount();
+  await click(radio("retrofit"));
+  await click(radio("hifi"));
+  expect(selects()).toHaveLength(0);
+});
+
+test("ImportDialog Importer en copie fidèle envoie hifi et le peaufinage, puis se ferme", async () => {
+  const { calls, button } = await mount();
+  await click(button("Importer"));
+  expect(calls.imports).toEqual([{ target: { mode: "hifi" }, tune: true }]);
+  expect(calls.closed).toBe(1);
+});
+
+test("ImportDialog Importer en retrofit envoie le pack et le thème choisis, sans peaufinage", async () => {
+  const { calls, radio, selects, tune, button } = await mount();
+  await click(radio("retrofit"));
+  await choose(selects()[0]!, "p-moi");
+  await choose(selects()[1]!, "t-nuit");
+  await click(tune());
+  await click(button("Importer"));
+  expect(calls.imports).toEqual([{ target: { mode: "retrofit", pack: "p-moi", theme: "t-nuit" }, tune: false }]);
+});
+
+test("ImportDialog retrofit sur le thème par défaut envoie theme null", async () => {
+  const { calls, radio, button } = await mount();
+  await click(radio("retrofit"));
+  await click(button("Importer"));
+  expect(calls.imports[0]!.target).toEqual({ mode: "retrofit", pack: "p-pro", theme: null });
+});
+
+test("ImportDialog ignore un clic des 500 premières ms", async () => {
+  const { calls, button } = await mount();
+  await act(async () => button("Importer").click());
+  expect(calls.imports).toHaveLength(0);
+});
+
+test("ImportDialog pendant l'import : occupé, tout désactivé, Échap ne ferme pas", async () => {
+  let finish = () => {};
+  const { host, calls, tune, button } = await mount(() => new Promise<void>((resolve) => (finish = resolve)));
+  await click(button("Importer"));
+  expect(host.querySelector('[role="status"]')?.textContent).toBe("Import en cours…");
+  expect(host.querySelector('[role="dialog"]')?.getAttribute("aria-busy")).toBe("true");
+  expect(button("Importer").disabled).toBe(true);
+  expect(button("Annuler").disabled).toBe(true);
+  expect(tune().disabled).toBe(true);
+  await act(async () => void window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", bubbles: true, cancelable: true })));
+  expect(calls.closed).toBe(0);
+  await act(async () => finish());
+  expect(calls.closed).toBe(1);
+});
+
+test("ImportDialog refusé : le message de l'hôte s'affiche et le dialogue reste ouvert", async () => {
+  const { host, calls, button } = await mount(() => Promise.reject("Ce fichier n'est pas une présentation PowerPoint."));
+  await click(button("Importer"));
+  expect(host.querySelector('[role="alert"]')?.textContent).toBe("Ce fichier n'est pas une présentation PowerPoint.");
+  expect(button("Importer").disabled).toBe(false);
+  expect(calls.closed).toBe(0);
+});
+
+test("ImportDialog Échap et Annuler ferment sans importer", async () => {
+  const { calls, button } = await mount();
+  await act(async () => void window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", bubbles: true, cancelable: true })));
+  await click(button("Annuler"));
+  expect(calls.closed).toBe(2);
+  expect(calls.imports).toHaveLength(0);
+});
+
+test("ImportDialog n'importe pas sur Entrée", async () => {
+  const { host, calls } = await mount();
+  const dialog = host.querySelector('[role="dialog"]')!;
+  await act(async () => void dialog.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Enter", bubbles: true, cancelable: true })));
+  expect(calls.imports).toHaveLength(0);
+});
```

```diff
+// Un fichier choisi par « Ouvrir » : un .pptx passe par le dialogue d'import.

+/** Vrai pour une présentation PowerPoint (`.pptx`, extension sans casse). */

+export function fileName(path: string): string {
```

The dialog, its styles, the menu hint and the key scope rename.

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ui/src/ImportDialog.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,192 @@
+// Dialogue d'import d'une présentation PowerPoint : copie fidèle (hi-fi) ou sur mes modèles
+// (retrofit, avec son pack et son thème), et peaufinage par l'agent une fois l'onglet prêt.
+
+import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
+import type { KeyboardEvent, MouseEvent } from "react";
+import { errorText, type ImportTarget, type PackInfo, type TabApi, type ThemeInfo } from "./api";
+import { ARMING_MS } from "./agent/useQuickKeys";
+import { t } from "./i18n";
+import { fileName } from "./importFile";
+
+const FOCUSABLE = "button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex='-1'])";
+
+interface Props {
+  /** Le `.pptx` choisi par « Ouvrir ». */
+  path: string;
+  /** Requêtes de l'onglet d'où l'on importe : les packs de la bibliothèque. */
+  api: Pick<TabApi, "templateSets">;
+  /** Thèmes de la bibliothèque (snapshot de l'onglet). */
+  themes: ThemeInfo[];
+  /** Lance l'import ; rejeté avec le message localisé de l'hôte. */
+  onImport: (target: ImportTarget, tune: boolean) => Promise<void>;
+  onClose: () => void;
+}
+
+/**
+ * La fenêtre, sur un voile qui couvre l'app. Elle prend le focus et le garde (Tab tourne à
+ * l'intérieur), Échap l'abandonne, aucune touche ne lance l'import, et les clics des premières
+ * 500 ms sont ignorés (le clic qui a choisi le fichier). Pendant l'import, rien ne s'y change.
+ */
+export default function ImportDialog({ path, api, themes, onImport, onClose }: Props) {
+  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ImportTarget["mode"]>("hifi");
+  const [sets, setSets] = useState<PackInfo[] | null>(null);
+  const [pack, setPack] = useState("");
+  // `""` : le thème par défaut.
+  const [theme, setTheme] = useState("");
+  const [tune, setTune] = useState(true);
+  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
+  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
+  const openedAt = useRef(Date.now());
+  // L'import réussi démonte souvent l'onglet (un autre devient actif) : plus rien à mettre à jour.
+  const alive = useRef(true);
+  useEffect(() => {
+    alive.current = true;
+    return () => {
+      alive.current = false;
+    };
+  }, []);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    let live = true;
+    api
+      .templateSets()
+      .then((list) => {
+        if (!live) return;
+        setSets(list);
+        setPack((p) => p || ((list.find((s) => s.default) ?? list[0])?.id ?? ""));
+      })
+      .catch((e) => live && setError(errorText(e)));
+    return () => {
+      live = false;
+    };
+  }, [api]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const previous = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
+    ref.current?.focus();
+    return () => {
+      if (previous?.isConnected) previous.focus();
+    };
+  }, []);
+
+  // Échap, pris avant les raccourcis de l'app ; ignoré pendant l'import, qui ne s'interrompt pas.
+  const busyRef = useRef(busy);
+  busyRef.current = busy;
+  const closeRef = useRef(onClose);
+  closeRef.current = onClose;
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const onKey = (e: globalThis.KeyboardEvent) => {
+      if (e.key !== "Escape") return;
+      e.preventDefault();
+      e.stopPropagation();
+      if (!busyRef.current) closeRef.current();
+    };
+    window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey, true);
+    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey, true);
+  }, []);
+
+  const onKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
+    if (e.key !== "Tab") return;
+    const items = [...(ref.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE) ?? [])];
+    if (items.length === 0) return e.preventDefault();
+    const first = items[0];
+    const last = items[items.length - 1];
+    const active = document.activeElement;
+    if (e.shiftKey && (active === first || active === ref.current)) {
+      e.preventDefault();
+      last.focus();
+    } else if (!e.shiftKey && active === last) {
+      e.preventDefault();
+      first.focus();
+    }
+  };
+  const onClickCapture = (e: MouseEvent) => {
+    if (Date.now() - openedAt.current < ARMING_MS) {
+      e.preventDefault();
+      e.stopPropagation();
+    }
+  };
+
+  const ready = mode === "hifi" || pack !== "";
+  const submit = async () => {
+    if (busy || !ready) return;
+    const target: ImportTarget = mode === "hifi" ? { mode: "hifi" } : { mode: "retrofit", pack, theme: theme || null };
+    setBusy(true);
+    setError(null);
+    try {
+      await onImport(target, tune);
+      if (alive.current) onClose();
+    } catch (e) {
+      if (!alive.current) return;
+      setError(errorText(e));
+      setBusy(false);
+    }
+  };
+
+  const modeChoice = (value: ImportTarget["mode"], name: string, note: string) => (
+    <label className={`model${mode === value ? " chosen" : ""}`}>
+      <input type="radio" name="import-mode" value={value} checked={mode === value} onChange={() => setMode(value)} />
+      <span className="model-name">{name}</span>
+      <span className="caption">{note}</span>
+    </label>
+  );
+
+  return (
+    <div className="import-veil">
+      <div
+        ref={ref}
+        tabIndex={-1}
+        className="import-dialog"
+        role="dialog"
+        aria-modal="true"
+        aria-labelledby="import-title"
+        aria-describedby="import-file"
+        aria-busy={busy}
+        onPointerDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
+        onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
+        onClickCapture={onClickCapture}
+      >
+        <h2 id="import-title" className="settings-title">{t("ui-import-title")}</h2>
+        <p id="import-file" className="caption import-file">{fileName(path)}</p>
+        <fieldset className="import-modes" disabled={busy}>
+          <legend className="caption">{t("ui-import-mode")}</legend>
+          <div className="model-list">
+            {modeChoice("hifi", t("ui-import-hifi"), t("ui-import-hifi-note"))}
+            {modeChoice("retrofit", t("ui-import-retrofit"), t("ui-import-retrofit-note"))}
+          </div>
+        </fieldset>
+        {mode === "retrofit" && (
+          <div className="import-target">
+            <label className="settings-row">
+              <span className="caption">{t("ui-picker-set")}</span>
+              <select className="select" value={pack} disabled={busy || !sets} onChange={(e) => setPack(e.target.value)}>
+                {(sets ?? []).map((s) => (
+                  <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.builtin ? s.name : t("ui-picker-set-mine", { name: s.name })}</option>
+                ))}
+              </select>
+            </label>
+            <label className="settings-row">
+              <span className="caption">{t("ui-toolbar-theme")}</span>
+              <select className="select" value={theme} disabled={busy} onChange={(e) => setTheme(e.target.value)}>
+                <option value="">{t("ui-import-theme-default")}</option>
+                {themes.map((th) => <option key={th.id} value={th.id}>{th.name}</option>)}
+              </select>
+            </label>
+          </div>
+        )}
+        <label className="check import-tune">
+          <input type="checkbox" checked={tune} disabled={busy} aria-describedby="import-tune-note" onChange={(e) => setTune(e.target.checked)} />
+          <span>{t("ui-import-tune")}</span>
+        </label>
+        <p id="import-tune-note" className="caption">{t("ui-import-tune-note")}</p>
+        {error && <p className="import-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
+        <div className="import-actions">
+          {busy && <span className="caption" role="status">{t("ui-import-busy")}</span>}
+          <button type="button" className="btn ghost" disabled={busy} onClick={onClose}>{t("ui-close-cancel")}</button>
+          <button type="button" className="btn primary" disabled={busy || !ready} onClick={() => void submit()}>{t("ui-import-submit")}</button>
+        </div>
+      </div>
+    </div>
+  );
+}
```

```diff
- * d'affichage, qu'aucun éditeur ne lie ; une fenêtre de l'agent ou le choix d'un modèle les garde toutes.
+ * d'affichage, qu'aucun éditeur ne lie ; une fenêtre de l'agent ou de l'app (choix d'un modèle, import) les garde toutes.
  */
 export function appKeyScope(holds: KeyHolds, e: ScopedKey): "all" | "display" | "none" {
-  if (holds.modal || holds.picking) return "none";
+  if (holds.modal || holds.dialog) return "none";
   const target = e.target instanceof HTMLElement ? e.target : null;
   if (holds.editing || targetOwnsKeys(target, e)) return viewToggle(e) ? "display" : "none";
   return "all";
```

### Task 10: End-to-end import of alto and agent fine-tuning

This task adds the browser spec `ui/e2e/220-import.cjs`, which drives the whole lot from the app. "Open" in the menu gives the web-mode prompt the absolute path of `fixtures/import/alto-wealth.pptx` and the import dialog opens (faithful copy and fine-tuning checked by default, no pack and no theme choice in hi-fi); "Import" opens a new active tab with 8 slides and a pack owned by the deck. The fake agent then plays the fine-tuning turn: the bubble "Peaufiner la présentation importée", two unfolded tool calls, and the "Import peaufiné" receipt with the thumbnail of s7. The spec reads the fake agent's log to prove what the tools returned: `import_report` in hi-fi with s7 `pending`, `import_diff` of s7 with two PNGs and one non-suspect region above the threshold, and a `report` without error. The turn changes nothing: one undo empties the tab (the import is a single step) and redo restores the 8 slides; the workshop is disabled. A second import on "my templates" (default pack preselected, the pack's theme, fine-tuning unchecked) opens a new tab with 8 slides, a child pack owned by the deck, and no agent turn. Deviations from the lot 5 decisions: the locale is not forced to English, the whole suite reads French labels (system language), and the fine-tuning turn is matched by `by_prompt` on the exact French prompt text. The fake agent "Faux" now writes its log (`--log`) into the temporary directory, passed to the specs as `E2E_AGENT_LOG`; `210-agent-picker.cjs` no longer runs last, since the new spec follows it and the picker returns to "Faux". The commit also repairs three specs of main that were already red on main at `9e7ad158` (same failures with main's UI) so that the whole suite passes: `010-editor` (the quasi-render of t-272 hides the marks outside the selection, so text is read from the CodeMirror state, with 2 marks at the cursor and 4 when everything is selected, and the slide image is not a CodeMirror widget buffer), `090-layout` (the scene scaling follows the React render, slower than two frames once the agent thread is loaded; the spec waits for the sheet to fit between the stack and the thread before "stable"), and `100-fields` (an editor line split into rectangles counts as one, and a field with bullets drawn by the editor is skipped like a field with displayed marks). The spec uses s7 (the callout box, worst non-suspect region 15.71 against a threshold of 7) rather than s8: since t-863 (a main commit ported by the replay onto the new base) the bullets of s8 sit at their indent and the slide is no longer flagged. This is the last user-visible task of the code; Task 11 builds on it.

**Files:**
- Create: `ui/e2e/220-import.cjs` (import dialog, new tab, fine-tuning turn with the fake agent, undo/redo, import on my templates)
- Modify: `fixtures/agent/e2e.json` (a `by_prompt` turn for the fine-tuning prompt: `import_report {}`, `import_diff {slide: s7}`, `report` with fixed arguments)
- Modify: `justfile` (the `e2e` recipe gives the fake agent `--log` and exports `E2E_AGENT_LOG`)
- Modify: `ui/e2e/210-agent-picker.cjs` (header comment: no longer the last spec)
- Modify: `ui/e2e/010-editor.cjs` (quasi-render: text read from the CodeMirror state, mark counts, slide image check)
- Modify: `ui/e2e/090-layout.cjs` (waits for the sheet to fit before "stable")
- Modify: `ui/e2e/100-fields.cjs` (split lines count as one, editor-drawn bullets ignored)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the `import_tab` workspace request and the import dialog (named "Importer une présentation PowerPoint"); the tools `import_report`, `import_diff(slide, region?)` and `report` of the import MCP server; the fake agent's `--log <file>` option, which writes one JSON line per message, including `mcp/result` entries with `params.tool` and `params.out`; `fixtures/import/alto-wealth.pptx`; the e2e helpers `lib/http.cjs` (`post`) and `lib/until.cjs` (`until`, `untilValue`).
- Produces: the environment variable `E2E_AGENT_LOG` (path of the fake agent "Faux" log, set by `just e2e`); in `fixtures/agent/e2e.json` the `by_prompt` key `Peaufiner la présentation importée` with `tool_calls` `i1` and `i2` and `mcp` calls `import_report {}`, `import_diff {"slide": "s7"}`, `report {"title": "Import peaufiné", "facts": [...], "slide": "s7"}`; the spec `ui/e2e/220-import.cjs` (no Rust, TS or Fluent item).

The e2e specs are the tests of this task. The new spec `220-import.cjs` fails until the fixture turn and the log wiring exist; the three repaired specs fail on main as well (same failures with main's UI).

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ui/e2e/220-import.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,158 @@
+// Import PowerPoint dans l'app : « Ouvrir » un .pptx (alto) ouvre le dialogue d'import ; en copie
+// fidèle avec le peaufinage, l'onglet importé s'ouvre et le faux agent joue son tour de
+// fine-tuning (import_report, import_diff de la slide 7, report) ; puis un import sur mes modèles
+// (pack par défaut, sans agent).
+// Contre `oku-slides serve` lancé par `just e2e` : faux agent « Faux » choisi, son journal dans
+// E2E_AGENT_LOG (les résultats MCP s'y lisent). Le témoin (office2pdf) tourne pour de vrai : attentes longues.
+const { chromium } = require('playwright');
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
+const { readFileSync } = require('node:fs');
+const path = require('node:path');
+const { post } = require('./lib/http.cjs');
+const { until, untilValue } = require('./lib/until.cjs');
+const URL = process.env.E2E_URL ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:4870/';
+const LOG = process.env.E2E_AGENT_LOG;
+const ALTO = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..', 'fixtures', 'import', 'alto-wealth.pptx');
+/** Import et premier rendu d'alto, puis le tour de l'agent avec le témoin : bien plus que les 8 s par défaut. */
+const SLOW = 180_000;
+
+const api = (p, tab, req) => post(p, '/api', { tab, req });
+
+/** Les résultats MCP (`mcp/result`) notés par le faux agent pour `tool`, dans l'ordre. */
+const mcpResults = (tool) =>
+  readFileSync(LOG, 'utf8')
+    .split('\n')
+    .filter(Boolean)
+    .map((l) => JSON.parse(l))
+    .filter((m) => m.method === 'mcp/result' && m.params.tool === tool)
+    .map((m) => m.params.out);
+
+/** Le dernier résultat MCP de `tool`, décodé (CallToolResult) ; attend qu'il soit noté. */
+const lastResult = async (p, tool) => {
+  const outs = await untilValue(p, () => mcpResults(tool), (o) => o.length > 0, `aucun résultat MCP pour ${tool}`, SLOW);
+  const out = outs[outs.length - 1];
+  try {
+    return JSON.parse(out);
+  } catch {
+    assert.fail(`${tool} : résultat illisible : ${out.slice(0, 300)}`);
+  }
+};
+
+/** « Ouvrir » du menu, le chemin donné à l'invite du mode web : le dialogue d'import, armé (clics des 500 premières ms ignorés). */
+const openImport = async (p, file) => {
+  p.once('dialog', (d) => d.accept(file));
+  await p.getByRole('button', { name: 'Menu' }).click();
+  await p.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Ouvrir' }).click();
+  const dialog = p.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Importer une présentation PowerPoint' });
+  await dialog.waitFor();
+  await p.waitForTimeout(600);
+  return dialog;
+};
+
+/** Clique « Importer » ; rend l'onglet importé, actif dans la fenêtre (réponse de `import_tab`). */
+const submitImport = async (p, dialog) => {
+  const reply = p.waitForResponse(
+    (r) => r.url().endsWith('/api/workspace') && (r.request().postData() ?? '').includes('"import_tab"'),
+    { timeout: SLOW },
+  );
+  await dialog.getByRole('button', { name: 'Importer', exact: true }).click();
+  const response = await reply;
+  const view = await response.json();
+  assert.ok(response.ok(), `import refusé : ${JSON.stringify(view)}`);
+  await dialog.waitFor({ state: 'detached', timeout: SLOW });
+  return view.windows.find((w) => w.label === 'w-1').active;
+};
+
+(async () => {
+  assert.ok(LOG, 'E2E_AGENT_LOG manquant : lancer par just e2e');
+  const b = await chromium.launch({ channel: process.env.E2E_CHANNEL });
+  const p = await b.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } });
+  const errors = [];
+  p.on('pageerror', (e) => errors.push(e.message));
+  await p.goto(URL);
+  await post(p, '/api/workspace', { cmd: 'activate', tab: 't-1' });
+  await p.reload();
+  await p.waitForSelector('.stage img');
+
+  // 1. Copie fidèle (le défaut) avec le peaufinage (coché par défaut).
+  const dialog = await openImport(p, ALTO);
+  assert.equal(await dialog.locator('.import-file').innerText(), 'alto-wealth.pptx');
+  assert.ok(await dialog.locator('input[name=import-mode][value=hifi]').isChecked(), 'copie fidèle par défaut');
+  assert.equal(await dialog.locator('.import-target').count(), 0, 'pas de pack ni de thème en copie fidèle');
+  const tune = dialog.getByRole('checkbox', { name: "Peaufiner avec l'agent" });
+  assert.ok((await tune.isChecked()) && (await tune.isEnabled()), 'peaufinage coché et disponible');
+  const hifi = await submitImport(p, dialog);
+  assert.notEqual(hifi, 't-1');
+  const snap = await api(p, hifi, { cmd: 'snapshot' });
+  assert.equal(snap.slides.length, 8);
+  assert.ok(snap.deck_pack, 'le pack généré est propre au deck');
+  await p.waitForSelector('.stage img');
+
+  // Le tour de fine-tuning : la bulle du prompt court, puis le reçu du `report`.
+  const turn = p.locator('.agent-turn', { hasText: 'Peaufiner la présentation importée' });
+  await turn.locator('.a2ui-prompt').waitFor({ timeout: SLOW });
+  const receipt = turn.locator('.a2ui-receipt');
+  await receipt.locator('.a2ui-title').waitFor({ timeout: SLOW });
+  assert.equal(await receipt.locator('.a2ui-title').innerText(), 'Import peaufiné');
+  assert.equal(await receipt.locator('.a2ui-hint').innerText(), "slide 7 comparée à l'original");
+  await receipt.locator('.a2ui-receipt-thumb').waitFor();
+  await turn.locator('.a2ui-timeline-summary').click();
+  await turn.locator('.a2ui-step-toggle').click();
+  assert.deepEqual(await turn.locator('.a2ui-call-label').allInnerTexts(), ["Lire le rapport d'import", 'Comparer la slide 7']);
+
+  // Ce que les outils ont rendu à l'agent : le rapport hi-fi d'alto, la slide 7 signalée (pire région non suspecte 15,71, seuil 7)…
+  const report = await lastResult(p, 'import_report');
+  assert.ok(!report.isError, `import_report en erreur : ${JSON.stringify(report).slice(0, 300)}`);
+  const body = JSON.parse(report.content.find((c) => c.type === 'text').text);
+  assert.equal(body.mode, 'hifi');
+  const s7 = body.slides.find((s) => s.slide === 's7');
+  assert.ok(s7, `s7 absente de la file : ${JSON.stringify(body.slides)}`);
+  assert.equal(s7.state, 'pending');
+  // … puis le diff de la slide 7 : deux PNG (la référence, le rendu Oku) et ses régions notées.
+  const diff = await lastResult(p, 'import_diff');
+  assert.ok(!diff.isError, `import_diff en erreur : ${JSON.stringify(diff).slice(0, 300)}`);
+  const images = diff.content.filter((c) => c.type === 'image');
+  assert.equal(images.length, 2);
+  assert.ok(images.every((i) => i.mimeType === 'image/png' && i.data.length > 0), 'deux PNG non vides');
+  const regions = JSON.parse(diff.content.find((c) => c.type === 'text').text).regions;
+  assert.ok(regions.some((r) => r.score > body.threshold && !r.suspect), `aucune région au-delà du seuil : ${JSON.stringify(regions)}`);
+  const receiptCall = await lastResult(p, 'report');
+  assert.ok(!receiptCall.isError, `report en erreur : ${JSON.stringify(receiptCall).slice(0, 300)}`);
+
+  // Le tour n'a rien changé : la seule annulation est celle de l'import, qui vide l'onglet.
+  const after = await api(p, hifi, { cmd: 'snapshot' });
+  assert.equal(after.slides.length, 8);
+  await p.locator('.stage').click({ position: { x: 5, y: 5 } });
+  await p.keyboard.press('Control+z');
+  await until(p, async () => (await api(p, hifi, { cmd: 'snapshot' })).slides.length === 0, "l'import ne s'annule pas en une étape");
+
+  await p.keyboard.press('Control+Shift+z');
+  await until(p, async () => (await api(p, hifi, { cmd: 'snapshot' })).slides.length === 8, "l'import ne se refait pas");
+  // Un deck importé n'ouvre pas l'atelier : ses modèles ne sont pas dans la bibliothèque.
+  await p.getByRole('button', { name: 'Menu' }).click();
+  assert.ok(await p.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Atelier' }).isDisabled(), "l'atelier devrait être désactivé");
+  await p.keyboard.press('Escape');
+
+  // 2. Sur mes modèles : le pack par défaut présélectionné, le thème du pack, sans agent.
+  const second = await openImport(p, ALTO);
+  await second.locator('input[name=import-mode][value=retrofit]').check();
+  const pack = second.locator('.import-target select').first();
+  await untilValue(p, () => pack.inputValue(), (v) => v !== '', 'aucun pack présélectionné');
+  assert.equal(await second.locator('.import-target select').nth(1).inputValue(), '');
+  await second.getByRole('checkbox', { name: "Peaufiner avec l'agent" }).uncheck();
+  const retrofit = await submitImport(p, second);
+  assert.ok(![hifi, 't-1'].includes(retrofit), `nouvel onglet attendu, pas ${retrofit}`);
+  const snap2 = await api(p, retrofit, { cmd: 'snapshot' });
+  assert.equal(snap2.slides.length, 8);
+  assert.ok(snap2.deck_pack, 'le pack enfant du retrofit est propre au deck');
+  await p.waitForSelector('.stage img');
+  // Sans peaufinage, aucun tour ne part dans l'onglet.
+  assert.equal(await p.locator('.agent-turn').count(), 0, 'aucun tour attendu');
+
+  assert.deepEqual(errors, []);
+  await b.close();
+  console.log('import : ok');
+})().catch((e) => {
+  console.error(e);
+  process.exit(1);
+});
```

```diff
+Decisions from the lot 5 plan (2026-10-16):
+
+1. **One pipeline, in the session.** The import orchestration of the CLI moves
+   into `oku_slides_session::import` (read with a size bound, retrofit and
+   hi-fi, an unreadable target theme refused, the plan checked
+   (`CheckedPlan`), applied in one history step and validated, `render`,
+   `note_overflows`, the witnesses, `ImportState`); the session depends on
+   `oku-slides-import` and `oku-slides-reference` (core never does). The CLI
+   keeps the options, the choice of witness, the output and the atomic report
+   write. Rendering goes through the render worker only. The target is `ImportTarget`, flat and tagged by `mode`
+   in JSON: `{"mode": "retrofit", "pack", "theme"?}` or `{"mode": "hifi"}`.
+2. **Suspect regions (t-884, first).** `metrics::WitnessLimit` marks the
+   regions whose gap is a known witness error, read from the `SourceDeck`:
+   `autofit` (`normAutofit` text without `fontScale` that office2pdf fits
+   itself: one unbulleted paragraph in a box of at most two lines, or text
+   anchored middle or bottom), `tracking`, `chart`, `smart_art`. They are
+   ranked after the others, written to the report with a localized message
+   and never flag a slide (`SlideScore::worst`, `is_above` ignore them).
+   These are office2pdf's limits: `metrics::regions` takes the witness
+   (`metrics::Witness`: `Office2Pdf` or `Other`) and only office2pdf marks
+   regions `suspect`; under the CLI's `--reference soffice` none is. The
+   threshold becomes 7.0, measured on 2026-10-16 (lot 4 decision 4).
+3. **Bounds held by the tools, one agent turn.** `import_report` gives the
+   report and the queue of the slides not yet `done`, worst region first, each
+   with a state (`pending`, `exhausted`, `stalled`, `witness`, `unscored`)
+   and `tries_left`. `import_diff(slide, region?)` renders the Oku side now
+   and rescores. A try is one whole-slide diff of a slide whose rendered page
+   changed since the previous one (a page fingerprint, no stale flag); the
+   first diff is the base and is free, as is a `region` zoom. It is refused at
+   `tries_left` 0: `[import] tune_iterations` (3) tries done, or `tune_stall`
+   (2) tries in a row without gain on the worst region (`stalled`). A slide
+   whose only regions above the threshold are suspect is `witness` from the
+   start; one without a score is `unscored`; neither is touched.
+4. **Deck-only packs and themes.** `PackScope` (`library`, the default and
+   never written to the manifest so existing hashes hold; `deck`) on
+   `PackManifest` and `ThemeManifest`, kept by the versions made from them.
+   The hi-fi pack and theme are `deck`; `Library::add_version` refuses a
+   `deck` version (`session-deck-only`); `set_widget` and `edit_theme` on
+   them embed a new version in one undo step and never write the library; a
+   file opened never brings such a pack into the library. In retrofit the
+   deck gets a child pack of the target (a copy of its files, id derived from
+   the SHA-256 of the `.pptx` and of the target version, `parent` = the
+   target version, named "<pack> for <deck>"); the target and the library
+   stay untouched. `Snapshot.deck_pack` tells the UI.
+5. **`import_diff` output.** Two PNGs of the whole slide at 960 px (reference,
+   Oku rendered now), then JSON: score, state, the 8 worst regions with their
+   source item, Oku element or slide parameter, frame in page pt, score,
+   shift and `suspect`. With `region`: both crops of that region at 2x with a
+   16 px margin. Hi-fi `ImportPlan.targets` maps each item to its elements
+   (groups included) or the slide parameter it fills; `groups` lists the
+   source groups repeated on at least 3 slides.
+6. **What the agent may edit.** Elements and params (`apply`), the widgets of
+   the deck's import pack (`set_widget`) and, in hi-fi, the generated theme
+   (`edit_theme`). The page fingerprints make a theme, widget or undo change
+   visible: the next `import_report` rescores the slides whose page changed
+   (witness cached) and gives `mean_before`, the new mean and `worse`; the
+   instructions say to revert a change that raises the mean, worsens a slide
+   or pushes one over the threshold. The whole turn is one undo group above
+   the import's own step, which stays one step.
+7. **Start.** "Open" accepts `.pptx`; an `ImportDialog` asks for the mode (hi-fi
+   by default, or "my templates" with a library pack, default preselected, and
+   a theme) and a "Fine-tune with the agent" box, checked by default.
+   `WorkspaceRequest::ImportTab { window, path, target, tune }` builds a new
+   tab (replacing a blank active one) and blocks until the first render;
+   with `tune`, the outcome `Tune { tab }` makes the host send
+   `AgentCommand::Tune`. A failed import is a localized error and changes
+   no tab.
+8. **State in the tab's memory.** `ImportState` (report, presentation, witness

+9. **No feature flag** for the witness: it runs in the app through the render

 ## Agent fine-tuning (app)
 
-- **New MCP tools** (`oku-slides-mcp`): `import_report` (the
-  current report) and `import_diff(slide)` (reference PNG, Oku PNG,
-  per-region scores).
-- **Bounded autonomous loop**: slides from worst to best;
-  corrections through `apply` / `set_widget`; stop under the threshold or after N
-  iterations per slide (threshold and N in config).
-- **Retrofit**: each `WidgetRequest` → widget created in the child pack
-  (`set_widget`, `preview_widget`), then fallback replaced on all the
-  slides of the pattern, without asking.
-- **Hi-fi**: the agent proposes the groupings ("N slides share this
-  pattern → element widget?") through `ask_confirm`.

+  the worst non-suspect region is corrected through `apply` (frame in page pt,

+  asking. No templates mode on an imported deck.

+- **End**: a `report` (changed, still above the threshold, frozen). Everything
+  goes through the session, hence undoable as one group.
```

### Task 12: Tune: the tools hold the try budget (raster fingerprint, excess gain, deck budget)

This task answers the plan review (Opus with the real app on alto and libreoffice, plus the 15-agent team) findings M2 (the page fingerprint is not visual: Typst's `RemoteCompiled::page_hash` also hashes introspection, so editing s6 changed s7's hash on alto and re-armed its tries), M3 (gain measured on the worst region only, and a fake `0.0` when a slide has no non-suspect region), M4 (`import_report` rescored changed pages for free, zoom and whole diffs were allowed at 0 tries, and a diff after a rescoring report was free), M5 (`mean_before` and `worse` depended on a rescoring happening in the same call) and F1 (`tries_left` was not 0 for `done`, `witness`, `unscored`), plus the global-budget decision of 2026-10-17 for theme and layout-widget edits. A new `Tuner` (in `tune.rs`, replacing the per-slide map of `ImportState`) charges every score a tool makes (a whole `import_diff` or `import_report`) as a `Charge`: `Baseline` (the slide's first score, free), `Unchanged` (same raster), `Global`, `Slide` (one try) or `Refused`. The fingerprint is a SHA-256 of the scored raster (dimensions and pixels at the scoring resolution); `page_hash` is kept only as the filter that lets `import_report` skip pages that cannot have changed (thumbnails and views do not use it). Gain is the slide's total excess, the sum over non-suspect regions of `max(0, score - threshold)`: `best` keeps it, `stalled` follows `tune_stall` tries without gain, and a slide without a non-suspect region has no excess (no invented `0.0`). Only a `pending` slide has tries; whole diffs and zooms are refused at 0 tries (`TriesUsed`, or the new localized `Untunable` for `done`, `witness`, `unscored`), except a slide's first score; `import_report` does not score a changed slide with no try left: it keeps its score and lists it in `stale`. The global budget `[import] tune_global` (default 3, `NonZeroU32`) deviates from the review's session-hook idea, on purpose: no hook is needed. A page changed while the fingerprint of the whole deck state (theme, templates/pack, tokens, params, variables: `Session::deck_key`) differs from the one of the slide's previous score costs one global try per deck state never scored, whatever the number of slides, and no slide try; going back to a scored state is free; once the budget is spent each changed slide pays one of its own tries. So UI edits, `edit_theme`, `set_widget`, undo and redo count the same. `mean_before` is one baseline for the whole life of the import (the mean of each slide's first score, the deck as imported; the session cannot see agent turns), and `worse` lists the slides whose excess is above their best. `import_report` now gives `excess` and `tries_left` per slide, `global_tries_left`, `mean_before`, `worse`, `stale`; `import_diff` gives `excess`, `global_tries_left` and `charge`. The fine-tuning instructions (`import.md`), the MCP tool descriptions, `config.default.toml`, the README, decisions 3 and 6 of the lot 5 spec, the session `ARCHITECTURE.md` and one session `AGENTS.md` rule are updated in the same commit (two A2UI rules of that file are merged to stay within 60 lines). The commit was rebased onto main at 3213b0d0 with no ported main commit changing it. Test fixtures that are `.pptx` files are now copied by the test helpers. Later tasks (13 and following) build on `Tuner`, `Charge`, `Seen` and `ImportState::observe`.

```diff
+/// Le rapport de `s` en anglais, sur une référence blanche.
+fn report(s: &mut crate::Session, witness: &WhiteWitness) -> Value {
+    s.import_report(witness, &crate::Localizer::new(Some("en"))).unwrap()
+}
+
+/// Retire le premier élément des slots de `slide` : sa page change.
+fn change(s: &mut crate::Session, slide: &str) {
+    let slide_ref = s.deck().slide(slide).unwrap();
+    let element = slide_ref.params.slots().flat_map(|(_, list)| list.iter().map(|e| e.id.clone())).next().unwrap();
+    let ops = vec![Op::RemoveElement { slide: slide.to_owned(), element }];
+    s.handle(Request::Apply { label: "Retirer".into(), ops, merge: None }).unwrap();
+}
+
+/// Change la marge haute de la page du thème du deck (le thème généré du hi-fi) : toutes les pages bougent.
+fn edit_theme(s: &mut crate::Session, margin: f64) {
+    let id = s.deck().theme.as_ref().unwrap().id;
+    let op = TokenOp::SetToken { path: vec!["page".into(), "margin-top".into()], value: serde_json::json!(margin) };
+    assert_that!(s.edit_theme(id, None, vec![op]).unwrap().changed).is_true();
+}
+
+/// Les essais restants de chaque slide de la file.
+fn tries(report: &Value) -> Vec<(String, u64)> {
+    let slides = report["slides"].as_array().unwrap();
+    slides.iter().map(|e| (e["slide"].as_str().unwrap().to_owned(), e["tries_left"].as_u64().unwrap())).collect()
+}
+
+/// Les essais restants des slides `pending` de la file ; jamais vide.
+fn pending_tries(report: &Value) -> Vec<(String, u64)> {
+    let pending: Vec<(String, u64)> = tries(report)
+        .into_iter()
+        .filter(|(slide, _)| entry(report, slide).is_some_and(|e| e["state"] == "pending"))
+        .collect();
+    assert_that!(pending).is_not_empty();
+    pending
+}
+
 /// La slide de la file `queue` d'id `id`.
```

```diff
+/// La fixture des tests hi-fi : alto, que le témoin office2pdf signale (s7, l'encadré, est `pending`).
+const ALTO: &str = "alto-wealth";
+
+/// Une slide `pending` d'alto, avec des éléments à retoucher.
+const PENDING: &str = "s7";
+
+/// Les essais restants de la slide `slide` dans la file du rapport `report`.
+fn tries_left(report: &Value, slide: &str) -> Option<u64> {
+    report["slides"].as_array()?.iter().find(|s| s["slide"] == slide)?["tries_left"].as_u64()
+}
+
+/// Déplace de 12 pt le premier élément cadré de la slide `slide`, par l'outil `apply`.
+async fn nudge(c: &rust_mcp_sdk::mcp_client::ClientRuntime, h: &Harness, slide: &str) {
+    let (element, mut frame) = {
+        let session = h.session.lock().unwrap_or_else(std::sync::PoisonError::into_inner);
+        let s = session.deck().slide(slide).unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("slide {slide}"));
+        let e = s.params.slots().flat_map(|(_, list)| list.iter()).find(|e| e.frame.is_some());
+        let e = e.unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("élément cadré dans {slide}"));
+        (e.id.clone(), e.frame.unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("cadre")))
+    };
+    frame.x += 12.0;
+    let ops = json!([{ "op": "set_frame", "slide": slide, "element": element, "frame": frame }]);
+    let applied = call(c, "apply", json!({ "label": "Déplacer", "ops": ops })).await;
+    assert_that!(applied.is_error).is_not_equal_to(Some(true));
+}
+
```

```diff
+//!

+//! - un raster inchangé ne coûte rien ;
+//! - un raster changé alors que l'état du deck a changé depuis la note

+//!   global ([`TuneLimits::global`]) : un essai par état du deck jamais noté,
+//!   quel que soit le nombre de slides qu'il change ; revenir à un état déjà
+//!   noté (celui de l'import, ou un déjà payé) est gratuit ; aucun essai de la

+pub(crate) fn fingerprint<'a>(parts: impl IntoIterator<Item = &'a [u8]>) -> u128 {
```

The tools: the whole diff and the report charge through `observe` (the report keeps a slide it cannot pay for at its old score, `stale`), `deck_key` fingerprints the deck state, and the JSON gains the new fields.

The agent text, the MCP tool descriptions and the docs (`ARCHITECTURE.md` and `AGENTS.md` committed with the code they describe; the README and the lot 5 spec state the new budget).

```diff
--- a/crates/oku-slides-agent/src/instructions/import.md
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-agent/src/instructions/import.md
@@ -2,13 +2,13 @@ Fine-tuning an imported deck: this tab's deck was just imported from PowerPoint.
 
 Start with import_report. Its mode is hifi or retrofit.
 
-Hi-fi (mode hifi): the goal is to look like the reference, the original PowerPoint rendering. Work through slides in the given order (worst first), only those whose state is pending. For each one:
-1. import_diff {slide}: two PNGs, reference then Oku, then JSON with regions ranked worst first. This first diff of the slide costs no try.
+Hi-fi (mode hifi): the goal is to look like the reference, the original PowerPoint rendering. The tools hold the budget: each time import_diff or import_report scores a slide whose rendering changed since its last score, it costs a try. A slide's progress is its excess, the sum of what its non-suspect regions exceed the threshold by: lower is better. Work through slides in the given order (worst first), only those whose state is pending. For each one:
+1. import_diff {slide}: two PNGs, reference then Oku, then JSON with excess and regions ranked worst first. It costs no try while the slide is unchanged since its last score.
 2. Take the worst region without a suspect field. Fix it with apply on its elements: set_frame {slide, element, frame {x, y, w, h}} in pt, the same unit as the region frame; set_style; set_param. A region with param instead of elements is a slide parameter: set_param on the slide. import_diff {slide, region: <its item>} zooms on it and costs no try. Use set_widget on a widget of the deck's import pack only when its layout is the cause, and edit_theme only for a cause shared by many slides (a font, a size, a color); before either, read the current widget source or token values so you can restore them.
-3. import_diff {slide} again. A diff after a change costs one try. If score did not go down, undo your change by applying the previous values.
-4. Repeat from 2 until state is done, exhausted or stalled, or tries_left is 0 (further diffs are refused), then go to the next slide.

On yes, write an element widget for it in the deck's import pack (set_widget, then preview_widget until it renders well), then with apply replace the elements of each occurrence by one element of that widget at the same place, carrying their content over. On no, leave it.
 
 Retrofit (mode retrofit): there is no queue and no reference. For each entry of widget_requests, without asking: write an element widget for that pattern in the deck's import pack (set_widget, then preview_widget until it renders well); then on every slide of its slides, read the slide and replace the element of kind fallback by an element of the new widget carrying the same content (apply replace_element, or set_kind then set_param).
```

```text
feat(import) : budget d'essais tenu par les outils — empreinte du raster, gain sur l'excès total, budget global des thèmes et widgets (t-692)

  touchent pas.

  import_report) a une charge : base (première note, gratuite), inchangée
  (même raster), globale ou essai de la slide ; refusée sans essai. Un
  rapport compte donc les essais comme un diff ; un diff après un rapport
  qui a noté la slide n'est plus gratuit.

  essais sans gain. Une slide sans région non suspecte n'a pas d'excès

  nouveau refus localisé Untunable en 20 langues) ; la première note
  d'une slide reste permise. Le rapport ne note pas une slide changée
  sans essai : elle garde sa note et va dans stale.

  alors que l'état du deck entier a changé depuis la note précédente de
  la slide (empreinte du thème, du pack, des jetons, paramètres et
  variables du deck) coûte un essai global par état du deck jamais noté,
  quel que soit le nombre de slides, et aucun essai de slide ; revenir à
  un état déjà noté est gratuit. Sans crochet : interface, edit_theme,
  set_widget, annulation comptent pareil. Épuisé, chaque slide changée
  paie un de ses essais.
- mean_before : la moyenne des premières notes (le deck importé), une
  seule base pour toute la vie de l'import ; worse : les slides dont
  l'excès dépasse le meilleur atteint.
- import_report : excess et tries_left par slide, global_tries_left,
  mean_before, worse, stale ; import_diff : excess, global_tries_left,
  charge.
```

### Task 13: Robust import state: one witness, nothing under the lock, deleted slides, isolated failures

This task answers the plan review's Task 13 findings: a reference job in flight (one witness run under concurrent tool calls), no witness under the session lock, a job that must belong to its `ImportState`, deleted slides and undone imports leaving the queue, one failing slide aborting `import_report`, `import_diff` not rendering the deck and counting a try before its images exist, the zoom crop from unsigned frame edges, `Raster::scaled` on empty images and factor 0, `spans` covering more than `SPAN` source slides, `ImportState` forgotten before `load_document` succeeds, the pptx bytes kept for ever, dead code, `{cause:?}` in an error, and missing tracing spans. The state keeps the place of its reference (`Arc<OnceLock>`); every `ReferenceJob` shares it, the first job to run renders and concurrent callers wait for its result, and a job only fills the place of the import that gave it (a replaced state receives nothing), so `set_reference`, `ReferenceDone` and `import_reference_done` disappear. `Session::import_report(l)` and `Session::import_diff(slide, region)` no longer take a witness: the caller first runs `Session::import_reference_job` outside the lock (`ReferenceJob::run(platform)`, or `run_with` for a test witness), and `import_diff` before the reference is done is refused with the localized `ReferencePending`. This deviates from the lot 5 decision that offered "refuse or always run the job": the code refuses, and `Tools` and the CLI run the job themselves (the CLI via `set_witness`, `job.run`, `score_deck`). `ImportState` records the witness chosen at import (office2pdf in hi-fi, none in retrofit), the session trait is renamed `WitnessRenderer: Send + Sync` (no clash with `metrics::Witness`), and `app_witness` is gone. The pptx bytes only serve the witness: never kept in retrofit or without a witness, freed once the reference settles. Slides with no page leave the queue, the mean and the `done` count; a slide that cannot be rendered or compared is logged and reported `unscored` while the others go on (all changed pages are rendered first, scores kept after the loop); `import_diff` calls `ensure_rendered` and counts a try only once both images exist; the zoom crop starts from signed frame edges (`crop_box`); `Raster::scaled` keeps an empty image empty and rejects factor 0 with `Size`; `spans` cuts a slice before it covers more than `SPAN` source numbers; `load_document` forgets the import only once the new document is set; `ImportState::score_slide` and `Session::import_state_mut` are removed (`import_state` is test-only); `LossKind::name()` replaces serializing the loss, `ReferenceCause` implements `Display`, and tracing spans wrap `ensure_reference`, the reference job and `rescore_changed`. `state.rs` is split into `state` (state and reference), `score` (scores) and `geometry` (source page, crops). The docs follow (session, MCP and CLI `ARCHITECTURE.md`, the MCP rule, spec decisions 3, 8 and 9, the `import_report` tool description). The commit was rebased onto main at 3213b0d0 without any ported main commit changing it. Tasks 14 to 17 build on these signatures.

**Files:**
- Create: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/score.rs` (scoring half of the old `state.rs`: `rescore`, `observe`, `touch`, `slide_state`, `scored_page`, `score_deck`, `pair`, `crop`)
- Create: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/geometry.rs` (`Geometry`, `px`, `image`, `crop_box` from signed frame edges)
- Create: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/geometry_tests.rs` (exact crops)

- Modify: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/state_tests.rs` (state tests)
- Modify: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/reference.rs` (`WitnessRenderer`, `ReferenceJob::run`/`run_with`, shared place, `log_failure`)
- Modify: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/reference_tests.rs` (job tests)
- Modify: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/queue.rs` (`import_report(l)`, `live_slides`, `Rescored`, `mean`, `spans` cut)

- Modify: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/diff.rs` (`import_diff(slide, region)`, `ensure_rendered`, try after images)

- Modify: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-09-import-pptx-design.md` (decisions 3, 8 and 9)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `ReferenceJob`, `ImportState` and `Session::import_reference_job` (Tasks 3 to 7), `ReferenceWitness`, `metrics::Witness`, `Raster`, `LossKind`, `ReferenceCause`, `TuneError`/`TuneErrorKind` and their `tune_kind()`, `Localizer::tr`, `RemoteCompiled`, `Platform`.
- Produces:
  - `pub trait WitnessRenderer: Send + Sync` (the former session `Witness` trait, `limits(&self) -> Witness` returns `metrics::Witness`), re-exported by `import`
  - `ReferenceJob::run(&self, platform: &Platform)` and `ReferenceJob::run_with(&self, renderer: &dyn WitnessRenderer)`, both returning `()`; concurrent runs of jobs of one import render once and share the result in the `Arc<OnceLock>` place of the state
  - `ImportState::set_witness(&mut self, witness: Option<ReferenceWitness>)`, `ImportState::score_deck(&mut self, compiled: &RemoteCompiled)`, `ImportState::reference_job(&self) -> Option<ReferenceJob>`
  - `Session::import_report(&mut self, l: &Localizer) -> Result<Value>` and `Session::import_diff(&mut self, slide: &str, region: Option<&str>) -> Result<ImportDiff>` (no witness argument)
  - `TuneErrorKind::ReferencePending` and Fluent key `session-import-tune-reference-pending` (20 locales)
  - `LossKind::name(&self) -> &'static str`, `impl Display for ReferenceCause`
  - `Raster::scaled` returns `Err(Size)` for factor 0 and an empty image stays empty
  - removed: `app_witness`, `ReferenceDone`, `ImportState::set_reference`, `Session::import_reference_done`, `ImportState::score_slide`, `Session::import_state_mut`; `witness_worker` and `WitnessWorker` become `pub(crate)`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests**

The tests pin: a single witness render under two concurrent job runs (a slow counting fake witness), a job of another import changing nothing, the pptx bytes freed after the reference and never kept in retrofit, a deleted slide and an undone import leaving the queue, the mean and `done`, a failing slide reported `unscored` without aborting the report, a failing diff counting no try, the `ReferencePending` refusal (localized in a non-English locale), exact zoom crops for an inner region and an edge region, `Raster::scaled` on an empty image and by zero, `spans` cut at `SPAN`, the import kept after a refused document, `LossKind::name` and the `Display` of `ReferenceCause`. The test support gains a call-counting witness and the `witnessed` helper.

```diff
+
+/// Retire de la référence de `s` la page du témoin de `slide` : sa comparaison échoue.
+fn drop_reference_page(s: &mut crate::Session, slide: &str) {
+    let state = s.import.as_mut().unwrap();
+    let reference = std::sync::Arc::get_mut(&mut state.reference).unwrap().get_mut().unwrap();
+    reference.pages.as_mut().unwrap().remove(slide);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_report_after_deleting_a_slide_leaves_it_out_of_the_queue_and_the_mean() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-queue-deleted-");
+    let mut s = hifi(data.path());
+    let witness = WhiteWitness::default();
+    let first = report(&mut s, &witness);
+    let slide = first["slides"][0]["slide"].as_str().unwrap().to_owned();
+    s.handle(Request::Apply {
+        label: "Supprimer".into(),
+        ops: vec![Op::RemoveSlide { slide: slide.clone() }],
+        merge: None,
+    })
+    .unwrap();
+    let after = report(&mut s, &witness);
+    assert_that!(entry(&after, &slide)).is_none();
+    let listed = after["slides"].as_array().unwrap().len() as u64 + after["done"].as_u64().unwrap();
+    assert_that!(listed).is_equal_to(2);
+    assert_that!(after["mean"].as_f64()).is_not_equal_to(first["mean"].as_f64());
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_report_after_undoing_the_import_has_an_empty_queue() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-queue-undone-");
+    let mut s = hifi(data.path());
+    let witness = WhiteWitness::default();
+    report(&mut s, &witness);
+    s.handle(Request::Undo).unwrap();
+    let undone = report(&mut s, &witness);
+    assert_that!(undone["slides"].as_array().map(Vec::len)).is_equal_to(Some(0));
+    assert_that!(undone["done"].as_u64()).is_equal_to(Some(0));
+    assert_that!(undone["mean"].is_null()).is_true();
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn import_report_with_one_slide_failing_marks_it_unscored_and_scores_the_others() {
+    let data = fresh_dir("oku-slides-import-queue-failing-");
+    let mut s = hifi(data.path());
+    let witness = WhiteWitness::default();
+    witnessed(&mut s, &witness);
+    let failing = s.deck().slides[0].id.clone();
+    drop_reference_page(&mut s, &failing);
+    let report = s.import_report(&crate::Localizer::new(Some("en"))).unwrap();
+    assert_that!(entry(&report, &failing).map(|e| e["state"].clone())).is_equal_to(Some(Value::from("unscored")));
+    let scored = report["slides"].as_array().unwrap().iter().filter(|e| e["score"].is_number()).count() as u64;
+    assert_that!(scored + report["done"].as_u64().unwrap()).is_equal_to(2);
+    assert_that!(report["mean"].is_number()).is_true();
+}
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run them to see them fail**

Run: `find crates src-tauri -path "*/src/*.rs" -exec touch {} + && touch crates/oku-slides-i18n/src/locales/*/*.ftl && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Users/matthieu/Projects/slider/target cargo nextest run -p oku-slides-session -p oku-slides-import -p oku-slides-reference` — Expected: compile errors naming the missing `WitnessRenderer`, `ReferenceJob::run_with`, `ImportState::set_witness`, `LossKind::name`, `TuneErrorKind::ReferencePending` and the new `import_report`/`import_diff` signatures, then assertion failures once they exist.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

Reference and state. The state owns the `Arc<OnceLock>` place of its reference and the recorded witness choice; the job renders at most once, fills only its own import's place and lets the state settle (free the pptx bytes). The old `state.rs` is split by concept: state and reference, scores, source geometry with the signed crop. The witness trait is renamed and `Send + Sync`, `app_witness` and the `ReferenceDone` hand-back are removed, with tracing spans on `ensure_reference` and the job.
