```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/score.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,182 @@
+//! Les notes d'un import hi-fi : chaque slide Oku comparée à sa page de référence.
+//!
+//! Chaque slide Oku, rognée à la page source ([`super::geometry`]), est
+//! comparée à sa page de référence ([`metrics::score`], régions des items
+//! source) ; les slides se répondent par leur numéro source. Une note d'un
+//! outil ([`ImportState::observe`]) coûte ce que dit [`super::Tuner`] et
+//! garde l'empreinte Typst de la page notée (un filtre : une page à la même
+//! empreinte a le même raster ; les essais, eux, suivent l'empreinte du
+//! raster noté). Pour la CLI, une slide qu'on ne peut noter prive tout le
+//! deck de scores ([`ImportState::score_deck`]) : le rapport dit pourquoi, le
+//! journal dit le détail. Hi-fi seulement : le retrofit ne se compare pas au
+//! témoin.
+
+use oku_slides_core::Frame;
+use oku_slides_import::metrics::{self, SlideScore};
+use oku_slides_import::report::{ReferenceCause, ReferenceReport};
+use oku_slides_reference::Raster;
+use oku_slides_render_worker::RemoteCompiled;
+
+use super::ImportState;
+use super::geometry::{Geometry, crop_box, image, px};
+use super::reference::{Failure, render_failure};
+use super::tune::{Charge, Seen, SlideState, fingerprint};
+
+impl ImportState {
+    /// Note la slide `slide` sur `oku` et garde le score au rapport ; l'échec revient à l'appelant.
+    fn rescore(&mut self, slide: &str, oku: &Raster) -> Result<SlideScore, Failure> {
+        let score = self.scored(slide, oku)?;
+        let report = self.plan.report_mut().slides.iter_mut().find(|r| r.slide == slide);
+        let report = report.ok_or_else(|| (ReferenceCause::Failed, format!("slide {slide} absente du rapport")))?;
+        report.score = Some(score.clone());
+        Ok(score)
+    }
+
+    /// Note la slide `slide` sur `oku`, rendue maintenant, l'état du deck d'empreinte `deck`.
+    ///
+    /// La note coûte ce que dit [`super::Tuner::charge`] : refusée, rien ne
+    /// change et le score manque ; un raster inchangé garde le score. `page` :
+    /// l'empreinte Typst de la page, le filtre du rapport suivant. Un échec ne
+    /// change rien : ni score, ni essai, ni empreinte.
+    pub(crate) fn observe(
+        &mut self,
+        slide: &str,
+        oku: &Raster,
+        page: Option<u128>,
+        deck: u128,
+    ) -> Result<(Charge, Option<SlideScore>), Failure> {
+        let raster = fingerprint([&oku.width().to_le_bytes()[..], &oku.height().to_le_bytes(), oku.rgba()]);
+        let now = Seen { raster, deck };
+        let current = self.plan.report.slides.iter().find(|r| r.slide == slide).and_then(|r| r.score.clone());
+        let charge = self.tuner.charge(slide, now, self.slide_state(slide));
+        if charge == Charge::Refused {
+            return Ok((charge, None));
+        }
+        let score = match (charge, current) {
+            (Charge::Unchanged, Some(score)) => score,
+            _ => self.rescore(slide, oku)?,
+        };
+        self.tuner.record(slide, now, charge, &score, self.threshold);
+        match page {
+            Some(page) => self.scored.insert(slide.to_owned(), page),
+            None => self.scored.remove(slide),
+        };
+        Ok((charge, Some(score)))
+    }
+
+    /// La page de `slide`, d'empreinte Typst inchangée, n'a pas à être notée : l'état du deck `deck` passe.
+    pub(crate) fn touch(&mut self, slide: &str, deck: u128) {
+        self.tuner.touch(slide, deck);
+    }
+
+    /// L'état de la slide `slide` dans la file, d'après sa note courante et ses essais.
+    pub fn slide_state(&self, slide: &str) -> SlideState {
+        let score = self.plan.report.slides.iter().find(|r| r.slide == slide).and_then(|r| r.score.as_ref());
+        SlideState::of(score, self.tuner.tuning(slide), self.threshold, self.tuner.limits())
+    }
+
+    /// L'empreinte de la page Oku de la dernière note de `slide`, si elle a été notée.
+    pub(crate) fn scored_page(&self, slide: &str) -> Option<u128> {
+        self.scored.get(slide).copied()
+    }
+
+    /// Note chaque slide de `compiled`, le rendu Oku du deck, contre la référence (la CLI).
+    ///
+    /// Sans effet tant que la référence n'est pas faite ([`Self::reference_job`]).
+    /// Pose au rapport le témoin et le seuil ; une référence en échec, ou une
+    /// slide qu'on ne peut noter, laisse toutes les slides sans score et dit pourquoi.
+    pub fn score_deck(&mut self, compiled: &RemoteCompiled) {
+        let Some(reference) = self.reference.get() else { return };
+        let (name, made) = (reference.witness.clone(), reference.pages.as_ref().map(|_| ()).map_err(Clone::clone));
+        self.settle();
+        let scored = match made {
+            Ok(()) => match self.score_all(compiled) {
+                Ok(()) => Ok(name),
+                Err(failure) => {
+                    self.warn(&failure, None);
+                    Err((name, failure.0))
+                }
+            },
+            // L'échec du témoin est journalisé une fois, quand il survient.
+            Err(cause) => Err((name, cause)),
+        };
+        self.set_scored(scored);
+    }
+
+    /// Pose au rapport le témoin et le seuil ; un échec (témoin, cause) laisse
+    /// toutes les slides sans score.
+    fn set_scored(&mut self, scored: Result<String, (String, ReferenceCause)>) {
+        let threshold = self.threshold;
+        let report = self.plan.report_mut();
+        let (witness, unavailable) = match scored {
+            Ok(witness) => (witness, None),
+            Err((witness, cause)) => {
+                for slide in &mut report.slides {
+                    slide.score = None;
+                }
+                self.scored.clear();
+                (witness, Some(cause))
+            }
+        };
+        report.reference = Some(ReferenceReport { witness, threshold, unavailable });
+    }
+
+    /// Note chaque slide du rapport sur sa page de `compiled` ; le premier échec arrête tout, rien n'est gardé.
+    fn score_all(&mut self, compiled: &RemoteCompiled) -> Result<(), Failure> {
+        let ppp = Geometry::of(&self.source).ppp as f32;
+        let mut scores = Vec::with_capacity(self.plan.report.slides.len());
+        for slide in &self.plan.report.slides {
+            let failed = |what: &str| (ReferenceCause::Failed, format!("slide {} : {what}", slide.source));
+            let page = compiled.layout().page_of(&slide.slide).and_then(|p| p.checked_sub(1));
+            let page = page.ok_or_else(|| failed("page Oku absente du rendu"))?;
+            let oku = compiled.png(page, ppp).map_err(|e| render_failure(&e, "page Oku"))?;
+            let oku = Raster::from_png(&oku).map_err(|e| (ReferenceCause::Failed, format!("page Oku : {e}")))?;
+            scores.push((self.scored(&slide.slide, &oku)?, compiled.page_hash(page)));
+        }
+        let mut hashes = Vec::with_capacity(scores.len());
+        for (slide, (score, page)) in self.plan.report_mut().slides.iter_mut().zip(scores) {
+            slide.score = Some(score);
+            hashes.push((slide.slide.clone(), page));
+        }
+        for (slide, page) in hashes {
+            match page {
+                Some(page) => self.scored.insert(slide, page),
+                None => self.scored.remove(&slide),
+            };
+        }
+        Ok(())
+    }
+
+    /// La page de référence de `slide` et sa page Oku `oku`, rognée à la page source.
+    ///
+    /// Les deux à la même taille, celle que [`metrics::score`] compare.
+    pub(crate) fn pair(&self, slide: &str, oku: &Raster) -> Result<(Raster, Raster), Failure> {
+        let failed = |what: &str| (ReferenceCause::Failed, format!("slide {slide} : {what}"));
+        let page = self.reference_page(slide).ok_or_else(|| failed("page du témoin absente"))?;
+        let refr = Raster::from_png(page).map_err(|e| (ReferenceCause::Failed, format!("page du témoin : {e}")))?;
+        let g = Geometry::of(&self.source);
+        let (x, y) = (px(g.rect.x, g.ppp), px(g.rect.y, g.ppp));
+        // Rognées à leur taille commune : un arrondi d'un pixel ne prive pas la slide de son score.
+        let w = g.width.min(refr.width()).min(oku.width().saturating_sub(x));
+        let h = px(g.rect.h, g.ppp).min(refr.height()).min(oku.height().saturating_sub(y));
+        Ok((refr.crop(0, 0, w, h), oku.crop(x, y, w, h)))
+    }
+
+    /// La rognure `[x, y, w, h]` du cadre `frame` (pt de la page Oku), à `margin` pixels autour, dans la page
+    /// source rognée de `width` × `height` pixels.
+    ///
+    /// Des bords signés : un cadre qui commence avant la page n'élargit pas
+    /// la rognure. `None` pour une page vide.
+    pub(crate) fn crop(&self, frame: Frame, margin: u32, (width, height): (u32, u32)) -> Option<[u32; 4]> {
+        crop_box(Geometry::of(&self.source).edges(frame), margin, width, height)
+    }
+
+    /// L'écart de la slide Oku `slide`, rendue en `oku`, à sa page de référence.
+    fn scored(&self, slide: &str, oku: &Raster) -> Result<SlideScore, Failure> {
+        let failed = |what: &str| (ReferenceCause::Failed, format!("slide {slide} : {what}"));
+        let src = self.source_slide(slide).ok_or_else(|| failed("source"))?;
+        let (refr, oku) = self.pair(slide, oku)?;
+        let regions = metrics::regions(src, Geometry::of(&self.source).scale, self.witness_limits());
+        metrics::score(image(&refr), image(&oku), &regions).ok_or_else(|| failed("images vides"))
+    }
+}
```

```diff
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/geometry.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,76 @@
+//! La géométrie de la comparaison d'un import hi-fi : la page source posée
+//! sur la page Oku, ses pixels, et les rognures d'une région.
+//!
+//! La page source fait [`REFERENCE_WIDTH`] pixels de large ; la page Oku est
+//! rendue à la même échelle ([`Geometry::ppp`]) puis rognée à la page source.
+//! Les bords d'une région sont signés : un cadre qui commence avant la page
+//! (ou finit après) est borné à la page sans s'élargir ([`crop_box`]).
+
+use oku_slides_core::Frame;
+use oku_slides_import::hifi;
+use oku_slides_import::metrics::Image;
+use oku_slides_import::source::SourceDeck;
+use oku_slides_reference::Raster;
+
+use super::REFERENCE_WIDTH;
+
+/// La géométrie de la comparaison : la page source sur la page Oku.
+pub(crate) struct Geometry {
+    /// La page source, en pt de la page Oku.
+    pub(crate) rect: Frame,
+    /// Pixels par pt de la page Oku, pour que la page source y fasse `REFERENCE_WIDTH` pixels.
+    pub(crate) ppp: f64,
+    /// Largeur de la page source, en pixels.
+    pub(crate) width: u32,
+    /// Pixels par pt de la page source.
+    pub(crate) scale: f64,
+}
+
+impl Geometry {
+    /// La géométrie de la présentation `source`.
+    pub(crate) fn of(source: &SourceDeck) -> Self {
+        let rect = hifi::source_rect(source);
+        let ppp = f64::from(REFERENCE_WIDTH) / rect.w;
+        let width = px(rect.w, ppp);
+        Self { scale: f64::from(width) / source.size.w, rect, ppp, width }
+    }
+
+    /// Les bords `[gauche, haut, droite, bas]` du cadre `frame` (pt de la page Oku), en pixels de la page source.
+    ///
+    /// Signés : un cadre qui déborde de la page source garde ses bords hors d'elle.
+    pub(crate) fn edges(&self, frame: Frame) -> [f64; 4] {
+        let (x, y) = ((frame.x - self.rect.x) * self.ppp, (frame.y - self.rect.y) * self.ppp);
+        [x, y, x + frame.w * self.ppp, y + frame.h * self.ppp]
+    }
+}
+
+/// `v` pt en pixels entiers, à `ppp` pixels par pt.
+pub(crate) fn px(v: f64, ppp: f64) -> u32 {
+    // Borné à zéro, puis arrondi : un cadre fini et borné de la page tient dans `u32`.
+    (v * ppp).round().max(0.0) as u32
+}
+
+/// La vue de `r` que lit [`oku_slides_import::metrics::score`].
+pub(crate) fn image(r: &Raster) -> Image<'_> {
+    Image { width: r.width(), height: r.height(), rgba: r.rgba() }
+}
+
+/// La rognure `[x, y, w, h]` des bords `edges` (pixels signés), à `margin` pixels autour, dans une page `width` × `height`.
+///
+/// Bornée à la page, et d'un pixel au moins : un cadre hors de la page montre
+/// son bord. `None` pour une page vide.
+pub(crate) fn crop_box([left, top, right, bottom]: [f64; 4], margin: u32, width: u32, height: u32) -> Option<[u32; 4]> {
+    if width == 0 || height == 0 {
+        return None;
+    }
+    let m = f64::from(margin);
+    // Arrondi puis borné à la page : la valeur tient dans `u32`.
+    let at = |v: f64, max: u32| v.round().clamp(0.0, f64::from(max)) as u32;
+    let (x0, y0) = (at(left - m, width - 1), at(top - m, height - 1));
+    let (x1, y1) = (at(right + m, width).max(x0 + 1), at(bottom + m, height).max(y0 + 1));
+    Some([x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0])
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+#[path = "geometry_tests.rs"]
+mod geometry_tests;
```

Queue and diff. `import_report` and `import_diff` lose the witness argument; deleted slides leave the queue and the mean; every changed page is rendered first, then scores are kept after the loop, a failing slide being logged and `unscored`; `import_diff` renders the deck if needed and counts its try only after both images exist; `ReferencePending` is a new tune error with its localized message.

```diff
+fn mean(scores: impl Iterator<Item = f64>) -> Option<f64> {
+    let (sum, n) = scores.fold((0.0, 0u32), |(sum, n), s| (sum + s, n + 1));
```

```diff
+//! Le nom de chaque sorte de perte, tel que l'écrit le rapport JSON.
+
+use super::LossKind;
+
+impl LossKind {
+    /// Le nom de la sorte, l'étiquette `type` du JSON (`list_levels`, `overflow`…).
+    pub fn name(&self) -> &'static str {
+        match self {
+            Self::ListLevels => "list_levels",
+            Self::MergedCells => "merged_cells",
+            Self::PercentStacked => "percent_stacked",
+            Self::ChartFormat(_) => "chart_format",
+            Self::RunStyle(_) => "run_style",
+            Self::Transform => "transform",
+            Self::ColorDropped(_) => "color_dropped",
+            Self::TextTruncated => "text_truncated",
+            Self::TableTruncated => "table_truncated",
+            Self::ChartTruncated => "chart_truncated",
+            Self::Opaque(_) => "opaque",
+            Self::SmartArtLayout => "smart_art_layout",
+            Self::UnsupportedImage(_) => "unsupported_image",
+            Self::HiddenSlide => "hidden_slide",
+            Self::Effects => "effects",
+            Self::SeriesDropped { .. } => "series_dropped",
+            Self::RepeatedDecor { .. } => "repeated_decor",

+            Self::ParagraphStyle => "paragraph_style",
+            Self::ShapeStyle(_) => "shape_style",
```

Callers: the MCP tools run the job in a blocking task outside the lock and no longer need a witness per call; the CLI takes the same path (`set_witness`, `job.run`, `score_deck`).

```diff
+   undone import) has no page and leaves the queue, the mean and `done`. A
+   slide whose page cannot be rendered or compared is logged and listed as
+   `unscored` in that report, without stopping the others; its try is never
+   counted, as `import_diff` counts one only once both images are made.
 4. **Deck-only packs and themes.** `PackScope` (`library`, the default and
    never written to the manifest so existing hashes hold; `deck`) on
    `PackManifest` and `ThemeManifest`, kept by the versions made from them.
@@ -322,12 +329,13 @@ Decisions from the lot 5 plan (2026-10-16):
    `AgentCommand::Tune`. A failed import is a localized error and changes
    no tab.
 8. **State in the tab's memory.** `ImportState` (report, presentation, witness
-   rasters made once per tab outside the session lock by `app_witness`, tries) is kept while
+   rasters made once per tab outside the session lock by its `ReferenceJob`, concurrent tool
+   calls sharing one witness run, tries) is kept while
    the tab lives, never resumed, dropped by any other document loaded; the
    imported deck is unsaved and the import is one undoable step. Without it,
    `import_report` answers a localized "no import in this tab".
 9. **No feature flag** for the witness: it runs in the app through the render
-   worker. The app's fine-tuning uses office2pdf only (`app_witness`), whose
+   worker. The app's fine-tuning uses office2pdf only (the witness `ImportState` records at import), whose
    limits `metrics` knows; LibreOffice stays a CLI witness.
 10. **Instructions** are `crates/oku-slides-agent/src/instructions/import.md`
     (English, `include_str!`), sent before the context on a `Tune` turn only;
```

```text
fix(import) : état d'import robuste — un seul témoin, rien sous le verrou, slides supprimées, échecs isolés (t-692)

Lot 5, tâche 13 (revue du plan).

- Un seul témoin : l'état garde la place de sa référence
  (Arc<OnceLock>) ; chaque ReferenceJob la partage, le premier qui
  tourne rend, les appels concurrents attendent son résultat. Un travail
  ne remplit que la place de l'import qui l'a donné : un état remplacé
  entre-temps ne reçoit rien (set_reference, ReferenceDone et
  import_reference_done disparaissent).
- Rien sous le verrou : Session::import_report(l) et import_diff(slide,
  region) n'appellent plus le témoin ; l'appelant lance d'abord
  import_reference_job (ReferenceJob::run(platform), ou run_with pour un
  témoin de test). import_diff avant la référence : refus localisé
  ReferencePending (20 langues). ImportState note le témoin choisi à
  l'import (office2pdf en hi-fi, aucun en retrofit ; set_witness pour la
  CLI) ; la CLI prend le même chemin (set_witness, job.run, score_deck).
  Le trait du témoin devient WitnessRenderer (Send + Sync), sans conflit
  avec metrics::Witness ; app_witness disparaît, Tools n'en a plus besoin.
- Les octets du .pptx ne servent qu'au témoin : jamais gardés en
  retrofit ni sans témoin, libérés dès la référence faite (settle).
- Slides supprimées (ou import annulé) : sans page, elles sortent de la
  file, de la moyenne et du compte des done.
- Une slide qu'on ne peut rendre ou noter n'arrête plus import_report :
  journalisée, dite unscored dans ce rapport ; toutes les pages changées
  sont rendues d'abord, les notes gardées ensuite.
- import_diff rend le deck s'il ne l'est pas (ensure_rendered) et ne
  compte un essai qu'une fois les deux images faites.
- Zoom : la rognure part des bords signés du cadre (crop_box) ; un cadre
  qui commence avant la page ne l'élargit plus.
- Raster::scaled : une image vide reste vide, un facteur nul est une
  erreur Size. spans coupe une tranche avant qu'elle couvre plus de SPAN
  numéros source (debug_assert de l'ordre).
- load_document n'oublie l'import qu'une fois le nouveau document posé.
- Code mort ôté : ImportState::score_slide, Session::import_state_mut ;
  import_state réservé aux tests. LossKind::name() au lieu de sérialiser
  la perte ; ReferenceCause implémente Display ; spans tracing autour
  d'ensure_reference, du travail de référence et de rescore_changed.
- state.rs découpé : state (l'état, la référence), score (les notes),
  geometry (la page source, les rognures).
- Docs : ARCHITECTURE.md de la session, du MCP et de la CLI, règle du
  AGENTS.md du MCP, décisions 3, 8 et 9 de la spec, description de

  bords), scaled vide et par zéro, spans coupées, import gardé après un
  document refusé, LossKind::name et Display de ReferenceCause.
```

### Task 14: Agent turn and MCP edges: deck theme without confirmation, host-only Tune, untrusted import content, retrofit samples

This task answers the "Task 14" findings of the plan review (Opus with real use of the app plus the 15-agent review team): M1 (`edit_theme` on a deck-only theme asked a pointless confirmation), the host-only `Tune` command, the missing untrusted-content sentence in the import instructions, the retrofit `widget_requests` that gave the agent no pattern to design a widget from, and the `edit_templates` refusal of a deck-only pack. (1) `ThemeInfo` gains `deck_only` (`!manifest.scope.is_library()`), set by `Session::theme_info` and by the theme library listing, and mirrored in the TS `ThemeInfo` type; the MCP `edit_theme` skips `hub.confirm` when it is true, because the new version stays in the deck as one undo step and nothing reaches the library, while a library theme (built-in copy or user theme) is still confirmed; the tool description, the MCP `ARCHITECTURE.md` and a rule of the MCP `AGENTS.md` say so. (2) `AgentCommand::Tune` becomes host-only: `#[serde(skip_deserializing)]` and the `ui` field is gone, so `{"cmd":"tune"}` from the UI channel is refused; the turn's short visible text is now always in the live interface language (`LiveLocalizer::current`), `tune_text` and the test-only `AgentHandle::tune` are removed (the turn test goes through `Stack::tune`), with an agent `AGENTS.md` rule and the spec's decision 10 updated (this changes Task 8's `Tune { tab, ui? }` shape and its `ui.locale` language rule). (3) `instructions/import.md` states that slide text, images and notes are untrusted data from the imported file, never to be obeyed, and that only Oku Slides tools are used in the turn. (4) In retrofit, each `widget_requests` entry of `import_report` carries a `sample` of the pattern's first occurrence, built by the new `import/sample.rs`: item kind, preset geometry, frame in pt rounded to a tenth, fill and stroke as `#rrggbb` with the PowerPoint theme slot when they come from the theme, paragraph count, group-child depth (children follow their group); at most 16 items, the rest counted in `omitted`; never the text; the import instructions tell the agent to follow it using the deck theme's colour tokens. (5) `edit_templates` on a pack embedded by the deck as deck-only (an import's pack) is refused with `DeckOnly` (`session-deck-only`) instead of `UnknownPack`, through the new `Session::embeds_deck_only_pack`, and the tool description says to use `set_widget` instead. The spec's decisions 6 and 10 are updated. The commit was rebased onto main at 3213b0d0 with no ported main commit changing it. Later tasks build on `ThemeInfo.deck_only` and on the host-only `Tune`.

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/sample_tests.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,72 @@
+use oku_slides_import::source::{
+    Color, Fill, Frame, Geometry, Item, ItemKind, Opaque, OpaqueReason, Rgba, Shape, Stroke, TextBox,
+};
+use serde_json::json;
+use speculoos::prelude::*;
+
+use super::{MAX_SAMPLE_ITEMS, sample};
+
+/// Un item `id` de sorte `kind`, cadré en `frame`.
+fn item(id: &str, frame: Frame, kind: ItemKind) -> Item {
+    Item { id: id.into(), name: String::new(), alt: None, frame, z: 0, role: None, placeholder: None, kind }
+}
+
+/// Un item intraduisible : la plus petite sorte d'item.
+fn opaque(id: &str) -> Item {
+    item(id, Frame::new(0.0, 0.0, 10.0, 10.0), ItemKind::Opaque(Opaque { reason: OpaqueReason::Math, fallback: None }))
+}
+
+/// Une forme `rect` remplie de `fill`, contour bleu explicite.
+fn shape(fill: Fill) -> Item {
+    let stroke = Stroke {
+        width: 1.5,
+        color: Color::explicit(Rgba::new(0, 0, 255)),
+        dash: oku_slides_import::source::Dash::Solid,
+        head: None,
+        tail: None,
+    };
+    let geom = Geometry::Preset { name: "roundRect".into(), adj: Default::default() };
+    let kind = ItemKind::Shape(Box::new(Shape { geom, fill, stroke: Some(stroke), text: None, connection: None }));
+    item("s3/4", Frame::new(12.25, 40.0, 200.04, 80.0), kind)
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn sample_of_a_shape_gives_its_kind_frame_in_pt_and_colours() {
+    let fill = Fill::Solid { color: Color::mapped(Rgba::new(0x44, 0x72, 0xc4), "accent1", "accent1", Vec::new()) };
+    let v = sample(&[shape(fill)]);
+    assert_that!(v).is_equal_to(json!({ "items": [{
+        "kind": "shape",
+        "geometry": "roundRect",
+        "frame": [12.3, 40.0, 200.0, 80.0],
+        "fill": { "hex": "#4472c4", "slot": "accent1" },
+        "stroke": { "hex": "#0000ff" },
+    }] }));
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn sample_of_a_text_box_counts_its_paragraphs() {
+    let v = sample(&[item("s3/5", Frame::new(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 20.0), ItemKind::Text(TextBox::default()))]);
+    assert_that!(v)
+        .is_equal_to(json!({ "items": [{ "kind": "text", "frame": [0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 20.0], "paragraphs": 0 }] }));
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn sample_of_a_group_lists_its_children_after_it_with_their_depth() {
+    let group = ItemKind::Group { items: vec![opaque("a"), opaque("b")], smartart: None };
+    let v = sample(&[item("g", Frame::new(0.0, 0.0, 50.0, 50.0), group)]);
+    let kinds: Vec<_> =
+        v["items"].as_array().unwrap().iter().map(|i| (i["kind"].clone(), i["depth"].clone())).collect();
+    assert_that!(kinds).is_equal_to(vec![
+        (json!("group"), json!(null)),
+        (json!("opaque"), json!(1)),
+        (json!("opaque"), json!(1)),
+    ]);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn sample_beyond_the_cap_keeps_the_first_items_and_counts_the_rest() {
+    let items: Vec<Item> = (0..MAX_SAMPLE_ITEMS + 5).map(|i| opaque(&format!("s1/{i}"))).collect();
+    let v = sample(&items);
+    assert_that!(v["items"].as_array().map(Vec::len)).is_equal_to(Some(MAX_SAMPLE_ITEMS));
+    assert_that!(v["omitted"].as_u64()).is_equal_to(Some(5));
+}
```

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/sample.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,114 @@
+//! L'échantillon d'une demande de widget du retrofit, pour l'agent.
+//!
+//! L'agent dessine le widget d'un motif d'après sa première occurrence :
+//! chaque item source y est décrit court (sorte, géométrie d'une forme,
+//! cadre en pt de la page, remplissage et contour en `#rrggbb` avec
+//! l'emplacement du thème PowerPoint d'où ils viennent, nombre de
+//! paragraphes). Le texte n'y est jamais : il vient du fichier importé, non
+//! fiable, et l'agent le lit sur les slides. Les enfants d'un groupe suivent
+//! le groupe, avec leur profondeur ; au-delà de [`MAX_SAMPLE_ITEMS`] items,
+//! le reste est compté.
+
+use serde_json::{Map, Value, json};
+
+use oku_slides_import::source::{Color, Fill, Geometry, Item, ItemKind};
+
+/// Items décrits par échantillon, au plus ; le reste est compté (`omitted`).
+pub(crate) const MAX_SAMPLE_ITEMS: usize = 16;
+
+/// L'échantillon des items `items` (première occurrence d'un motif).
+pub(crate) fn sample(items: &[Item]) -> Value {
+    let mut out = Vec::new();
+    let mut omitted = 0;
+    walk(items, 0, &mut out, &mut omitted);
+    let mut v = json!({ "items": out });
+    if omitted > 0 {
+        v["omitted"] = json!(omitted);
+    }
+    v
+}
+
+/// Décrit `items` à la profondeur `depth` dans `out`, groupes d'abord puis leurs enfants.
+fn walk(items: &[Item], depth: u32, out: &mut Vec<Value>, omitted: &mut usize) {
+    for item in items {
+        if out.len() < MAX_SAMPLE_ITEMS {
+            out.push(describe(item, depth));
+        } else {
+            *omitted += 1;
+        }
+        if let ItemKind::Group { items: children, .. } = &item.kind {
+            walk(children, depth + 1, out, omitted);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// Une valeur en pt arrondie au dixième.
+fn pt(v: f64) -> f64 {
+    (v * 10.0).round() / 10.0
+}
+
+/// Une couleur : `#rrggbb` et, si elle vient du thème, son emplacement (`accent1`…).
+fn color(c: &Color) -> Value {
+    let mut v = json!({ "hex": c.value.to_hex() });
+    if let Some(slot) = c.origin.slot() {
+        v["slot"] = json!(slot);
+    }
+    v
+}
+
+/// Un remplissage peint ; `None` s'il ne peint rien.
+fn fill(f: &Fill) -> Option<Value> {
+    match f {
+        Fill::None => None,
+        Fill::Solid { color: c } => Some(color(c)),
+        Fill::Gradient { stops, .. } => {
+            let ends = [stops.first(), stops.last()];
+            Some(json!({ "gradient": ends.into_iter().flatten().map(|s| color(&s.color)).collect::<Vec<_>>() }))
+        }
+        Fill::Picture { .. } => Some(json!("picture")),
+    }
+}
+
+/// Le nom de la sorte de `kind`, comme le sérialise la source.
+fn kind_name(kind: &ItemKind) -> &'static str {
+    match kind {
+        ItemKind::Text(_) => "text",
+        ItemKind::Shape(_) => "shape",
+        ItemKind::Picture(_) => "picture",
+        ItemKind::Table(_) => "table",
+        ItemKind::Chart(_) => "chart",
+        ItemKind::Group { .. } => "group",
+        ItemKind::SmartArt(_) => "smart_art",
+        ItemKind::Opaque(_) => "opaque",
+    }
+}
+
+/// La description courte d'un item à la profondeur `depth` (absente à 0).
+fn describe(item: &Item, depth: u32) -> Value {
+    let f = &item.frame;
+    let mut v = Map::new();
+    v.insert("kind".into(), json!(kind_name(&item.kind)));
+    if depth > 0 {
+        v.insert("depth".into(), json!(depth));
+    }
+    if let ItemKind::Shape(s) = &item.kind {
+        if let Geometry::Preset { name, .. } = &s.geom {
+            v.insert("geometry".into(), json!(name));
+        }
+        if let Some(paint) = fill(&s.fill) {
+            v.insert("fill".into(), paint);
+        }
+        if let Some(stroke) = &s.stroke {
+            v.insert("stroke".into(), color(&stroke.color));
+        }
+    }
+    v.insert("frame".into(), json!([pt(f.x), pt(f.y), pt(f.w), pt(f.h)]));
+    if let Some(tb) = item.text() {
+        v.insert("paragraphs".into(), json!(tb.paragraphs.len()));
+    }
+    Value::Object(v)
+}
+
```

```diff
@@ -11,6 +11,6 @@ Never change a region that has a suspect field (the reference itself is wrong th
 A set_widget on the deck's import pack or an edit_theme changes the whole deck: the slides it changes are scored for one global try in all (global_tries_left), not their own tries, and going back to a deck state already scored is free. When global_tries_left is 0, edit neither the theme nor the pack widgets any more: each slide they change would pay one of its own tries. After any set_widget or edit_theme, call import_report: if mean is above mean_before, if worse lists a slide, or if a slide went over threshold, restore what you changed.
 groups lists patterns repeated on 3 or more slides. For each group, ask_confirm "<N> slides share this pattern: turn it into an element widget?". On yes, write an element widget for it in the deck's import pack (set_widget, then preview_widget until it renders well), then with apply replace the elements of each occurrence by one element of that widget at the same place, carrying their content over. On no, leave it.
 
-Retrofit (mode retrofit): there is no queue and no reference. +Retrofit (mode retrofit): there is no queue and no reference. For each entry of widget_requests, without asking: write an element widget for that pattern in the deck's import pack (set_widget, then preview_widget until it renders well), designed from its sample: the items of its first occurrence in drawing order (a group's children follow it with their depth), each with its kind, frame [x, y, w, h] in pt, and fill and stroke as hex with the PowerPoint theme slot they come from; use the deck theme's color tokens, not the hex values; then on every slide of its slides, read the slide and replace the element of kind fallback by an element of the new widget carrying the same content (apply replace_element, or set_kind then set_param).
 
 End with one report: the slides you changed, the slides still above threshold, the frozen items, and the witness slides (left as imported because the reference is wrong there).
\ No newline at end of file
```

### Task 15: Retrofit child pack at the first widget write, app import target by id, bounded import inputs

This task answers the plan review findings of Task 15: the retrofit child pack is created at the first widget write instead of at import (user decision), the app import path accepts a library pack id or name only, pack files are read with a size bound and without silent fallbacks, a reader panic becomes a localized error, an unreadable target theme is really refused, the "Import" undo label and the child pack name follow the live interface language, and the CLI-only helpers leave `session::import`. A retrofit deck now keeps the target library pack version as imported (`deck.templates` is the target, the version banner and the open Workshop apply, `Snapshot.deck_pack` is false) until a widget is written. The first deck-mode write on that pack (the agent's or the UI's `set_widget`, a rename, a delete) goes to the deck-only child pack of `import/child_pack.rs`: the target's files under `child_id` (SHA-256 of the `.pptx` and of the target version), parent = the target version, named "<pack> pour <deck>" (`session-import-retrofit-pack`), with the written widget. It is one version and the ordinary widget session, so one undo step, which returns the deck to the target pack; the library and the target pack never change. `ImportState` holds the pending child for the life of the tab (a resumed tab is an ordinary deck), so the CLI now writes a retrofit deck on the target pack. `ImportRequest` gains `packs: PackLookup` (`Library` for the app and `WorkspaceRequest::ImportTab`, `LibraryOrDir` for the CLI); `library_pack` (id or name) sits beside `resolve_pack` (which also reads a directory), and a directory coming from the interface is a localized unknown pack. `read_pack_dir` is bounded by `[sources] max_sources_mib` (`Storage::read_limited`, one total budget) and has no silent fallback: it returns `Result<Option<PackFiles>>`, a stat, list or read error is `File`, going over the budget is `TooLarge` (new message `session-import-pack-too-large`), a `pack.json` that is not an object is `BadPack`; the CLI logs and ignores an unreadable copy beside the deck. A panic of the reader (`read_on_own_thread`, the reader being a parameter for tests) is logged and becomes `ReaderPanic`, of kind `Presentation` (new message `session-import-reader-panic`), instead of being resumed. `deck_tokens` reads the embedded theme version (`manifest_of`) with no fallback on the default theme: absent or unreadable is `BadTheme` with its cause, and an unreadable `PackManifest::from_files` is `BadPack` with its serde source. The CLI helpers move out of `session::import` into `library_lookup.rs` (`read_pack_dir`, `library_pack`, `resolve_pack`, `embed_theme`) and `probed_widgets.rs` (`ProbedWidgets`, `sources_with_pack`), re-exported at the session root; `witness_missing` takes its detail, the `--reference soffice` wording living in the CLI. The docs follow (decision 4 of lot 5 and the retrofit fine-tuning in the spec, README, `import.md`: the first `set_widget` moves the deck onto its own copy of the target pack, the `set_widget` description, the session and CLI `ARCHITECTURE.md`, the session `AGENTS.md` rule, two template-mode rules merged to stay within 60 lines), and e2e 220 checks that a retrofit without widget keeps `deck_pack` false and the Workshop open. The commit was replayed onto main at 3213b0d0 with no ported main commit changing it. Task 16 (import dialog) and Task 17 build on the app-side `PackLookup::Library` target and the unchanged `Snapshot` shape.

- Create: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/library_lookup.rs` and `library_lookup_tests.rs` (bounded `read_pack_dir`, `library_pack`, `resolve_pack`, `embed_theme`, moved from `import/library.rs`)
- Create: `crates/oku-slides-session/src/probed_widgets.rs` and `probed_widgets_tests.rs` (`ProbedWidgets`, `sources_with_pack`, moved from `import/widgets.rs`)

  - `pub(crate) fn read_source(path, bytes, limits, reader: Reader) -> Result<SourceDeck>` with `Reader = fn(&[u8], &ReadLimits) -> Result<SourceDeck, oku_slides_import::ImportError>`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests**

The session tests pin the new behavior: a retrofit deck stays on the target library pack until a widget is written, shows the version banner when the target moves ahead, creates its deck-only child pack on the first write in one undo step (undo returns to the target) and leaves the library intact, keeps writing in the same child and step on the second write, and leaves a hi-fi deck on its generated pack. The import tests cover the planned-but-not-created child, a directory refused by `PackLookup::Library` and read by `LibraryOrDir`, the "Import" label in the live language, a reader that panics (through the `Reader` parameter), an unreadable or absent target theme, and the new error messages. `read_pack_dir` is tested on the budget, an invalid `pack.json` and an unreadable listing; `library_pack` on id and name. The `ImportTab` test refuses a directory with a localized message. The CLI tests now expect the retrofit deck on the target pack, and the e2e spec checks the Workshop. The `library_tests.rs` and `widgets_tests.rs` of `import/` are deleted with their code (their tests live on in the two new modules).

```diff
+use oku_slides_core::{Deck, PackFiles, ThemeRef};
+use speculoos::prelude::*;
+
+use super::deck_tokens;
+use crate::import::ImportErrorKind;
+use crate::{Localize, Localizer, PRO_THEME};
+
+/// Des sources vides qui embarquent `files` comme version du thème Pro.
+fn bundle_with_theme(files: PackFiles) -> (crate::SourceBundle, ThemeRef) {
+    let mut bundle = crate::SourceBundle::new(Deck::empty(), crate::test_support::registry()).unwrap();
+    let r = ThemeRef { id: PRO_THEME, version: bundle.add_theme(files) };
+    (bundle, r)
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn deck_tokens_of_an_unreadable_embedded_theme_is_refused() {
+    let serde_json::Value::Object(manifest) = serde_json::json!({ "name": 3 }) else { unreachable!() };
+    let (bundle, r) = bundle_with_theme(PackFiles::new(manifest, Default::default()));
+    let err = deck_tokens(&bundle, &r).unwrap_err();
+    assert_that!(err.kind()).is_equal_to(ImportErrorKind::BadTheme);
+    let (fr, en) = (err.localize(&Localizer::new(Some("fr"))), err.localize(&Localizer::new(Some("en"))));
+    assert_that!(fr).is_not_equal_to(en);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn deck_tokens_of_a_theme_missing_from_the_sources_is_refused() {
+    let (bundle, mut r) = bundle_with_theme(PackFiles::new(Default::default(), Default::default()));
+    r.version =
+        PackFiles::new(Default::default(), [(oku_slides_core::WidgetFile::parse("x").unwrap(), String::new())].into())
+            .version();
+    let err = deck_tokens(&bundle, &r).unwrap_err();
+    assert_that!(err.kind()).is_equal_to(ImportErrorKind::BadTheme);
+}
```

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/library_lookup_tests.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,179 @@
+use oku_slides_core::PackManifest;
+use oku_slides_i18n::Localize;
+use speculoos::prelude::*;
+
+use super::*;
+use crate::import::ImportErrorKind;
+use crate::{DEFAULT_PACK, GRID_PACK, PRO_THEME};
+
+/// L'interface en français : les erreurs se testent hors de l'anglais.
+fn fr() -> &'static oku_slides_i18n::Localizer {
+    static FR: std::sync::LazyLock<oku_slides_i18n::Localizer> =
+        std::sync::LazyLock::new(|| oku_slides_i18n::Localizer::new(Some("fr")));
+    &FR
+}
+
+/// Une bibliothèque de packs vide dans un dossier temporaire (les intégrés seulement).
+fn library(dir: &Path) -> (Storage, PackLibrary) {
+    let storage = Storage::local().unwrap();
+    let library = PackLibrary::new(Some(dir.join("templates")), storage.clone());
+    (storage, library)
+}
+
+/// Un budget de lecture qui ne gêne pas.
+const MAX: usize = 1 << 20;
+
+fn pack_id(files: &PackFiles) -> uuid::Uuid {
+    PackManifest::from_files(files).unwrap().id
+}
+
+/// Écrit dans `dir` le `pack.json` du pack intégré Grilles et un widget `citation`.
+fn write_pack_dir(dir: &Path) {
+    let json = include_str!("../../../templates/grilles/pack.json");
+    std::fs::create_dir_all(dir.join("widgets")).unwrap();
+    std::fs::write(dir.join("pack.json"), json).unwrap();
+    std::fs::write(dir.join("widgets").join("citation.typ"), "// widget").unwrap();
+}
+
+/// Des sources vides, sur le registre de base figé.
+fn empty_bundle() -> SourceBundle {
+    SourceBundle::new(oku_slides_core::Deck::empty(), crate::test_support::registry()).unwrap()
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn read_pack_dir_reads_the_manifest_and_the_widget_files() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    write_pack_dir(tmp.path());
+    let (storage, _) = library(tmp.path());
+    let files = read_pack_dir(&storage, tmp.path(), MAX).unwrap().unwrap();
+    let names: Vec<String> = files.widgets().keys().map(|w| w.file_name()).collect();
+    assert_that!((pack_id(&files), names)).is_equal_to((GRID_PACK, vec!["citation.typ".to_owned()]));
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn read_pack_dir_without_pack_json_is_none() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let (storage, _) = library(tmp.path());
+    assert_that!(read_pack_dir(&storage, tmp.path(), MAX).unwrap()).is_none();
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn read_pack_dir_beyond_its_budget_is_too_large() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    write_pack_dir(tmp.path());
+    let (storage, _) = library(tmp.path());
+    let size = std::fs::metadata(tmp.path().join("pack.json")).unwrap().len() as usize;
+    // Le pack.json tient, le widget (10 octets) non.
+    let err = read_pack_dir(&storage, tmp.path(), size + 5).unwrap_err();
+    assert_that!(err.kind()).is_equal_to(ImportErrorKind::TooLarge);
+    assert_that!(err.localize(fr())).contains("pack");
+    assert_that!(err.localize(fr())).is_not_equal_to(err.localize(&oku_slides_i18n::Localizer::new(Some("en"))));
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn read_pack_dir_with_a_manifest_that_is_not_an_object_is_a_bad_pack() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    std::fs::write(tmp.path().join("pack.json"), "[]").unwrap();
+    let (storage, _) = library(tmp.path());
+    let err = read_pack_dir(&storage, tmp.path(), MAX).unwrap_err();
+    assert_that!(err.kind()).is_equal_to(ImportErrorKind::BadPack);
+}
+
+#[cfg(unix)]
+#[test]
+fn read_pack_dir_whose_widgets_cannot_be_listed_is_a_file_error() {
+    use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    write_pack_dir(tmp.path());
+    let widgets = tmp.path().join("widgets");
+    // Un dossier qu'on ne lit pas : sa liste échoue, elle n'est pas vide.
+    std::fs::set_permissions(&widgets, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o000)).unwrap();
+    let (storage, _) = library(tmp.path());
+    let read = read_pack_dir(&storage, tmp.path(), MAX).map(|_| ()).map_err(|e| e.kind());
+    std::fs::set_permissions(&widgets, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755)).unwrap();
+    assert_that!(read).is_equal_to(Err(ImportErrorKind::File));
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn resolve_pack_by_name_ignores_case() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let (storage, library) = library(tmp.path());
+    let files = resolve_pack(&storage, &library, "essentiel", MAX).unwrap();
+    assert_that!(pack_id(&files)).is_equal_to(DEFAULT_PACK);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn resolve_pack_by_id_takes_the_current_version() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let (storage, library) = library(tmp.path());
+    let files = resolve_pack(&storage, &library, &GRID_PACK.to_string(), MAX).unwrap();
+    assert_that!(files.version()).is_equal_to(library.current_version(GRID_PACK).unwrap().version);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn resolve_pack_by_folder_reads_it() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let dir = tmp.path().join("mon-pack");
+    write_pack_dir(&dir);
+    let (storage, library) = library(tmp.path());
+    let files = resolve_pack(&storage, &library, dir.to_str().unwrap(), MAX).unwrap();
+    assert_that!(files.widgets().len()).is_equal_to(1);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn resolve_pack_unknown_fails_with_a_localized_message() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let (storage, library) = library(tmp.path());
+    let err = resolve_pack(&storage, &library, "Nope", MAX).unwrap_err();
+    assert_that!(err.kind()).is_equal_to(ImportErrorKind::UnknownPack);
+    assert_that!(err.localize(fr())).is_equal_to("pack inconnu : Nope".to_owned());
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn resolve_pack_unknown_id_fails_too() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let (storage, library) = library(tmp.path());
+    let id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000";
+    assert_that!(resolve_pack(&storage, &library, id, MAX)).is_err();
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn library_pack_by_name_or_id_gives_the_current_version() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let (_, library) = library(tmp.path());
+    let by_name = library_pack(&library, "GRILLES").unwrap();
+    let by_id = library_pack(&library, &GRID_PACK.to_string()).unwrap();
+    assert_that!(by_name.version()).is_equal_to(by_id.version());
+    assert_that!(pack_id(&by_id)).is_equal_to(GRID_PACK);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn library_pack_never_reads_a_folder() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let dir = tmp.path().join("mon-pack");
+    write_pack_dir(&dir);
+    let (_, library) = library(tmp.path());
+    let err = library_pack(&library, dir.to_str().unwrap()).unwrap_err();
+    assert_that!(err.kind()).is_equal_to(ImportErrorKind::UnknownPack);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn embed_theme_by_name_or_id_embeds_the_same_version() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let themes = ThemeLibrary::new(Some(tmp.path().join("themes")), Storage::local().unwrap());
+    let mut bundle = empty_bundle();
+    let by_name = embed_theme(&themes, "PRO", &mut bundle).unwrap();
+    let by_id = embed_theme(&themes, &PRO_THEME.to_string(), &mut bundle).unwrap();
+    assert_that!(by_name).is_equal_to(by_id.clone());
+    assert_that!(by_id.id).is_equal_to(PRO_THEME);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn embed_theme_unknown_fails_with_a_localized_message() {
+    let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
+    let themes = ThemeLibrary::new(Some(tmp.path().join("themes")), Storage::local().unwrap());
+    let mut bundle = empty_bundle();
+    let err = embed_theme(&themes, "Nope", &mut bundle).unwrap_err();
+    assert_that!(err.kind()).is_equal_to(ImportErrorKind::UnknownTheme);
+    assert_that!(err.localize(fr())).is_equal_to("Thème inconnu : Nope".to_owned());
+}
```

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/probed_widgets_tests.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,71 @@
+use speculoos::prelude::*;
+
+use super::*;
+
+/// Rejoue `left` (fichiers non sondés après chaque appel) ; rend le résultat et le nombre d'appels.
+fn rounds(left: &[usize]) -> (Result<usize, &'static str>, usize) {
+    let mut calls = 0;
+    let out = probe_rounds(
+        || {
+            calls += 1;
+            Ok(left[(calls - 1).min(left.len() - 1)])
+        },
+        |n| *n,
+        || false,
+    );
+    (out, calls)
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn probe_rounds_stops_once_every_file_is_probed() {
+    let (out, calls) = rounds(&[3, 1, 0, 0]);
+    assert_that!(out).is_equal_to(Ok(0));
+    assert_that!(calls).is_equal_to(3);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn probe_rounds_stops_when_a_round_probes_nothing() {
+    // Processus de rendu indisponible : le deuxième appel ne sonde rien, on s'arrête.
+    let (out, calls) = rounds(&[5, 5, 5]);
+    assert_that!(out).is_equal_to(Ok(5));
+    assert_that!(calls).is_equal_to(2);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn probe_rounds_makes_at_most_the_bounded_number_of_calls() {
+    let left: Vec<usize> = (0..20).rev().collect();
+    let (out, calls) = rounds(&left[..19]);
+    assert_that!(calls).is_equal_to(PROBE_ROUNDS);
+    assert_that!(out).is_equal_to(Ok(19 - PROBE_ROUNDS + 1));
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn probe_rounds_stops_at_the_first_error() {
+    let mut calls = 0;
+    let out: Result<usize, &str> = probe_rounds(
+        || {
+            calls += 1;
+            if calls == 1 { Ok(4) } else { Err("lien rompu") }
+        },
+        |n| *n,
+        || false,
+    );
+    assert_that!(out).is_equal_to(Err("lien rompu"));
+    assert_that!(calls).is_equal_to(2);
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn probe_rounds_stops_once_the_total_time_is_spent() {
+    // Chaque appel épuise son budget : le temps total est écoulé après le troisième.
+    let calls = std::cell::Cell::new(0);
+    let out: Result<usize, &str> = probe_rounds(
+        || {
+            calls.set(calls.get() + 1);
+            Ok(10 - calls.get())
+        },
+        |n| *n,
+        || calls.get() >= PROBE_BUDGETS as usize,
+    );
+    assert_that!(calls.get()).is_equal_to(PROBE_BUDGETS as usize);
+    assert_that!(out).is_equal_to(Ok(10 - PROBE_BUDGETS as usize));
+}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

Session child pack: `child_pack.rs` holds `child_id` and `ChildPack` (name from the live localizer, target `PackRef`); `Session::retrofit_child_target` returns the child's `WidgetTarget` only when the written pack is the target of the pending child, and `widgets_deck.rs` uses it so the first write creates the child in the ordinary widget session.

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/import/child_pack.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+//! Le pack enfant d'un retrofit, créé à la première écriture d'un widget du deck.
+//!
+//! Un deck de retrofit garde le pack cible de la bibliothèque (atelier
+//! ouvert, bandeau des versions) tant qu'aucun widget ne s'y écrit. La
+//! première écriture en mode deck sur ce pack, de l'agent ou de
+//! l'interface, va à sa place dans un pack du deck seul : les fichiers de
+//! la version cible sous un id tiré du `.pptx` et de cette version
+//! ([`child_id`]), de parente la version cible, nommé « <pack> pour
+//! <deck> », avec le widget écrit. Une seule version et la séance de
+//! widgets ordinaire (`widgets_deck.rs`) : une seule étape d'annulation, que
+//! l'annulation défait en rendant le pack cible. La bibliothèque et le pack
+//! cible ne changent jamais.
+//!
+//! L'état de l'import ([`super::ImportState`]) garde ce pack à venir tant
+//! que vit l'onglet ; un deck repris ou relu est un deck ordinaire sur son pack.
+
+use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
+use uuid::{Builder, Uuid};
+
+use oku_slides_core::{PackRef, PackScope, PackVersion};
+use oku_slides_i18n::Localizer;
+
+use crate::Session;
+use crate::pack::PackManifest;
+use crate::widgets_edit::WidgetTarget;
+
+/// Id du pack enfant du retrofit de `pptx` sur la version `target`.
+///
+/// La moitié haute du SHA-256 de l'empreinte du `.pptx` suivie de la
+/// version cible, en UUID v8 : le même fichier sur la même version donne le
+/// même pack, une autre cible un autre pack.
+pub(crate) fn child_id(pptx: &[u8], target: &PackVersion) -> Uuid {
+    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
+    hasher.update(Sha256::digest(pptx));
+    hasher.update(target.as_str().as_bytes());
+    let digest: [u8; 32] = hasher.finalize().into();
+    let mut bytes = [0u8; 16];
+    bytes.copy_from_slice(&digest[..16]);
+    Builder::from_custom_bytes(bytes).into_uuid()
+}
+
+/// Le pack enfant d'un retrofit, pas encore créé : son id, son nom et la version cible.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
+pub(crate) struct ChildPack {
+    id: Uuid,
+    name: String,
+    target: PackRef,
+}
+
+impl ChildPack {
+    /// L'enfant du retrofit de `pptx` sur `target`, version du pack nommé `pack`, pour le deck `deck`.
+    ///
+    /// Son nom est dans la langue `l`, celle de l'interface à l'import.
+    pub(crate) fn new(l: &Localizer, pptx: &[u8], target: PackRef, pack: &str, deck: &str) -> Self {
+        let name = l.tr_with("session-import-retrofit-pack", &[("pack", pack.into()), ("deck", deck.into())]);
+        Self { id: child_id(pptx, &target.version), name, target }
+    }
+
+    /// La version cible, que le deck garde tant qu'aucun widget ne s'y écrit.
+    #[cfg(test)]
+    pub(crate) fn target(&self) -> &PackRef {
+        &self.target
+    }
+
+    /// Fait d'une écriture sur `t`, la version cible, une écriture sur le pack enfant.
+    ///
+    /// `manifest` prend l'id, le nom et la portée du deck seul ; la cible
+    /// rendue a les fichiers de la version cible, qui devient la parente.
+    fn adopt(&self, t: &WidgetTarget, manifest: &mut PackManifest) -> WidgetTarget {
+        manifest.id = self.id;
+        manifest.name.clone_from(&self.name);
+        manifest.scope = PackScope::Deck;
+        WidgetTarget { id: self.id, version: t.version.clone(), files: t.files.clone() }
+    }
+}
+
+impl Session {
+    /// Le pack enfant du retrofit qui reçoit une écriture de widgets sur `t`, si `t` est sa version cible.
+    ///
+    /// `manifest` (celui de l'écriture) devient alors celui de l'enfant.
+    /// `None` hors d'un onglet de retrofit, ou une fois le deck sur un autre pack.
+    pub(crate) fn retrofit_child_target(&self, t: &WidgetTarget, manifest: &mut PackManifest) -> Option<WidgetTarget> {
+        let child = self.import.as_ref()?.child()?;
+        let on_target = t.id == child.target.id && t.version == child.target.version;
+        on_target.then(|| child.adopt(t, manifest))
+    }
+}
```

Helpers moved out of `import/` (the old files are deleted), with the bounded and error-returning `read_pack_dir`:

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/library_lookup.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,109 @@
+//! Packs et thèmes désignés par l'utilisateur : un pack ou un thème trouvé
+//! par son id ou son nom dans la bibliothèque, ou, pour la CLI seulement, un
+//! pack lu dans un dossier, borné en taille ; un thème embarqué dans des
+//! sources. L'import et la CLI passent par ici ; leurs erreurs sont celles de
+//! l'import ([`ImportError`](crate::import::ImportError)).
+
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::path::Path;
+
+use snafu::{IntoError, OptionExt, ResultExt};
+
+use oku_slides_core::{PackFiles, SourceBundle, ThemeRef, WidgetFile};
+use oku_slides_platform::storage::{Storage, StorageErrorKind};
+
+use crate::import::error::{
+    BadPackFilesSnafu, PackDirSnafu, PackTooLargeSnafu, Result, UnknownPackSnafu, UnknownThemeSnafu,
+};
+use crate::{PackLibrary, ThemeLibrary};
+
+/// `n` octets en `u64`.
+pub(crate) fn as_u64(n: usize) -> u64 {
+    // Saturé, jamais atteint : `usize` tient dans `u64` sur toutes les cibles (64 bits au plus),
+    // et les réglages en Mio sont déjà saturés en `usize`.
+    u64::try_from(n).unwrap_or(u64::MAX)
+}
+
+/// Les fichiers du pack rangé dans `dir` (`pack.json`, `widgets/<nom>.typ`), `max_bytes` octets au plus en tout.
+///
+/// C'est la disposition d'une version de pack ; `Ok(None)` sans `pack.json`.
+/// Un fichier qu'on ne lit pas, un dossier qu'on ne liste pas : `File` ; au-delà
+/// de `max_bytes` : `TooLarge`, avant de lire le fichier de trop ; un
+/// `pack.json` qui n'est pas un objet ou un widget qui n'est pas du texte : `BadPack`.
+pub fn read_pack_dir(storage: &Storage, dir: &Path, max_bytes: usize) -> Result<Option<PackFiles>> {
+    let manifest = dir.join("pack.json");
+    if storage.len(&manifest).context(PackDirSnafu { path: &manifest })?.is_none() {
+        return Ok(None);
+    }
+    let max = as_u64(max_bytes);
+    let mut left = max;
+    let mut read = |path: &Path| -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
+        let bytes = match storage.read_limited(path, left) {
+            Ok(bytes) => bytes,
+            Err(e) if e.kind() == StorageErrorKind::TooLarge => {
+                return Err(PackTooLargeSnafu { path: dir, max }.build().into());
+            }
+            Err(e) => return Err(PackDirSnafu { path }.into_error(e).into()),
+        };
+        left = left.saturating_sub(as_u64(bytes.len()));
+        Ok(bytes)
+    };
+    let pack_json = read(&manifest)?;
+    let widgets_dir = dir.join("widgets");
+    let listed = storage.list_files(&widgets_dir).context(PackDirSnafu { path: &widgets_dir })?;
+    let mut widgets = BTreeMap::new();
+    for path in listed {
+        let Some(name) = path.file_name().and_then(|n| n.to_str()).and_then(WidgetFile::from_file_name) else {
+            continue;
+        };
+        widgets.insert(name, read(&path)?);
+    }
+    let files = PackFiles::from_bytes(&pack_json, widgets.iter().map(|(n, b)| (n.clone(), b.as_slice())))
+        .context(BadPackFilesSnafu { pack: dir.display().to_string() })?;
+    Ok(Some(files))
+}
+
+/// Le pack de la bibliothèque désigné par `wanted` : un id, sinon un nom.
+///
+/// Un id donne la version courante ; un nom est celui d'un pack intégré ou de
+/// la bibliothèque, sans casse. Jamais un dossier : c'est la cible de l'app.
+/// Introuvable : `UnknownPack`.
+pub fn library_pack(library: &PackLibrary, wanted: &str) -> Result<PackFiles> {
+    let unknown = || UnknownPackSnafu { pack: wanted };
+    let id = match uuid::Uuid::parse_str(wanted) {
+        Ok(id) => id,
+        Err(_) => library.packs().into_iter().find(|p| p.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(wanted)).context(unknown())?.id,
+    };
+    Ok(library.current_version(id).context(unknown())?.files)
+}
+
+/// Le pack désigné par `wanted` pour la CLI : un id, un dossier de pack, sinon un nom.
+///
+/// Comme [`library_pack`], plus un dossier qui a un `pack.json`, lu par
+/// [`read_pack_dir`] en `max_bytes` octets au plus.
+pub fn resolve_pack(storage: &Storage, library: &PackLibrary, wanted: &str, max_bytes: usize) -> Result<PackFiles> {
+    if uuid::Uuid::parse_str(wanted).is_err()
+        && let Some(files) = read_pack_dir(storage, Path::new(wanted), max_bytes)?
+    {
+        return Ok(files);
+    }
+    library_pack(library, wanted)
+}
+
+/// Embarque dans `bundle` la version courante du thème désigné par `wanted`.
+///
+/// `wanted` est son id, sinon son nom (intégré ou de la bibliothèque, sans
+/// casse) ; rend sa référence. Inconnu : `UnknownTheme`.
+pub fn embed_theme(themes: &ThemeLibrary, wanted: &str, bundle: &mut SourceBundle) -> Result<ThemeRef> {
+    let unknown = || UnknownThemeSnafu { theme: wanted };
+    let id = match uuid::Uuid::parse_str(wanted) {
+        Ok(id) => id,
+        Err(_) => themes.themes().into_iter().find(|t| t.name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(wanted)).context(unknown())?.id,
+    };
+    let current = themes.current_version(id).context(unknown())?;
+    Ok(ThemeRef { id, version: bundle.add_theme(current.files) })
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+#[path = "library_lookup_tests.rs"]
+mod library_lookup_tests;
```
```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-session/src/probed_widgets.rs
@@ -0,0 +1,181 @@
+//! Les widgets d'un deck hors session : son pack embarqué, sondé par le
+//! processus de rendu ([`ProbedWidgets::probe`]). Chaque fichier est sondé à
+//! part, les widgets cassés écartés (diagnostics au journal) ; le registre
+//! sondé valide le deck (t-355).
+//!
+//! Un import ou une commande n'a pas de « rendu suivant » : les fichiers
+//! laissés non sondés (budget épuisé) sont sondés de nouveau, tant qu'un appel
+//! en sonde au moins un, en [`PROBE_ROUNDS`] appels et [`PROBE_BUDGETS`]
+//! budgets de sonde au plus. Le code d'un pack reçu est isolé et borné dans
+//! ce processus (délai, mémoire : spec t-327).
+//!
+//! L'import et la CLI s'en servent ; leurs erreurs sont celles de l'import
+//! ([`ImportError`](crate::import::ImportError)).
+
+use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
+use std::sync::Arc;
+use std::time::Instant;
+
+use snafu::ResultExt;
+
+use oku_slides_core::{Deck, PackFiles, PackVersion, SourceBundle, WidgetFile, WidgetRegistry};
+use oku_slides_i18n::{Localize, Localizer};
+use oku_slides_platform::Platform;
+use oku_slides_platform::errors::one_line;
+use oku_slides_render::{Fonts, PackWidgets, RenderError};
+use oku_slides_render_worker::{RenderSlot, RenderWorker};
+
+use crate::import::error::{LibrarySnafu, Result, SourcesSnafu};
+use crate::{PackLibrary, adopt_default_pack};
+
+/// Appels de sonde d'un pack au plus.
+///
+/// Les sondes faites sont gardées par le processus de rendu : un appel qui ne
+/// fait pas baisser le nombre de fichiers non sondés (processus indisponible)
+/// arrête la relance avant cette borne.
+const PROBE_ROUNDS: usize = 8;
+
+/// Durée totale de la relance, en budgets de sonde (`probe_budget_ms`).
+///
+/// Chaque appel peut épuiser le sien, la relance n'en épuise pas plus de
+/// trois (un import ou une commande `open` ou `render` attend au plus ce temps-là).
+const PROBE_BUDGETS: u32 = 3;
+
+/// Appelle `probe` tant que des fichiers restent non sondés, que chaque appel en sonde et que le temps reste.
+///
+/// `unprobed` compte les fichiers non sondés d'un résultat ; `expired`, lu
+/// avant chaque relance, dit le temps écoulé. [`PROBE_ROUNDS`] appels au
+/// plus ; la première erreur arrête tout.
+fn probe_rounds<T, E>(
+    mut probe: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, E>,
+    unprobed: impl Fn(&T) -> usize,
+    expired: impl Fn() -> bool,
+) -> Result<T, E> {
+    let mut last = probe()?;
+    for _ in 1..PROBE_ROUNDS {
+        let left = unprobed(&last);
+        if left == 0 || expired() {
+            break;
+        }
+        let next = probe()?;
+        let progressed = unprobed(&next) < left;
+        last = next;
+        if !progressed {
+            break;
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(last)
+}
+
+/// Les widgets sondés d'un deck, et le processus de rendu qui les rend.
+///
+/// Le registre est la base surchargée par les widgets valides de son pack ;
+/// sans pack à widgets valides, la base seule.
+#[derive(Debug)]
+pub struct ProbedWidgets {
+    /// Le registre qui valide le deck et ses sources.
+    pub registry: Arc<WidgetRegistry>,
+    /// Fichiers du pack toujours non sondés après la relance (budget épuisé, lien indisponible).
+    pub unprobed: BTreeSet<WidgetFile>,
+    /// L'erreur localisée d'une sonde du pack tout entière échouée ; le registre est alors la base.
+    pub probe_failed: Option<String>,
+    worker: RenderWorker,
+    pack: Option<PackWidgets>,
+}
+
+impl ProbedWidgets {
+    /// Sonde le pack que `deck` référence, pris dans `packs`.
+    ///
+    /// Sans référence, ou sans widgets : la base. Version absente de `packs`
+    /// ou pack cassé : journalisés, la base, comme dans l'app ; une sonde
+    /// échouée garde son erreur ([`Self::probe_failed`]).
+    pub fn probe(
+        platform: &Platform,
+        base: &Arc<WidgetRegistry>,
+        deck: &Deck,
+        packs: &BTreeMap<PackVersion, PackFiles>,
+    ) -> Self {
+        let l: &Localizer = &platform.localizer;
+        let worker = RenderWorker::new(platform.render_launch.clone(), platform.settings.render.clone());
+        let base_only =
+            |worker| Self { registry: base.clone(), unprobed: BTreeSet::new(), probe_failed: None, worker, pack: None };
+        let Some(r) = &deck.templates else { return base_only(worker) };
+        let Some(files) = packs.get(&r.version) else {
+            tracing::warn!(pack = %r.id, version = %r.version, "{}", l.tr("session-pack-missing"));
+            return base_only(worker);
+        };
+        if files.widgets().is_empty() {
+            return base_only(worker);
+        }
+        let (start, total) = (Instant::now(), platform.settings.render.probe_budget().saturating_mul(PROBE_BUDGETS));
+        let probed = PackWidgets::new(r.version.hex(), files.widgets().clone()).and_then(|pack| {
+            probe_rounds(|| worker.probe_pack(&pack), |p| p.unprobed.len(), || start.elapsed() >= total)
+        });
+        let probe = match probed {
+            Ok(probe) => probe,
+            Err(e) => {
+                let message = e.localize(l);
+                tracing::warn!(pack = %r.id, error = %one_line(&e), "{message}");
+                return Self { probe_failed: Some(message), ..base_only(worker) };
+            }
+        };
+        for (name, file) in probe.files.iter().filter(|(_, p)| !p.is_valid()) {
+            for d in &file.diagnostics {
+                tracing::warn!(pack = %r.id, widget = %name, "{}", d.localize(l));
+            }
+        }
+        match probe.pack {
+            Some(pack) => Self {
+                registry: probe.registry,
+                unprobed: probe.unprobed,
+                probe_failed: None,
+                worker,
+                pack: Some(pack),
+            },
+            None => Self { unprobed: probe.unprobed, ..base_only(worker) },
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// Le pack a-t-il des widgets valides, que seul le processus de rendu exécute ?
+    pub fn has_pack(&self) -> bool {
+        self.pack.is_some()
+    }
+
+    /// Un emplacement du processus de rendu, avec ces widgets et les polices `fonts`.
+    pub fn slot(&self, fonts: &Fonts, l: &Localizer) -> Result<RenderSlot, RenderError> {
+        let mut slot = self.worker.slot(fonts, l, self.registry.clone())?;
+        slot.set_widgets(self.pack.as_ref(), self.registry.clone())?;
+        Ok(slot)
+    }
+}
+
+/// Les sources de `deck` avec son pack (`packs`), et les widgets sondés de ce pack.
+///
+/// Sans pack référencé, le deck adopte la version courante du pack par défaut,
+/// modifiable : elle peut avoir des widgets. Le pack est sondé avant toute
+/// écriture ; les sources sont recréées avec le registre sondé, pour que le
+/// replica et la validation aient ses widgets.
+pub fn sources_with_pack(
+    platform: &Platform,
+    library: &PackLibrary,
+    base: &Arc<WidgetRegistry>,
+    deck: Deck,
+    packs: BTreeMap<PackVersion, PackFiles>,
+) -> Result<(SourceBundle, ProbedWidgets)> {
+    let mut bundle = SourceBundle::new(deck, base.clone()).context(SourcesSnafu)?;
+    for files in packs.into_values() {
+        bundle.add_pack(files);
+    }
+    adopt_default_pack(library, &mut bundle).context(LibrarySnafu)?;
+    let widgets = ProbedWidgets::probe(platform, base, bundle.deck(), &bundle.packs);
+    if !Arc::ptr_eq(&widgets.registry, base) {
+        let packs = std::mem::take(&mut bundle.packs);
+        bundle = SourceBundle::new(bundle.deck().clone(), widgets.registry.clone()).context(SourcesSnafu)?;
+        bundle.packs = packs;
+    }
+    Ok((bundle, widgets))
+}
+
+#[cfg(test)]
+#[path = "probed_widgets_tests.rs"]
+mod probed_widgets_tests;
```

```diff
-/// Durée totale de la relance, en budgets de sonde (`probe_budget_ms`).

-/// Appelle `probe` tant que des fichiers restent non sondés, que chaque appel en sonde et que le temps reste.

-    mut probe: impl FnMut() -> Result<T, E>,
-    unprobed: impl Fn(&T) -> usize,
-    expired: impl Fn() -> bool,
```

```diff
--- a/crates/oku-slides-agent/src/instructions/import.md
+++ b/crates/oku-slides-agent/src/instructions/import.md
@@ -11,6 +11,6 @@ Never change a region that has a suspect field (the reference itself is wrong th
 A set_widget on the deck's import pack or an edit_theme changes the whole deck: the slides it changes are scored for one global try in all (global_tries_left), not their own tries, and going back to a deck state already scored is free. When global_tries_left is 0, edit neither the theme nor the pack widgets any more: each slide they change would pay one of its own tries. After any set_widget or edit_theme, call import_report: if mean is above mean_before, if worse lists a slide, or if a slide went over threshold, restore what you changed.
 groups lists patterns repeated on 3 or more slides. For each group, ask_confirm "<N> slides share this pattern: turn it into an element widget?". On yes, write an element widget for it in the deck's import pack (set_widget, then preview_widget until it renders well), then with apply replace the elements of each occurrence by one element of that widget at the same place, carrying their content over. On no, leave it.
 
-Retrofit (mode retrofit): there is no queue and no reference. For each entry of widget_requests, without asking: write an element widget for that pattern in the deck's import pack (set_widget, then preview_widget until it renders well), designed from its sample: the items of its first occurrence in drawing order (a group's children follow it with their depth), each with its kind, frame [x, y, w, h] in pt, and fill and stroke as hex with the PowerPoint theme slot they come from; use the deck theme's color tokens, not the hex values; then on every slide of its slides, read the slide and replace the element of kind fallback by an element of the new widget carrying the same content (apply replace_element, or set_kind then set_param).
+Retrofit (mode retrofit): there is no queue and no reference. For each entry of widget_requests, without asking: write an element widget for that pattern in the deck's pack (set_widget, then preview_widget until it renders well; the first set_widget moves the deck onto its own copy of the target pack, so the library pack never changes), designed from its sample: the items of its first occurrence in drawing order (a group's children follow it with their depth), each with its kind, frame [x, y, w, h] in pt, and fill and stroke as hex with the PowerPoint theme slot they come from; use the deck theme's color tokens, not the hex values; then on every slide of its slides, read the slide and replace the element of kind fallback by an element of the new widget carrying the same content (apply replace_element, or set_kind then set_param).
 
 End with one report: the slides you changed, the slides still above threshold, the frozen items, and the witness slides (left as imported because the reference is wrong there).
\ No newline at end of file
```

```text
feat(import) : pack enfant du retrofit à la première écriture ; cible d'import de l'app par id, entrées bornées (t-692)

Lot 5, tâche 15 (revue du plan).

- Décision de l'utilisateur : un deck de retrofit garde la version cible
  du pack de la bibliothèque (bandeau des versions, atelier ouvert,
  Snapshot.deck_pack faux) tant qu'aucun widget ne s'y écrit. La première
  écriture en mode deck sur ce pack (set_widget de l'agent ou de
  l'interface, renommage, suppression) va dans le pack enfant
  (import/child_pack.rs) : les fichiers de la cible sous child_id (SHA-256
  du .pptx et de la version cible), de parente la version cible, nommé
  « <pack> pour <deck> », du deck seul, avec le widget écrit. Une seule
  version et la séance de widgets ordinaire : une étape d'annulation, que
  l'annulation défait en rendant le pack cible ; la bibliothèque et le
  pack cible ne changent jamais. ImportState garde l'enfant à venir tant
  que vit l'onglet ; un onglet repris est un deck ordinaire. La CLI écrit
  donc un deck de retrofit sur le pack cible.
- Cible de l'app par id ou nom seulement : ImportRequest.packs
  (PackLookup::Library pour l'app et WorkspaceRequest::ImportTab,
  LibraryOrDir pour la CLI) ; library_pack (id ou nom) à côté de
  resolve_pack (aussi un dossier). Un dossier venu de l'interface est un
  pack inconnu, localisé.
- read_pack_dir borné par [sources] max_sources_mib (read_limited, budget
  total) et sans repli muet : Result<Option<PackFiles>>, une erreur de
  stat, de liste ou de lecture est File, au-delà du budget TooLarge
  (nouveau message session-import-pack-too-large), un pack.json qui n'est
  pas un objet BadPack ; la CLI journalise et ignore une copie à côté du
  deck illisible.
- Une panique du lecteur (read_on_own_thread, lecteur passé en argument
  pour les tests) est journalisée et devient ReaderPanic, de nature
  Presentation (session-import-reader-panic), au lieu d'être relancée.
- Thème cible illisible vraiment refusé : deck_tokens lit la version
  embarquée (manifest_of) sans repli sur le thème par défaut ; absente ou
  illisible : BadTheme, avec sa cause. PackManifest::from_files illisible :
  BadPack avec sa source serde.
- Langue courante (live_localizer) pour le libellé « Import » et le nom du
  pack enfant.
- Aides de la CLI sorties de session::import : library_lookup.rs
  (read_pack_dir, library_pack, resolve_pack, embed_theme) et
  probed_widgets.rs (ProbedWidgets, sources_with_pack), réexportés à la
  racine de la session. witness_missing prend son détail : le texte de
  --reference soffice vit dans la CLI.
- Docs : décision 4 du lot 5 et fine-tuning du retrofit dans la spec,
  README, import.md (le premier set_widget passe le deck sur sa propre
  copie du pack cible), description de set_widget, ARCHITECTURE.md de la
  session et de la CLI, règle du AGENTS.md de la session (deux règles du
  mode modèles fusionnées pour tenir en 60 lignes). e2e 220 : le retrofit
  sans widget garde deck_pack faux et l'atelier ouvert.
- Tests : session (retrofit sur le pack cible, bandeau quand la cible
  avance, première écriture qui crée l'enfant en une étape et laisse la
  bibliothèque intacte, deuxième écriture dans la même étape, hi-fi
  inchangé), import (enfant prévu sans être créé, dossier refusé par la

  ImportTab sur un dossier refusé et localisé, read_pack_dir (budget,
  pack.json invalide, liste illisible), library_pack, lecteur en panique,
  thème illisible ou absent, nouveaux messages d'erreur ; tests de la CLI
```

### Task 16: Import dialog hardening: held shortcuts, shared modal frame, empty cases, e2e without false positives, `api.ts` split

This task answers the Task 16 findings of the plan review (Opus with real use of the app and the 15-agent review team). It fixes: tab shortcuts (⌘T, ⌘W, ⌘1…9, Ctrl+Tab) firing behind the import dialog; the import error and busy state living in the dialog, so a late failure after it unmounted was lost; the focus trap (unchecked radios of a checked group, disabled fieldsets, focus lost when the focused button became disabled, Tab not handled like Escape, Escape accepted during the arming delay, two copies of `FOCUSABLE` and `ARMING_MS`); the empty cases of the dialog (empty pack list, listing error shown outside retrofit, received packs labelled wrongly, default theme listed twice, one fine-tuning note for both modes); the `ActionMenu` hint polluting the accessible name; the typed path trimmed in `isPptx`/`fileName` instead of at the prompt; `ui-file-merge-prompt` saying "open"; `ImportTarget.theme` typed as `string | null`; the file-size caps (`api.ts`, `styles.css`, `App.tsx`); and the e2e false positives (spec 220 reading the whole agent log, a fixed 600 ms wait, unguarded `JSON.parse`; spec 100 losing coverage silently; specs 110, 120, 130 reading `styles.css` alone). The import is now held by the workspace (`useImportJob`): the dialog is controlled (`busy`, `error`), no longer closes itself, Cancel and Escape close it while the import continues, a refusal arriving after that goes to the window banner, and picking another `.pptx` during an import reopens the running one's dialog. The tab shortcuts move out of `Workspace.tsx` into `useTabShortcuts` with a `held` callback. `useModalFrame` (in `modalFrame.ts`, the only home of `FOCUSABLE` and `ARMING_MS`) serves both `ImportDialog` and `AgentSurfaceBox`; `ARMING_MS` leaves `agent/useQuickKeys.ts`. `api.ts` is split into `hostCall.ts`, `workspaceApi.ts` and `filePick.ts` (re-exported by name, 821 lines left), the import and workshop CSS go to `import.css` and `workshop.css` (loaded right after `styles.css` by `main.tsx`, which is then 871 lines), and the file actions of `App.tsx` go to `useFileActions` (909 lines left). Deviations from the lot 5 decisions: the dialog no longer owns the import (decision 7 of the spec is rewritten to say the workspace holds it), and the e2e sheets are read through `e2e/lib/css.cjs`. Later tasks (Task 17) only add tests, docs and rules; the UI of this task is not changed again.

**Files:**
- Create: `ui/src/modalFrame.ts` (`useModalFrame`, `tabbables`, `FOCUSABLE`, `ARMING_MS`)
- Create: `ui/src/useImportJob.ts` and `ui/src/useImportJob.render.test.tsx` (the import held by the workspace, and its render tests)
- Create: `ui/src/useTabShortcuts.ts` and `ui/src/useTabShortcuts.render.test.tsx` (tab shortcuts out of `Workspace.tsx`, with `held`, and their render tests)
- Create: `ui/src/useFileActions.ts` (open, merge, move, copy, autosave out of `App.tsx`)
- Create: `ui/src/hostCall.ts`, `ui/src/workspaceApi.ts`, `ui/src/filePick.ts` (the three parts split from `api.ts`)
- Create: `ui/src/import.css`, `ui/src/workshop.css` (rules moved out of `styles.css`)
- Create: `ui/e2e/lib/css.cjs` (`APP_SHEETS`, `sheets()`: the app stylesheets for e2e pages)
- Modify: `ui/src/ImportDialog.tsx` and `ui/src/ImportDialog.render.test.tsx` (controlled dialog, frame, empty cases; render tests)

```diff
--- /dev/null
+++ b/ui/src/useImportJob.render.test.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+// L'import d'un .pptx tenu par l'espace de travail : le dialogue peut se fermer, l'issue reste montrée.
+
+import { afterEach, expect, test } from "bun:test";
+import "./test/dom";
+
+const { act, createElement } = await import("react");
+const { createRoot } = await import("react-dom/client");
+const { useImportJob } = await import("./useImportJob");
+
+type Job = ReturnType<typeof useImportJob>;
+let cleanup: (() => Promise<void>) | null = null;
+afterEach(async () => {
+  await cleanup?.();
+  cleanup = null;
+});
+
+/** Monte le hook ; `settle` règle l'import en cours (rien : réussi, un texte : refusé). */
+async function mount() {
+  const late: string[] = [];
+  const started: string[] = [];
+  let settle: (error?: string) => void = () => {};
+  const run = (path: string) =>
+    new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
+      started.push(path);
+      settle = (error) => (error === undefined ? resolve() : reject(new Error(error)));
+    });
+  const state: { job: Job | null } = { job: null };
+  const Probe = () => {
+    state.job = useImportJob((m) => late.push(m));
+    return null;
+  };
+  const host = document.createElement("div");
+  document.body.append(host);
+  const root = createRoot(host);
+  await act(async () => root.render(createElement(Probe)));
+  cleanup = async () => {
+    await act(async () => root.unmount());
+    host.remove();
+  };
+  const job = () => state.job!;
+  const done = (error?: string) => act(async () => settle(error));
+  const begin = () => act(async () => void job().start(run));
+  return { job, late, started, done, begin };
+}
+
+test("useImportJob pick ouvre le dialogue et retient les touches des onglets", async () => {
+  const { job } = await mount();
+  expect(job().job).toBeNull();
+  await act(async () => job().pick("/a/Alto.pptx"));
+  expect(job().job).toEqual({ path: "/a/Alto.pptx", shown: true, busy: false, error: null });
+  expect(job().holdsKeys()).toBe(true);
+});
+
+test("useImportJob réussi oublie l'import", async () => {
+  const { job, started, done, begin } = await mount();
+  await act(async () => job().pick("/a/Alto.pptx"));
+  await begin();
+  expect(started).toEqual(["/a/Alto.pptx"]);
+  expect(job().job?.busy).toBe(true);
+  await done();
+  expect(job().job).toBeNull();
+});
+
+test("useImportJob refusé, dialogue ouvert : le refus y reste", async () => {
+  const { job, late, done, begin } = await mount();
+  await act(async () => job().pick("/a/Alto.pptx"));
+  await begin();
+  await done("fichier illisible");
+  expect(job().job).toEqual({ path: "/a/Alto.pptx", shown: true, busy: false, error: "fichier illisible" });
+  expect(late).toEqual([]);
+});
+
+test("useImportJob fermé pendant l'import : il continue, sans retenir les touches", async () => {
+  const { job, done, begin } = await mount();
+  await act(async () => job().pick("/a/Alto.pptx"));
+  await begin();
+  await act(async () => job().close());
+  expect(job().job).toEqual({ path: "/a/Alto.pptx", shown: false, busy: true, error: null });
+  expect(job().holdsKeys()).toBe(false);
+  await done();
+  expect(job().job).toBeNull();
+});
+
+test("useImportJob refusé après la fermeture du dialogue : l'espace de travail le montre", async () => {
+  const { job, late, done, begin } = await mount();
+  await act(async () => job().pick("/a/Alto.pptx"));
+  await begin();
+  await act(async () => job().close());
+  await done("fichier illisible");
+  expect(job().job).toBeNull();
+  expect(late).toEqual(["fichier illisible"]);
+});
+
+test("useImportJob un autre choix pendant l'import rouvre celui qui tourne", async () => {
+  const { job, started, begin } = await mount();
+  await act(async () => job().pick("/a/Alto.pptx"));
+  await begin();
+  await act(async () => job().close());
+  await act(async () => job().pick("/b/Autre.pptx"));
+  await begin();
+  expect(job().job).toEqual({ path: "/a/Alto.pptx", shown: true, busy: true, error: null });
+  expect(started).toHaveLength(1);
+});
+
+test("useImportJob fermé hors import oublie le refus", async () => {
+  const { job, done, begin } = await mount();
```

```diff
+// Raccourcis des onglets de la fenêtre : retenus derrière un dialogue, et pendant une saisie.
```
